title: AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning)
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning) based in United Kingdom.

As an AI Research Engineer specializing in Agentic Reinforcement Learning, you will drive research and innovation in next-generation intelligent systems.
You will develop advanced reinforcement learning techniques that improve decision-making, adaptive behavior, and performance across multimodal AI architectures.
Working with text, images, audio, and other data modalities, you will help build models capable of solving complex, real-world challenges.
Your work will involve designing scalable training infrastructure, optimizing reward mechanisms, and improving the reliability of autonomous AI agents.
You will explore cutting-edge approaches involving diffusion-based generative models, autoregressive architectures, and unified multimodal frameworks.
Through rigorous experimentation and benchmarking, you will push the boundaries of model performance, efficiency, and generalization.
This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to contribute to impactful AI research within a fast-moving, globally distributed technology environment.


Accountabilities

In this role, you will conduct advanced research and develop scalable reinforcement learning systems for multimodal AI applications. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Research and develop reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image generation, autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified architectures integrating multiple modalities.

  • Design and implement scalable reinforcement learning infrastructure supporting distributed training across complex multimodal systems.

  • Develop and optimize reward modeling strategies to improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and prevent reward hacking and related failure modes.

  • Create, curate, and maintain multimodal simulation environments and training datasets to support robust model development, evaluation, and benchmarking.

  • Design and implement rigorous evaluation protocols to measure model performance, monitor progress against established baselines, and validate research improvements.

  • Analyze and optimize policy performance across different modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, reward optimization, and cross-modal alignment.

  • Investigate emerging reinforcement learning paradigms that enable AI agents to learn more effectively from environmental feedback.

  • Improve model exploration, decision-making, and adaptive behavior to achieve state-of-the-art performance in dynamic, real-world environments.

  • Conduct large-scale experiments and translate empirical findings into practical algorithmic improvements.

  • Publish and present research findings at leading international conferences, including ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, and ECCV.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate combines strong theoretical knowledge of reinforcement learning with hands-on experience developing and optimizing large-scale multimodal AI systems. The following qualifications and technical skills are expected:

    • Master's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline. A PhD in Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, or a closely related field is preferred.

    • Strong track record of AI research, including publications in leading international conferences.

    • Demonstrated experience conducting large-scale reinforcement learning experiments in multimodal and vision-centric systems, including online reinforcement learning environments.

    • Proven ability to improve domain-specific decision-making and achieve measurable gains in policy performance.

    • Deep understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and optimization techniques applied to vision and multimodal learning.

    • Strong knowledge of policy stability, exploration strategies, sample efficiency, and optimization in complex, high-dimensional environments involving images, video, and other modalities.

    • Advanced proficiency in PyTorch and modern deep learning frameworks for computer vision and multimodal AI.

    • Hands-on experience building end-to-end reinforcement learning pipelines covering simulation, model training, evaluation, and production deployment.

    • Ability to address fundamental reinforcement learning challenges, including sample inefficiency, exploration-exploitation trade-offs, and training instability.

    • Experience designing robust evaluation frameworks and using empirical research to continuously improve algorithmic performance.

    • Established research publication record at top-tier conferences such as ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, or ECCV.

    • Strong analytical thinking, scientific problem-solving skills, and the ability to translate advanced research into practical AI solutions.

      • Benefits

      • Fully Remote Work: Work remotely from anywhere in the world, with a globally distributed team.

      • International Collaboration: Collaborate with talented researchers, engineers, and technology professionals across different countries and disciplines.

      • Cutting-Edge AI Research: Work on advanced reinforcement learning, multimodal architectures, generative AI, and next-generation intelligent systems.

      • Research and Innovation: Explore new methodologies and contribute to state-of-the-art developments in artificial intelligence.

      • Scientific Recognition: Opportunities to publish research and present findings at leading international AI and machine learning conferences.

      • Professional Growth: Develop expertise in emerging AI technologies while contributing to challenging, high-impact research initiatives.

      • Global Technology Environment: Be part of an ambitious, fast-growing organization working across AI, digital finance, peer-to-peer technology, and other innovative fields.

Job Summary

As a research engineer at Graphcore, you will contribute to the advancement of AI research, investigating new ideas that push the limits on important AI/ML problems. Specialised hardware has been the key driver of the progress of AI over the last decade, and we believe that hardware-aware AI algorithms and AI-aware hardware developments will continue to be critical to advancing this exciting field. We are therefore looking for individuals who combine strong machine learning experience with practical engineering skills to deliver impactful AI research. We are seeking AI researchers with strong software engineering experience, particularly in lower-level programming and performance optimisation for hardware efficiency. Our research spans a broad range of topics, including efficient training and inference, world models, life sciences, reinforcement learning, and beyond. You will work closely with researchers to generate ideas and translate them into scalable implementations, contributing to publications and projects that help to steer the future of AI hardware.

The Team

Graphcore Research participates in both fundamental and applied research, to characterise the computational requirements of machine intelligence and to demonstrate how hardware can drive the next generation of innovative AI models. We publish at leading AI/ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) as well as specialist workshops, and collaborate with other research teams and organisations across the world.

We pride ourselves on being a supportive and collaborative team, where we organise around our individual research interests to solve problems together in domains such as efficient compute, model scaling and distributed training and inference of AI models for multiple modalities and applications, including for sequence- and graph-based data. We’re based across London, Cambridge and Bristol, with projects and discussions that involve all our locations.

Perhaps the best way to get an idea of what we’re all about is to read one of our papers or an article on our blog. If you’re excited to work at the cutting edge of AI supported by new hardware and want to develop your skills in this area, we’d love to hear from you!

About you:

  • Python programming in a modern deep learning framework, e.g. PyTorch or JAX.

  • Capable of designing, executing and reporting from ML experiments.
  • Lower-level programming for hardware efficiency, e.g. C++/CUDA/Triton.
  • Practical familiarity with hardware capabilities for deep learning – threads, caches, vector & matrix engines, data dependencies, bus widths and throttling.

Desirable:

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

You'll be the founding analytics engineer in Finance, shaping our data infrastructure and analytical capabilities during a critical transformation.   • Build and champion data quality and testing practices; catch errors before they reach stakeholders

What you would bring

You've built processes others follow; here, you'll do that with AI as a core enabler.

descriptionHtml:
About the team

The Applied AI Engineering team works closely with frontier startups. We are trusted advisors to, and thought partners with, startups to ensure that OpenAI’s technology is deployed safely and effectively, whilst also partnering with engineering, research, and product to turn those insights into evaluation systems, product improvements, and better model behavior.

As an Applied AI Engineer focused on Codex for startups, you will help developers and founders transform how they build and ship software. Presentations and community engagement are central to this role. You will engage developers and founders through technical talks, live demos, workshops, and programmes across the startup ecosystem, alongside targeted work with individual customers. You’ll build reusable tools and resources that extend your impact, and bring insights from developers back to OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys both hands-on building and sharing what they learn with others. Skills and Experience 

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

title: Associate Product Manager (UK Loans)
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

We're looking for a proactive, data-driven Associate Product Manager to join our UK Loans product team. You'll play an important role in shaping the customer experience after they take out a loan: from how we engage with customers and manage payments, to how we support those who experience financial difficulty.

APMs at Lendable take ownership of their product changes, working closely with teams across Engineering, Credit, Finance and Operations to solve problems and take the business to the next level.

You'll have the opportunity to solve complex problems, scale impactful products, and help shape the future of our lending experience. If you're excited by fintech and enjoy turning data and customer insight into great products, we'd love to hear from you.

What you’ll work on

  • Improving repayment performance: Running experiments to help more customers pay on time, from choosing repayment dates to how and when we remind people to pay.

  • Personalising customer engagement: Own how we communicate across email, SMS and in-app notifications, testing new messages and improving our tooling.

  • Making loan management easier: Optimising and expanding journeys within the Zable SuperApp, particularly for those who need additional financial support.

  • Using data to drive improvements: Work with Credit and Data Science to identify opportunities and build models to improve payment and servicing outcomes. Build dashboards to track key metrics and measure the impact of what we launch.

  • Testing and learning with customers: Running customer research and testing ideas to understand what people need, how they behave and what works best.

  • Taking products from idea to launch: Working across Engineering, Data Science and Operations to understand the impact of new features, coordinate their rollout and make sure they work for both customers and the business.

  • Increasing impact with AI: Building tools and automations with AI that save time for you, the ops team and the wider business

What we're looking for

Don't worry if you don't meet every single one of the criteria. We'd love to hear from great candidates who are curious, proactive and excited to learn.

  • Experience: 1–2 years in product, or 2-3 years in strategy, analytics, consulting or similar roles, ideally with experience working closely with product or delivery teams to get things done.

  • Communication: You can clearly explain ideas and requirements to different audiences, from writing specs for engineers to training Operations teams.

  • Curiosity: You ask lots of questions and aren't satisfied until you understand why something is happening.

  • Problem-solving: You enjoy forming hypotheses and finding the quickest way to test them, even if the first version is rough around the edges.

  • Data-driven: You're comfortable working with data and can use SQL or Python to investigate problems and answer your own questions.

  • AI-native: You're already experimenting with AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex in your work or side projects, and are excited to see how far they can take you.

  • Hands-on: You're happy to roll up your sleeves and pick up the small jobs. In a lean product team, no task is beneath your attention.

  • Adaptable: You enjoy variety and like that no two days look quite the same.

  • Bonus: Experience in lending, payments, fintech or a fast-growing startup.

AI at Lendable

We want to build the most AI-forward financial services company in the world. PMs here make their own dashboards to answer questions that used to need an analyst, build their own agents and workflows to take care of repetitive work, and ship straightforward changes to production themselves. You don't need to be an expert on day one, but we'll expect you to keep pushing what one person can do.

Interview process

  • A quick chat with someone from our Product team to see if the role is a good match

  • A 15 minute cognitive assessment

  • A take home task; a practical product challenge to complete in your own time

  • Task debrief with the product team

  • Final round (in our London office) - typically with the CPO and UK Loans MD, Engineering Manager, Head of Product and hiring manager

Location

This position is a hybrid role based in London, please note we're unable to provide sponsorship for this position

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

title: Automation Engineer – Magnet Industrialisation
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

TEAM & ROLE

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

You will support the industrialisation of production processes for magnet production, contributing directly to the execution of key activities within Proxima’s magnet program.

You will play a central role in designing, programming and operating automation cells performing a wide array of production processes such as welding, bonding, sealing and coating.

You will operate across a wide range of technical tasks, from design and engineering to hands on production work, and collaborating closely with engineers and technicians

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Advise on future line design and automation concepts

  • Define the requirements for automation cells for different processes to ensure performance, repeatability and safe operation

  • Contribute to the development of control strategies for new production lines

  • You will build and commission automation cells, including running FAT at supplier sites

  • Identify and test different manufacturing and in-process monitoring approaches

  • Design jigs and tools for magnet industrialised production

  • Support in the process development and prototyping of magnets, with scalability and repeatability in mind.

  • Collaborate closely with engineers and technicians across multiple teams

WHO YOU ARE

  • A master´s degree in mechanical, mechatronics or similar engineering field

  • A wide experience in robotics, automation and process monitoring in an industrial setting

  • Strong hands-on experience in production environments over a wide range of production processes (for ex. welding, machining, assembly, bonding)

  • Experience with robotic simulation and offline programming (e.g. RoboGuide, RobotStudio, Process Simulate). Previous work on FANUC systems is a plus

  • Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (e.g., OPC UA, Ethernet, Profinet)

  • Proficient in industrial-level PLC programming

  • Ability to work across a variety of tasks in a dynamic environment

  • Reliable, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset

  • Strong team player, able to collaborate closely with engineers and technical staff

  • A high performer who loves challenges and is not afraid to experiment, take risks and learn from mistakes.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Familiarity in both prototype manufacturing and industrial manufacturing

  • Proficiency in CAD: good knowledge of Catia V5 or 3DExperience are considered as a plus

  • Exposure to SCADA systems or MES integration

  • Familiarity with Beckhoff PLC and motion control

  • Knowledge of safety standards and risk assessments in automated environments

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)


*This role sits at L2 of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Azure Integration Architect
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij complexe integratievraagstukken vertalen naar toekomstbestendige oplossingen binnen het Microsoft-ecosysteem? En krijg je energie van het ontwerpen van architecturen die applicaties, systemen en data met elkaar verbinden? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Bij HSO werk je aan uitdagende integratievraagstukken binnen complexe IT-landschappen. Je krijgt de ruimte om klanten te adviseren, technische keuzes te maken en bij te dragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft Cloud- en integratieoplossingen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Azure Integration Architect help je onze klanten bij het ontwerpen, realiseren en moderniseren van hun integratielandschappen. Je vertaalt complexe business- en IT-vraagstukken naar schaalbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige oplossingen op basis van Microsoft Azure. Je kijkt verder dan alleen de techniek. Je begrijpt de uitdagingen van onze klanten, adviseert over architectuurkeuzes en zorgt ervoor dat verschillende systemen, applicaties en databronnen optimaal met elkaar samenwerken.

Concreet houd je je bezig met:

  • Ontwerpen van integratiearchitecturen: Je ontwikkelt schaalbare en toekomstbestendige oplossingen binnen complexe Microsoft- en hybride IT-landschappen.
  • Adviseren van klanten: Je begeleidt klanten bij strategische en technische keuzes rondom integratie, cloudmodernisering en architectuur.
  • Inzetten van Azure-technologie: Je ontwerpt oplossingen met onder andere Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, API Management, Service Bus en Event Grid.
  • Moderniseren van integratielandschappen: Je helpt organisaties bij het vervangen of verbeteren van bestaande integratieoplossingen en het toepassen van moderne cloud-native technologie.
  • Borgen van kwaliteit: Je houdt rekening met security, performance, schaalbaarheid en beheerbaarheid.
  • Kennis delen en samenwerken: Je werkt samen met andere architecten, consultants en developers en draagt bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze integratie-expertise.

Je krijgt de ruimte om inhoudelijk richting te geven, mee te denken over innovatieve oplossingen en klanten te helpen bij hun digitale transformatie.

Wat vragen wij van jou?

We zoeken een ervaren architect die technische expertise combineert met een adviserende en ondernemende instelling. Je bent in staat om complexe vraagstukken te doorgronden en deze te vertalen naar praktische, toekomstbestendige oplossingen. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

  • Je hebt HBO-werk- en denkniveau;
  • Je hebt ervaring met het ontwerpen van integratiearchitecturen binnen complexe IT-omgevingen;
  • Je beschikt over gedegen kennis van Microsoft Azure en Azure Integration Services;
  • Je hebt ervaring met technologieën zoals Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, API Management en Service Bus;
  • Je bent bekend met architectuurprincipes, security, governance en cloud-native oplossingen;
  • Je kunt technische vraagstukken vertalen naar heldere adviezen en weet verschillende stakeholders hierin mee te nemen;
  • Je bent ondernemend, denkt graag mee over nieuwe mogelijkheden en draagt bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze dienstverlening;
  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Wat verzorgen wij?  

  • Bij HSO reis je niet alleen voor een baan maar voor een carrière vol ontdekkingen. Naast een marktconform salaris en een prestatiegerichte bonus, krijg je praktische benodigdheden en beleving: 
  • Flexibele werkplek: kies je basis Rotterdam, Veenendaal of thuiswerken, jij bepaalt de route; 
  • Mobiliteitsvergoeding waarbij je of een auto kunt leasen of het bedrag toe kunt voegen aan je salaris. Daar bovenop krijg 100% betaald van de ov-kosten;  
  • Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan;   
  • EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget, we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote;   
  • Op dag één start jouw onboardingprogramma, daarnaast krijg je een persoonlijk studiebudget dat je kunt inzetten voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling en ontvang je ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.  
  • 25 vakantiedagen + optie om 10 extra te kopen; workations mogelijk voor wie écht nieuwe houvast zoekt; 
  • Dagelijkse verzorgde lunch, bedrijfsfeesten, sportactiviteiten en wekelijkse borrels om onze gezamenlijke reis te versterken. 

Onze wereldwijde route

Als Microsoft Inner Circle-partner en internationaal opererend bedrijf biedt HSO jou toegang tot best practices, certificeringen en een wereldwijd netwerk van experts. Samen met ruim 2200 getalenteerde medewerkers in Europa, Azië en Noord-Amerika verlenen we ondersteuning op lokaal en internationaal niveau aan industriële bedrijven, retailers, financiële en zakelijke dienstverleners en overheidsinstellingen. Je werkt in een dynamische omgeving waarin kennisdeling centraal staat en waarin je jouw expertise direct kunt inzetten om klanten te helpen transformeren.

title: Broker Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Wayflyer

Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.

Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.

You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.

 

The challenge

The Broker Channel is Wayflyer's fastest-growing route to market, and growth like that doesn't manage itself. We need someone who can scale a panel of brokers into a genuine growth engine, turning relationships and referral volume into closed deals. This isn't a maintenance role. It's a build role.

What you'll actually do

  • Grow and manage our broker panel, bringing on new brokers and training them to properly understand and sell our products

  • Build real relationships with existing brokers, the kind that make them think of you first when a deal comes up

  • Review referrals and provide sense checks and indicative offers, reading business financials well enough to spot what matters

  • Own your portfolio end to end, converting referral volume into funded deals, not just noise in the pipeline

  • Represent Wayflyer at industry events and in broker networks, building our name as much as your own

What this role could turn into

Brokers are a key focus area for the business, so whoever takes this on gets a real say in shaping it, not just executing someone else's plan. From here, that can mean leading a regional broker team as we expand into new regions, or stepping into a wider commercial partnerships role across the business.

Who thrives here

Someone who treats brokers as partners, not leads, and understands that a broker's reputation is on the line every time they refer you a deal. You're commercially sharp, comfortable with numbers, and genuinely curious about the businesses behind the applications, not just the credit markers. You don't wait for a case to be handed to you in a tidy format. You chase it down, sense-check it, and move.

We hire for range

We're looking for someone who's spent at least 2 years in business lending, ideally in fintech, and at least 2 years working directly with commercial finance brokers, with a real network to show for it. You'll have at least a year analysing business financials at a working level, and Hubspot experience is a bonus. More important than the years is the trajectory: have you built something, grown a book, or turned relationships into revenue? We'll also consider exceptional candidates from adjacent areas of business finance who don't tick every box.

Location and working policy

📍London, hybrid (3-4 days)

title: CDI - Senior Context & Analytics Engineer - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Un agent ne vaut que ce que valent les données et les connaissances sur lesquelles il répond. Pipelines, modèles de données, définitions de métriques, droits d’accès : vous créez et gouvernez ce socle, et les applications et les agents de nos clients s’appuient dessus. Quand un analyste ou un agent demande un chiffre, la réponse est celle de l’équipe finance, accompagnée de sa définition et de sa source.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que les métiers et les agents puissent se fier aux données, et les utilisent.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Context & Analytics Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités

Avec les équipes métier et les analystes, il s’agit de définir ce que signifie chaque métrique et de vérifier que les données y correspondent. Sur ce socle, les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers construisent applications et agents.

Les Platform Engineers exploitent l’infrastructure sur laquelle tournent vos pipelines. Les échanges avec les data owners et les équipes de gouvernance du client, la relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues complètent le quotidien.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des pipelines d’ingestion et des modèles de données, avec dbt par exemple.
  • Mettre en place des contrôles de qualité des données et maintenir le lineage.
  • Construire la couche sémantique et les définitions de métriques, pour que les personnes et les agents utilisent les mêmes chiffres, y compris en text-to-SQL.
  • Définir les règles de gouvernance et les droits d’accès.
  • Construire des pipelines de connaissances pour le RAG : indexation, chunking, métadonnées, permissions.
  • Préparer le contexte exploitable par les agents : métadonnées, définitions, lineage et permissions.

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous écrivez du SQL avec aisance et modélisez les données pour l’analyse.
  2. Des pipelines de données planifiés, testés et surveillés figurent à votre actif.
  3. Aux côtés des équipes métier, vous définissez les métriques et vérifiez que les données veulent bien dire ce que tout le monde croit y lire.
  4. La qualité des données, la documentation et les droits d’accès comptent pour vous.
  5. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Python pour le traitement de données.
  • Une plateforme de données cloud, comme BigQuery, Snowflake ou Databricks.
  • Une couche sémantique ou un metrics store.
  • La préparation de documents pour le RAG : chunking, indexation, métadonnées.
  • Des outils de data catalogue ou de lineage.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Dans un métier où deux tableaux de bord affichent parfois deux chiffres différents, ce poste consiste à rétablir la confiance : un chiffre juste, une définition partagée, une source identifiable. Ce travail, discret quand il réussit, conditionne tout ce que les autres archétypes construisent au-dessus.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets, avec les AI Engineers et l’appui de la communauté Context & Analytics Engineer, notamment le context engineering, c’est-à-dire le travail qui rend les données exploitables par les agents d’IA. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Context & Analytics Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

  1. Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.
  2. Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).
  3. Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.
  4. Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.
  5. Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.
  6. Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 53 000€ à 70 000€ brut annuel (fixe)  + variable selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil international spécialisé en Data et Intelligence Artificielle, présent dans plus de 20 pays avec plus de 2 500 collaborateurs.

Nous accompagnons nos clients dans leur transformation en combinant expertise technologique, conseil et connaissance métier, sur des enjeux allant de la stratégie Data & IA à la conception et au déploiement de solutions concrètes.

Nos équipes réunissent notamment des Business Consultants, Data Analysts, Data Scientists et Data Engineers, qui interviennent auprès de grands groupes internationaux dans des secteurs variés.

Notre ambition : mettre la Data et l’IA au service de problématiques business concrètes et créer un impact mesurable pour nos clients.

Ton rôleAu sein de l’équipe Talent Acquisition France et sous la responsabilité de la Head of Talent Acquisition, tu pilotes en autonomie le recrutement des équipes Strat Data d’Artefact, sur des profils allant de Junior à Manager.

Partenaire des équipes opérationnelles, tu les accompagnes tout au long du processus afin de garantir des recrutements de qualité et une expérience candidat exigeante :

Piloter les recrutements de bout en bout

  • Recueillir et challenger les besoins auprès des managers
  • Définir et mettre en œuvre l’approche de recrutement adaptée à chaque besoin
  • Piloter l’ensemble du processus : sourcing, qualification, entretiens RH, coordination des étapes d’évaluation et offre
  • Développer une approche proactive du sourcing et constituer des viviers de profils pertinents.

Accompagner les équipes opérationnelles

  • Conseiller et challenger les managers tout au long du processus afin de garantir des décisions de recrutement objectives et cohérentes
  • Garantir la bonne application du processus et des méthodes d’évaluation
  • Veiller à une expérience de recrutement de qualité pour les candidatures et les équipes internes

Contribuer à l’amélioration continue

  • Identifier les points de friction et contribuer à l’amélioration des processus et pratiques
  • Veiller à la qualité et à la fiabilité des données dans notre ATS (Greenhouse)
  • Contribuer aux projets et initiatives de l’équipe Talent Acquisition.

Ton profil

  • Une expérience confirmée en recrutement, idéalement dans le conseil/ ESN
  • Une maîtrise du recrutement de bout en bout, avec une solide pratique du sourcing et de l’approche directe
  • Une capacité à gérer et prioriser un périmètre de recrutement en autonomie
  • Une posture de business partner, avec la capacité de conseiller et challenger
  • Une bonne maîtrise des outils de recrutement et un bon niveau d’anglais.

Rémunération : jusqu’à 44K annuel selon profil.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Formations continues et participation à des projets stratégiques d'acquisition et de fidélisation des talents
  • Équipe dynamique, flexibilité télétravail, séminaires d'équipe
  • Localisation Paris 9ème

Étapes du recrutement

  1. Entretien avec Mélody, Head of Talent Acquisition
  2. Entretien avec Laurie, DRH

Chez Artefact, nous recrutons nos collaborateurs uniquement en fonction de nos besoins et des qualités propres de chaque candidat. Nous assurons le développement de leurs compétences professionnelles et de leurs responsabilités sans discrimination d’aucune sorte, notamment de croyances, de genre, d’âge, de situation d'handicap, d’origine ethnique, d’orientation sexuelle, d’appartenance à une organisation politique, religieuse, syndicale ou à une minorité.

title: Channel Partnerships Manager, DACH
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

As Partnerships Manager, you will be joining as a core member of Airwallex’s Commercial team in EMEA and the first partnerships manager on the ground in Germany. You will be responsible for identifying and building partnerships across our core verticals of travel, SaaS and e-Commerce. We are seeking a strategic, creative, and highly-driven Partnerships Manager who has 5+ years of experience working in a fast-paced or high-growth environment. We operate in a hybrid environment, with a minimum of 3 days a week working in our office in Berlin.

What You'll Be Doing...

  • You will lead, own, and develop a partnership strategy that aligns with our overall GTM in Germany

  • You will be accountable for identifying growth opportunities, testing new verticals, and building a high-quality portfolio of partners

  • You will design a scalable programme to consistently deliver growth in the partnerships channel

  • You will work closely with Marketing, Sales and Strategy teams to position Airwallex’s value proposition to partners and their clients in Germany

  • You will represent Airwallex at industry events and conferences, as well as speak on relevant panels and webinars

What You Bring...

  • Demonstrable interest in fintech, SaaS, and/or payments

  • Strong commercial instincts and a history of meeting or exceeding OKRs/KPIs consistently

  • 5+ years of work experience in partnerships, strategy, business development, or a similar role in a high-growth, fast-paced environment

  • Comfortable working with data and spreadsheets (G-Suite, Looker) and building and delivering presentations for partners and clients

  • Superior verbal and written communication skills in German and English.

Who You Are...

  • Results-driven - you hold yourself accountable for delivering on your targets

  • Proactive - you identify, plan, and execute against opportunities to grow, and you enjoy problem-solving to achieve those goals

  • Laser-focused - you are ruthless in spending time on the highest-impact initiatives in a fast-paced environment

  • Commercially-minded - you enjoy negotiating and you strive to achieve the best outcomes for the business

  • Relationship-oriented - you can build deep and trusting relationships with partners

  • Excellent communicator - you have excellent written and presentation skills

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Clinical Solutions Consultant
descriptionHtml:
About Rivia

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Over the past two years, European- and US-based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia's ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

The Role

As our Clinical Solutions Consultant, you'll be the bridge between science, technology, and sales, helping biotech and pharma companies understand how Rivia can transform the way they work with clinical trial data.

You'll partner closely with our Account Executives throughout the technical stages of the sales cycle, turning complex scientific and technical challenges into compelling product demonstrations, tailored sandboxes, and solutions that address real customer needs.

This isn't a role where you simply present slides or follow a demo script. You'll need to understand clinical trial workflows, get hands-on with data, challenge assumptions, and translate complex customer requirements into solutions we can actually deliver.

You'll also play an important role in shaping how we approach technical pre-sales at Rivia, building repeatable processes, improving our demo environments, and helping us scale without losing the scientific depth and customer understanding that make us different.

What Excites You

  • Bringing science and technology together: You love understanding complex scientific challenges and translating them into practical, impactful solutions.

  • Being hands-on: You don't just talk about what a product can do. You enjoy building demos, configuring sandboxes, working with data, and showing customers what's possible.

  • Making an impact on revenue: You enjoy being part of the sales process, influencing strategic deals, and helping customers confidently make decisions.

  • Solving real customer problems: You're curious about how biotech and pharma companies operate and enjoy finding creative ways to address their challenges.

  • Building from the ground up: You get excited about joining a growing company where you can shape processes, improve tools, and help establish how technical pre-sales should work.

  • Working across teams: You enjoy collaborating with Sales, Product, and Engineering, balancing commercial opportunities with technical feasibility.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Account Executives as the scientific and technical expert throughout the sales process, helping prospects understand how Rivia can address their specific challenges.

  • Lead in-depth product demonstrations tailored to customers' clinical trial workflows, data structures, and scientific requirements.

  • Build and configure customized sandboxes, demo environments, and prototype integrations to demonstrate Rivia's value using realistic customer scenarios.

  • Understand customers' clinical trial pipelines, protocols, endpoints, and data challenges, translating their needs into practical technical solutions.

  • Scope prospective customer implementations, identifying technical requirements, dependencies, risks, and feasibility before commercial commitments are made.

  • Collaborate closely with Solutions Engineers and Customer Engagement to ensure smooth handovers from pre-sales to implementation.

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to both customers and internal teams, confidently addressing complex scientific questions while being transparent about product capabilities and limitations.

  • Adapt demonstrations and technical conversations to customers' familiarity with and readiness to adopt AI-driven solutions.

  • Identify recurring customer needs, technical objections, and product gaps, sharing insights with Product and Engineering to continuously improve our offering.

  • Help develop scalable pre-sales processes, reusable demo environments, and technical documentation as Rivia grows.

What Excites Us

  • Scientific background: You have a degree in life sciences, bioinformatics, biomedical engineering, or a related scientific discipline, and you're comfortable navigating complex scientific discussions.

  • Relevant experience: You bring at least 4 years of client-facing experience in solutions consulting, technical pre-sales, field application science, technical account management, or similar roles.

  • Scientific and technical fluency: You understand scientific data and experimental logic, and can quickly grasp complex clinical trial workflows and technical requirements.

  • Hands-on technical skills: You've personally built and configured product demos, sandboxes, or technical proof-of-concepts, rather than only presenting solutions developed by others.

  • Commercial mindset: You understand how technical expertise contributes to winning deals and enjoy working closely with sales teams to move opportunities forward.

  • Customer-facing confidence: You can communicate complex technical concepts clearly and credibly, whether you're speaking with scientists, clinical operations leaders, or technical stakeholders.

  • Strong ownership: You're proactive, independent, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where processes are still being built.

  • Collaborative approach: You know when to challenge assumptions, push back on unrealistic commitments, and work across teams to deliver the best outcomes for customers.

Bonus / Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in scientific software, clinical trial technology, biotech platforms, or laboratory informatics.

  • Familiarity with clinical trial protocols, endpoints, regulatory considerations, and clinical data integration.

  • Experience working with AI-driven products or communicating the value of AI to scientific and technical stakeholders.

Our Values

  • In It to Win It: Approach every challenge with determination, resilience, and a drive to achieve the best possible outcomes.

  • Embrace Change: We see change as an opportunity for growth, innovation, and improvement, continuously evolving to stay one step ahead.

  • Why Not?: We challenge assumptions, stay curious, and explore new possibilities rather than accepting things as they are.

  • Find the Gap: We proactively identify opportunities, anticipate challenges, and solve problems before they arise.

  • Collective Accountability: We're one team, on one mission, committed to shared responsibility, mutual support, and trust.

  • Value Add Solutions: Know better. Act better. We're dedicated to delivering meaningful solutions that create real impact.

title: Commercial Account Executive, Growth | Remote | Germany
descriptionHtml:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity 

Grafana Labs is looking for a Commercial Account Executive, Growth based in Germany who will be responsible for prospecting and closing new business across DACH. You will identify, nurture and close opportunities with new customers, manage forecasts and track customer data. We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products, work with the customer during the trial phase and hand off a strong relationship to our Growth team. Ideally, you come from a technical background and have sold technical products before.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals
  • Outbound prospecting into net-new customers
  • Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, and negotiations)
  • Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads
  • Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise
  • Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce
  • Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 2+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales
  • Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer)
  • Energetic, upbeat, entrepreneurial, tenacious team player
  • Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies
  • You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually
  • Fluent in English & German 

 Bonus Points For: 

  • Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage
  • Experience using Salesforce
  • Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal

Compensation & Rewards 

In Germany, the OTE compensation range for this role is EUR 175,000 - EUR 185,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. 

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. title: Commercial Counsel - Germany
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Commercial Counsel to join our Legal Team in Germany. In this role, you will support complex commercial transactions with a primary focus on Germany and support for the DACH region, including SaaS, licensing, and strategic partnerships, while helping the company navigate diverse legal and regulatory frameworks in the rapidly evolving field of artificial intelligence. You will work closely with global colleagues to provide practical, business-oriented advice that enables growth while managing risk across multiple jurisdictions.

Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, and negotiate enterprise commercial agreements, with a primary focus on GTM/Sales transactions in Germany, with support for EMEA as a whole, as a member of a growing commercial legal team in the regions.

  • Partner with sales, business development, and operations teams to design and implement strategies that support high-growth go-to-market initiatives.

  • Monitor and interpret evolving country specific legal and regulatory developments, including data protection, technology, and AI-related frameworks, and apply this knowledge to contract drafting and risk assessment.

  • Develop, maintain, and localize contract templates, playbooks, and policies to reflect local requirements and industry best practices.

  • Provide clear, pragmatic, and commercially focused legal advice to cross-functional teams, tailoring advice to enable responsible growth and innovation.

  • Contribute to scaling the Legal Team’s commercial function, fostering a collaborative, solutions-oriented team culture.

Who you are

  • Curious about the future of AI and emerging technologies, have a strong sense of ownership with enthusiasm for applying your legal expertise to cutting-edge products.

  • Experienced in navigating fast-paced, high-growth environments, with the ability to manage ambiguity and make informed, timely decisions.

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and global colleagues.

title: Compliance Associate, Advisory
descriptionHtml:
Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth

We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love.

Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success.

Тoday, we serve over 5 million clients, with more than €30 billion in assets under management - a testament to the scale and trust we’ve built in just a few years.

The role

As a Compliance Associate in the Advisory team at Trading 212 UK, you'll help the business meet its FCA obligations through day-to-day second line advice, review and approval. You'll handle time-sensitive requests from across the business, including financial promotions, client communications, employee compliance and regulatory queries, and help keep the UK compliance framework up to date.

What you’ll do

  • Review and approve financial promotions for Trading 212 in line with FCA rules, Consumer Duty and internal guidelines.

  • Review and approve client communications.

  • Respond to compliance queries from the business on a wide range of subjects.

  • Review and approve professional client opt-up applications.

  • Support partner and affiliate onboarding reviews.

  • Deliver compliance inductions and support the Compliance training plan, including training materials.

  • Support horizon scanning, impact assessments, gap analyses and implementation of regulatory change.

  • Review and update policies, procedures and the Compliance Manual.

  • Support SM&CR administration, FCA notifications, regulatory reporting and responses to FCA requests.

  • Support product governance, appropriateness and Consumer Duty work on new products and changes.

  • Collect data and help produce monthly MI.

  • Support senior members of the team with projects and ad hoc tasks.

What you need to have

  • 2–3 years' compliance experience within an FCA-regulated firm, ideally in retail investments, brokerage or payments.

  • Experience reviewing financial promotions or client communications is strongly preferred.

  • Working knowledge of FCA rules, including COBS 4, PRIN and Consumer Duty, SYSC and SM&CR.

  • Ability to manage a high volume of time-sensitive work accurately and prioritise under pressure.

  • Strong attention to detail and record-keeping.

  • Strong IT skills.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, Business or any other relevant field.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work in a high-performance

  • environment

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team

  • A strong drive for excellence and a continuous improvement mindset

  • Strong time management and organizational abilities

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

What We offer

  • Working with a highly motivated and successful team of high performers - with real ownership and room to grow

  • A culture that values talent, ideas, and execution

  • Real impact - your work will help shape growth for a product used by millions of investors

  • Challenges that will help you grow fast and unlock your potential

title: Content Creator (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Einleitung

Wir suchen neue Kolleg:innen! Migrando ist ein Legal-Tech-Unternehmen aus Cottbus. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Weg zur Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht und einem starken Team aus über 60 Kolleg:innen begleiten wir tausende Mandant:innen erfolgreich auf dem Weg zum deutschen Pass. Alle unsere Stellen sind Festanstellungen bei uns vor Ort in Cottbus.

Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich selbst einen Eindruck auf unserer Karriereseite. Denn wir können hier schreiben, was wir wollen, am Ende bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung.

Wir bieten Dir

Wir wissen, dass guter Content mehr ist als nur ein Trend. Deshalb bekommst du bei uns nicht nur kreativen Freiraum, sondern auch Flexibilität, Wertschätzung und ein Team, das zusammenhält.

  • Eigenes Content-Budget und Freiraum für neue Formate
    Du bekommst ein eigenes Budget und die Freiheit, neue Formate zu testen, ohne unnötige Hierarchieschleifen. Wir leben eine „Test-and-Learn“-Kultur: Du darfst Risiken eingehen, ausprobieren und auch Content machen, der polarisiert, solange er unsere Mission voranbringt.
  • Professionelles Equipment und High-End-Hardware
    Wir stellen dir professionelle Kameras, Mikrofone und Licht. Für die Postproduktion bekommst du die Maschine, auf der du am besten arbeitest, egal ob MacBook Pro oder Dell XPS mit Linux, dazu 4K-Monitore und einen ergonomischen Arbeitsplatz mit höhenverstellbarem Tisch.
  • Große Reichweite
    Über die Jahre haben wir mit unserer Plattform schon sehr viele Menschen erreicht. Durch diesen Traffic siehst du schnell, was funktioniert, und bekommst direktes Feedback auf deine Arbeit.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit
    Dein Content hat direkten Einfluss auf das Leben von Menschen. Du unterstützt sie dabei, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen. Das ist Arbeit mit echter Bedeutung.
  • Kurze Wege und kleine Teams
    Du arbeitest in überschaubaren Teams, in denen man sich kennt. Du musst dich nicht durch Hierarchien hangeln, um gehört zu werden, sondern sprichst direkt mit Kolleg:innen, Teamleads oder der Geschäftsführung. Entscheidungen fallen schnell, und niemand sitzt „im Elfenbeinturm“.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit und flexible Teilzeit
    Keine Kernzeiten, keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster. Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell: Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.
  • Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung
    Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Nach deiner Einarbeitung ist gelegentliches Homeoffice aber kein Problem, auch spontan.
  • Spontan frei, wenn das Leben dazwischenkommt
    Kranke Kinder, Elternabend, kurzfristiger Arzttermin oder einfach mal eine Auszeit: Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.
  • Modernes Altbau-Büro mit Fitnessraum
    Hohe Decken, viel Tageslicht, Pflanzen und ein Innenhof für die Pause zwischendurch, mitten im Herzen von Cottbus. Unser eigener Fitnessraum im Haus steht dir kostenlos und jederzeit zur Verfügung. Einen Einblick in unsere Räume bekommst du auf unserer Website.
  • Team-Events und Feel-Good-Angebote
    Sommerfest am See, Weihnachtsfeier, Halloween-Sause, gemeinsame Lunches oder Afterwork-Dinner: Wir feiern gern. Erscheinen ist keine Pflicht, und früher gehen ist auch kein Problem. Zwischendurch sorgt unsere Feel-Good-Managerin für kleine Auszeiten, von Nacken- und Schultermassagen bis zu kurzen Entspannungs-Sessions.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

Als Content Creator (w/m/d) bist du nicht nur für den Schnitt verantwortlich. Du kannst Strateg:in, Regisseur:in oder Performance-Analyst:in sein.

  • Strategisches Video-Scripting
    Du entwickelst kreative Video-Konzepte und Skripte für alle relevanten Social-Media-Kanäle (TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts) und bringst sie bis zur finalen Fassung.
  • Produktionsmanagement
    Du planst, koordinierst und setzt Videodrehs um, von der Idee bis zum Upload.
  • Storytelling mit Impact
    Gemeinsam mit unserem Anwaltsteam verwandelst du komplexe juristische Themen in leicht verständliche, authentische und emotionale Geschichten.
  • Redaktionsplanung
    Du baust eine Content-Pipeline auf und sorgst mit deiner Redaktionsplanung für konstanten Output.
  • Content-Multiplikation
    Du planst Cross-Promotion und verwertest Content clever über verschiedene Plattformen hinweg.
  • Trend-Scouting
    Du erkennst aktuelle Social-Media-Trends und Formate früh und adaptierst sie schnell für Migrando.
  • Performance-Analyse
    Du analysierst laufend, wie dein Content performt (Views, Watch Time, Engagement), und optimierst ihn stetig.
  • A/B-Testing
    Du testest systematisch Thumbnails, Teaser, Titel und Call-to-Actions, um Klickrate und Performance zu maximieren.
  • Community- & Engagement-Management
    Du baust eine engagierte Community auf und pflegst sie, indem du aktiv auf Kommentare und DMs antwortest.

Dein Profil

Uns ist egal, welche Zertifikate du hast oder wo du studiert hast. Was uns interessiert: Was kannst du wirklich? Wer in der Praxis gearbeitet und echte Hands-on-Erfahrung gesammelt hat, bringt mehr mit als jeder Kursabschluss. Bei uns zählen deine Erfahrung, dein Können und dein Verantwortungsbewusstsein.

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Content-Produktion
    Du hast bereits Social-Media-Content produziert, der wirklich online gegangen ist und funktioniert hat, und kannst uns Beispiele dafür zeigen. Du weißt, was es heißt, regelmäßig zu liefern, und hast aus Erfolgen wie Flops gelernt.
  • Festanstellung vor Ort in Cottbus
    Du möchtest fest bei uns angestellt sein und im Team vor Ort in Cottbus arbeiten. Für Freelance-Aufträge oder reine Remote-Stellen sind wir leider nicht die richtige Adresse.
  • Bereitschaft, vor der Kamera zu stehen
    Du hast keine Scheu, selbst vor der Kamera zu stehen, und motivierst auch Kolleg:innen, ihre Geschichte zu teilen.
  • Video-Schnitt
    Idealerweise beherrschst du professionelle Schnittprogramme (z. B. Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve). In unserem Social-Media-Team gibt es aber auch Bedarf an Scripting, Ideenentwicklung und Content-Planung, ganz ohne Schnittsoftware.

    Du denkst nicht nur in Reichweite, sondern in Interaktion. Deine Metrik ist die Engagement Rate.

Jemand, mit dem die Zusammenarbeit angenehm und reibungslos läuft, ist im Alltag oft wertvoller als jemand mit noch mehr Know-how, mit dem die Kommunikation aber schleppend ist.

title: Content & Growth Marketer
descriptionHtml:
About Tradeaze

Tradeaze is on-demand delivery for the built environment. Builders' merchants book a delivery in our app, and a vetted driver collects from the branch and delivers to site the same day. We work with national groups like Jewson, Travis Perkins, EH Smith and Lords, and we are growing fast. You would be the second person in growth and marketing, joining as the new brand and website go live.

The role

You are a content-leaning generalist marketer who uses AI to do the work of a bigger team. Your job is to bring new branches onto Tradeaze and turn them into regular customers. You make the message; we run the system behind it.

What you will do

  • Make content for two audiences: the people who use Tradeaze every day (branch staff and drivers), and the people who follow us on LinkedIn as a tech-forward start-up. Posts, short video, case studies, printed pieces, content from around the office
  • Turn one real delivery into three things in a week: a case study, a post and a one-pager sales can carry into a branch
  • Write the campaigns that turn a new branch into a regular customer, from the idea to the words to the design
  • Sit with the marketing team at a merchant head office and run a joint campaign across their branches
  • Keep socials and the blog moving, with AI doing the first draft and you deciding what's good
  • Be out at yards and branches with a camera, and at trade events with a stand

Who you are

  • Around 3 years in marketing, in a small team or start-up where you made the work yourself. Less is fine if your work shows it
  • You take ownership. You spot what needs doing and do it without being asked, and you treat the results as yours.
  • You've designed things people actually used: a post, a flyer, a deck. Use whatever tool you like (Figma, Adobe), as long as the work looks professional
  • You write for an audience, whether you write it yourself or set the lines and guidelines and have AI draft it. Either way you know what a counter manager will read and what a LinkedIn follower will stop for
  • You already use AI in your work. You can show us something you shipped with it and talk us through how you use it
  • You've taken a campaign from the idea to launch: the message, the words and the design
  • You come to a conversation with ideas and you enjoy bouncing them off someone
  • You're personable: comfortable with sales reps, a room full of branch managers, and sitting with a merchant head office's marketing team to run a joint campaign
  • You'd rather get it live this week and improve it than plan it for a month
  • Nice to have: paid ads (you've run paid social or search with a budget), events (you've helped run a trade show stand) and email copy (you've written emails that get people to take one clear action)

Not for you if:

  • You want a brief handed to you
  • You need an agency to make things
  • You'd rather plan than ship

How we work

You will report to our GTM Engineer, and you both report to Jack, our CEO. You will work with the GTM Engineer day to day. They own the systems: the CRM, the email platform, the data and the sends. You own the message and the content. You will plan together, brainstorm together, and look at the numbers together every Monday. Jack opens the door with merchant head offices; you and the GTM Engineer run what happens next.

You will see your work on a live dashboard: what shipped, what it reached, and which branches ordered because of it.

What you get

  • £40k to £48k
  • Stock options
  • 25 days holiday
  • A laptop

How to apply

With your application, send us:

  1. 3 to 5 pieces of content you made yourself, ideally including one video you filmed and cut yourself (a phone is fine). Other examples: a social post or carousel, a campaign from idea to launch, a printed piece, a case study. For each one, a line on what you did and what it led to
  2. A few lines on how you use AI: which tools, for what, and one thing it let you ship

How we will hire

  1. Send us 3 to 5 pieces you made and a few lines on how you work with AI
  2. A call with Jack, our CEO
  3. A short campaign task, then a call with our GTM Engineer to talk it through
  4. Present your idea to the team in person: the same idea, updated with what you'd change. 15 minutes, no new deck needed
