DIRECTOR – EUROPEAN GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

As the Director – European Government Operations, based in Munich/ Berlin, Germany, you will lead Rocket Lab’s government affairs strategy across Germany and the broader European region. You will play a critical role in advancing Rocket Lab’s business objectives by shaping policy environments, building strategic government relationships, and ensuring alignment between Government Affairs and Business Development. In this role, you will work at the intersection of aerospace innovation, national security, and European public-sector engagement. To be successful, you must be results‑oriented, proactive, politically astute, and deeply comfortable operating in complex, fast‑moving environments. Join a driven team of pioneers relentlessly tackling challenging projects, delivering on the impossible, and making an impact on the future of space.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO

  • Build and lead Rocket Lab’s in‑house European Government Operations function, delivering the same level of strategic support and government engagement the company receives in the U.S. market
  • Develop and lead Rocket Lab’s government affairs strategy in Germany and across Europe, ensuring alignment with corporate priorities and business development objectives
  • Build and maintain high‑impact relationships with key German federal stakeholders, including the Bundestag, DLR, Ministry of Defense, and relevant regulatory and executive agencies
  • Establish and grow Rocket Lab’s presence with government entities and innovation ecosystems in Munich and other strategic European hubs
  • Partner closely with the Business Development team to support market expansion, customer engagement, and pursuit of government‑funded programs
  • Shape and influence policy discussions related to space, defense, launch, and emerging technologies, ensuring Rocket Lab’s interests are represented and understood
  • Provide strategic guidance on political, regulatory, and industrial‑policy developments across Europe, identifying opportunities and risks for business
  • Represent Rocket Lab in industry associations, working groups, and public‑sector forums to strengthen the company’s visibility and credibility
  • Drive measurable business outcomes through targeted government engagement not only monitoring policy trends but actively shaping them
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on European political dynamics, defense priorities, and government procurement pathways

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in political science, international relations, public policy, law, economics, engineering, or a related field
  • 12+ years of experience in government affairs, public policy, defense, aerospace, or related strategic roles within Germany or Europe
  • Professional fluency in German and English
  • Demonstrated success building and managing relationships with senior government officials, policymakers, and public‑sector institutions
  • Proven ability to drive business‑aligned outcomes through government engagement, not solely policy monitoring
  • Strong understanding of European political structures, defense priorities, and government procurement processes
  • Ability to operate autonomously, set strategy, and execute in a fast‑paced, high‑growth environment
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder‑management skills

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE

  • Background in space, aerospace, defense, or dual‑use technology sectors
  • Experience working with or within institutions such as DLR, MOD, Bundestag committees, EU defense bodies, or national innovation agencies
  • Prior roles in business development, defense industrial policy, or public‑sector consulting
  • Experience working in Munich’s government, defense, or technology ecosystem
  • Familiarity with NATO, EU defense initiatives, and cross‑border industrial‑cooperation frameworks

By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our: Data Privacy Policy.

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of partnerships and enterprise growth experience along with a track record of driving growth for health tech products in new markets.

The ideal candidate has both a deep health industry experience and leadership experience in establishing new partnerships and growing accounts/markets over time. Given Oura’s more recent international expansion, no job is too big or too small. Scaling global and local Health partners in UK, European, MENA and APAC markets  is an essential frontier for Oura's future strategy.

This is a highly cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of product, partnerships, marketing, and sales. The ideal candidate brings a track record of international commercial leadership in healthcare or digital health, deep understanding of the international health landscape across different markets of UK, Europe, MENA, APAC, and a passion for building solutions that meet the unique needs of customers across all markets and stages of life.

What you will do

Consumer & Enterprise Business Development

  • Build and manage a qualified pipeline of long-term prospects across different health categories including cardiohealth, metabolic health, women’s health, wellness, mental health, and chronic condition management 
  • Represent the brand in high-level partner engagements, acting as a subject matter expert on digital health, general health and insurance models 

Partner Program Development & Management

  • Design and lead customized, strategic partnerships for larger and more complex partners (health systems, multinational employers, insurers, consumer platforms), ensuring tailored solutions that drive measurable business and health outcomes 
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with strategic partners, with the ability to serve 10-20 simultaneous accounts with varying needs.
  • Establish partner enablement tools, resources, and communications to ensure partner success and scalable growth 

Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams (Product, Marketing, Clinical, Regulatory affairs, Legal, Operations) to design, launch, and optimize partnership integrations and programs. Ensure alignment of goals, accountability, and execution across scaled programs and complex deals  

Performance, Optimization & Insights

  • Define, track, and optimize success metrics for both scaled partner programs and bespoke enterprise deals; identify and address challenges in internal processes that may slow innovation in partnerships 
  • Champion a culture of experimentation by testing new partnership models, incentive structures, and go-to-market approaches for health programs

Strategic Communication & Reporting

  • Leverage user research, behavioral data, and partner feedback to guide health partnership strategy 
  • Regularly communicate partnership program performance, enterprise deal progress, and overall health market traction to executive leadership 

We would love to have you on our team if you have:

  • Experience designing and scaling structured partner programs alongside bespoke, high-value enterprise deals — balancing repeatable growth with the customisation complex partners require.
  • Experience using performance, partner adoption, and consumer engagement data to build partnership models that expand reach, engagement, and retention.
  • A cross-functional operator who aligns product, clinical, operations, and marketing to deliver measurable health and business outcomes.
  • An entrepreneurial, commercially minded builder: sharp written and verbal communicator, comfortable bringing clarity to ambiguity in a fast-paced environment, and relentless about the quality and measurability of your work.

Considered a strong asset: additional language skills, an established network in your market, and willingness to travel up to 50%.

title: Director, Technical Product Marketing
descriptionHtml:
• Radiant builds and operates AI-native cloud platforms for high-performance GPU workloads.

  • Our infrastructure brings together data centres, compute, networking, storage and software for customers with demanding AI requirements.

  • As we grow internationally, we are establishing Global Capability Centres (GCCs) in several regions to provide specialist capability and operational support to teams across Radiant.

About the Role

Radiant is looking for a Director of Technical Product Marketing with deep, hands-on knowledge of AI infrastructure, GPU compute and datacenters to turn our technical advantages into clear, credible, market-facing narratives.

The role in brief

  • An embedded role, close to the product, close to engineering, and close to what we are building: end-to-end datacenters purpose-built for large-scale GPU compute and AI model training and inference.

  • You will spend time with infrastructure, datacenter design and operations, product, engineering, solutions, partnerships and the leadership team.

  • You will extract the technical truth from the building (power and cooling design, GPU cluster architecture, networking fabric, how customers train and serve models) and identify what is differentiated.

  • You will turn that into blogs, web pages, whitepapers, case studies, executive thought leadership, speaking narratives and product storytelling.

What this role is not

  • Not a conventional PMM role centred only on launch checklists, personas and sales decks. Our audience is hyperfocused and well understood.

  • Not a technical writing role.

The right person

  • Technically curious, commercially sharp, and an exceptional writer.

  • Deeply technical in data centers / AI factories and AI infrastructure.

  • Understands GPU and accelerator architectures, how frontier models are trained and served, and what those workloads demand of power, cooling, networking and physical design.

  • Knows how to sit with engineers, ask good questions, pressure-test claims, and translate complex infrastructure into language that is accurate, compelling and useful.

What You'll Do

Technical Product Narrative

  • Own Radiant's technical product narrative across our GPU platform, infrastructure, datacenter footprint and market-facing offerings.

  • Work with product and engineering to understand what we build, how it works, what problems it solves and why it is different, from site, power and thermal design through to GPU cluster performance and model workload efficiency.

  • Translate that into positioning, messaging, product explanations and technical narratives for customers, partners, analysts, executives and the broader market.

  • The questions you'll be asking:

    • Why did we build this this way?

    • What breaks at scale: power density, liquid cooling, GPU interconnect, cluster utilisation?

    • What tradeoff did we avoid?

    • What is genuinely differentiated, and what is defensible?

    • What should a technical buyer, such as a model builder or hyperscaler infrastructure lead, care about?

Technical Content & Thought Leadership

  • Create the core technical content that gives hyperscaler and AI lab customers confidence that Radiant is who they should trust to run their most demanding GPU workloads.

  • Formats include:

    • Technical blog posts, product pages and solution pages

    • Whitepapers and reference architecture content (GPU cluster design, high-density rack deployments, liquid cooling, power architecture)

    • Case studies and customer stories

    • Launch narratives and technical explainers

    • Executive essays and long-form thought leadership

  • Make complex topics understandable without making them simplistic.

  • Write for technical buyers, ML and infrastructure engineers, datacenter engineers, business decision-makers, partners, investors and industry observers, adjusting the level of detail without losing credibility.

Web & Product Copy

  • Help shape the language on Radiant's website and product pages.

  • Turn internal product reality into strong external copy that covers:

    • What the product does and who it is for

    • Why it matters and how it is different

    • The proof points that support the claim (GPU performance, power efficiency, capacity, deployment speed)

  • Work with design, web, product and marketing teams to create pages that are clear, technically grounded and commercially useful.

Speaking & Executive Substance

  • Create the technical spine behind talks, panels, submissions, keynotes, podcasts, executive posts and strategic narratives across the AI and datacenter industry calendar.

  • The social and communications team may own the opportunity pipeline and distribution cadence. You provide the substance: the thesis, the architecture, the proof points, the technical argument, the story arc and the language.

  • Ghostwrite for corporate and executive voices where content needs technical depth, product understanding or strategic market framing, on topics such as GPU generations, AI compute supply, power availability and model scaling.

  • Be public-facing yourself: an excellent communicator with a credible presence in the datacenter and AI infrastructure community, able to hold your own on stage and in a room of engineers and AI researchers.

Case Studies, Customer Stories & Proof Points

  • Build Radiant's library of customer, partner and product proof.

  • Work with sales, solutions, customer teams, GPU and hardware partners, and leadership to identify strong stories.

  • Turn them into case studies, web copy, blogs, presentations and sales-supporting narratives.

  • Find the real story behind each account:

    • What problem existed

    • What was deployed (compute, cooling, power, network)

    • What changed for the customer's models and workloads

    • What was hard, what mattered, and what the market should learn from it

Internal Translation

  • Act as a bridge between engineering, datacenter operations, product, sales, marketing and leadership.

  • Engineers should trust you because you ask good questions and represent the technology accurately, down to the GPU, the rack and the megawatt.

  • Marketing should trust you because you can turn complex ideas into clear, compelling language.

  • Sales should trust you because your work helps customers understand why Radiant matters.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days

  • Strong working relationships built with product and engineering.

  • A clear understanding of Radiant's technical architecture, GPU platform, datacenter design and product priorities.

  • A meaningful set of market-facing assets shipped.

  • A repeatable process for extracting technical stories from the organisation and turning them into blogs, web copy, technical narratives, executive content, speaking inputs and longer-form assets.

Over time

  • Radiant has a deeper, sharper, more technically credible voice and is recognised as a leading voice in AI infrastructure and datacenters.

  • The website explains the product more clearly.

  • Our blogs are technical, differentiated, and read by the people who build and run AI at scale.

Who You Are

Experience and technical depth

  • 8–12+ years in technical product marketing, product marketing, technical content, developer marketing, infrastructure marketing, solutions marketing or a closely related role, with a substantial part of that in AI infrastructure, GPU compute or datacenters.

  • A background in cloud infrastructure, AI infrastructure, data infrastructure, datacenters or high-performance computing.

  • Deep technical AI experience (essential): you understand how GPUs and accelerators work, how models are trained and served, and how those workloads drive compute, networking, power and cooling design. A technical degree is preferred.

  • You know datacenters from the inside: power density, liquid and air cooling, electrical and mechanical design, capacity planning and build-out, with a visible presence or network in the datacenter community.

  • Technically fluent enough to work directly with product managers, engineers, architects, ML practitioners, datacenter engineers and technical executives. You don't need to be an engineer, but you understand complex systems, from GPU interconnects and cluster topology to the power and thermal envelope of a hall.

  • You keep up with the market: GPU roadmaps, model releases and datacenter developments, and you can explain what each new generation means for infrastructure.

Writing and judgment

  • An excellent writer who can produce product pages, blogs, whitepapers, case studies, executive essays, launch narratives and technical explainers on GPU infrastructure, AI models and datacenter design with minimal handholding.

  • Strong product judgment: you can distinguish a feature from a benefit, a claim from a proof point, a capability from a differentiated position, and a generic AI market trend from a useful point of view.

  • Strong editorial taste: you know when copy is too generic, too inflated, too shallow or too complicated, and can make technical content sharper without making it flashy or imprecise.

Ways of working

  • Comfortable working in the building: regular face time with product, engineering and leadership is part of the job, as is time on site in our datacenters.

  • Highly autonomous: you don't wait for perfect briefs. You find the right people, ask the right questions, create the draft, pressure-test the claims and move the work forward.

  • Commercially aware: you understand that technical marketing exists to help the market understand the company, help customers evaluate the product, help sales tell the story, help executives communicate clearly, and help the company build credibility in a highly competitive AI infrastructure market.

Ideal Background

  • Where you've worked: high-growth B2B technology companies, AI infrastructure companies, GPU cloud / neocloud providers, hyperscale and colocation datacenter operators, AI model companies, cloud platforms, data infrastructure companies, telecom infrastructure businesses, semiconductor ecosystems (particularly GPU and accelerator vendors), or technical agencies with deep infrastructure experience.

  • Strongly preferred: experience working with engineers, architects, ML researchers, datacenter design teams, product leaders, founders or technical executives.

  • Required: experience writing about complex technical topics for external audiences, specifically on GPU compute, AI models and datacenter infrastructure.

  • Strong advantage: a track record of speaking, publishing or being visibly active in the AI infrastructure or datacenter community.

To ensure our recruitment processes provide an equal opportunity for all applicants to succeed, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments that we can make.

title: Doctorant : “Experimental Geomechanics for Induced Seismicity and Control”
descriptionHtml:
Contexte :

ENSTA est un établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées. L’école a pour mission la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, dont les ingénieurs de l'armement et les ingénieurs des études et techniques de l'armement, ainsi que des cadres et docteurs hautement qualifiés pour les secteurs public et privé, en particulier dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et des technologies de pointe.

ENSTA accompagne par sa recherche, son innovation et son offre de formation la transformation des grands secteurs stratégiques nationaux répondant ainsi aux enjeux de souveraineté nationale. Elle dispose de 3 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR) organisées autour de 9 laboratoires de recherche (UER) qui mènent une recherche appliquée en relation étroite avec l’industrie.

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID)). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.

Sujet : “Experimental Geomechanics for Induced Seismicity and Control”

Le poste fait partie du projet ERC-CdG « Preventing human-induced seismicity to fight climate change » (INJECT), financé par le Conseil européen de la recherche (ERC). La recherche sera menée à l'ENSTA, Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Le poste offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet de recherche stimulant et à fort impact. Les connaissances, l'innovation et les compétences développées dans le cadre de ce poste offriront d'excellentes perspectives d'évolution de carrière tant dans l'industrie que dans le monde universitaire.

Le changement climatique constitue une menace imminente pour notre civilisation. Les nouvelles technologies les plus en vue pour lutter contre le changement climatique font appel aux ressources énergétiques renouvelables et durables du sous-sol de la Terre et au stockage souterrain. Cependant, toutes ces technologies dépendent de l'injection de fluides dans la croûte terrestre, ce qui peut provoquer d'importants tremblements de terre. INJECT résoudra ce problème en s'appuyant sur une nouvelle méthode scientifique révolutionnaire qui empêchera la sismicité induite par l'homme et maximisera la production et le stockage d'énergie à partir de ressources naturelles renouvelables et durables.

La méthodologie interdisciplinaire d'INJECT repose sur un programme scientifique astucieux qui place la théorie du contrôle et les mathématiques au cœur de ce nouveau défi. Sur la base de développements théoriques de pointe, des contrôleurs et des observateurs robustes seront conçus pour ajuster de manière optimale les taux d'injection de fluides, prévenir les événements sismiques induits sur de vastes régions et optimiser la production et le stockage d'énergie. Les méthodes théoriques innovantes d'INJECT seront testées en profondeur à l'aide de modèles numériques de haute fidélité qui tiendront compte de la dynamique poro-élasto, du frottement de Coulomb, de la multiphysique et de la modélisation d'ordre réduit. Le plan expérimental s'appuiera sur des démonstrateurs et des essais hybrides laboratoire-ordinateur pour tester la théorie. Pour plus d'informations : https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101087771 ----- class="Default" style="text-align:justify;">Missions / Activités principales :

Le thème de recherche se concentre sur le développement d'un dispositif innovant conçu pour reproduire et contrôler la sismicité induite dans un cadre de laboratoire.

En tant que chercheur doctorant, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la conception et la construction de démonstrateurs innovants adaptés à la méthodologie d'INJECT. Cette opportunité englobe l'ensemble de la chaîne de développement, c'est-à-dire de la conceptualisation des idées à l'assemblage et au test rigoureux de prototypes de laboratoire avancés pour des expériences géomécaniques. Vous intégrerez la conception mécanique, l'ingénierie des matériaux, la mise en œuvre des capteurs et des contrôleurs, l'analyse des données et la modélisation numérique. L'objectif ultime est de reproduire et de contrôler les instabilités sismiques causées par des injections de fluides dans un environnement de laboratoire contrôlé, ouvrant ainsi la voie à des applications dans le monde réel.

Missions / Activité annexe :

· Contribuer à toute activité du service en fonction des priorités retenues.

· Contribuer à la démarche Qualité, notamment via la rédaction et la mise à jour des procédures, le renseignement et le suivi des indicateurs

· Contribuer à la démarche RSE de l’Ecole dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités

Durée d’affectation souhaitée : CDD de 3 ans

Date de prise de fonctions prévue : dès que possible

Lieu de travail :

ENSTA Campus Paris-Saclay, 828 boulevard des Maréchaux 91762 Palaiseau – Cedex

Le site est accessible en voiture (parking pour le personnel) mais également par les transports en commun

Poste à temps complet (25 jours de congés annuels, 18 RTT annuels)

Avantages :

  • Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %)

  • Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an)

  • Possibilité de télétravail (après accord du manager et dépôt d’une demande)

  • Subvention employeur au restaurant administratif et/ou à la cafétéria de l’établissement

  • Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion, centre de loisirs pour les enfants du personnel à partir de 6 ans avec tarifs préférentiels (campus Paris-Saclay)

  • Mutuelle (participation à hauteur de 50% de l’établissement)

Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif :

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux candidats en situation de handicap.

ENSTA s’engage à un recrutement favorisant l’égalité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement.

Candidature complète : curriculum vitae, lettre de motivation et coordonnées de 2 professeurs de référence


Les candidats retenus doivent posséder de solides compétences scientifiques et être très motivés. La maîtrise de l'anglais parlé et écrit est obligatoire.

Les candidats effectueront des recherches, développeront des dispositifs et des outils expérimentaux et rédigeront des articles scientifiques en étroite collaboration avec le PI du projet, Pr. Ioannis Stefanou, et les membres du groupe INJECT.

Connaissances :

· Une expérience dans le domaine des essais expérimentaux et de la conception (par exemple en géotechnique/géophysique/géomécanique) ou un diplôme de fin d'études dans ce domaine.

· Intérêt pour la modélisation numérique, la conception mécanique et l'électronique.

· Sens de l'organisation et rigueur.

· Utilisation de logiciels de design industriel.

· Compétences en Python.

· Expérience en laboratoire et esprit d'équipe.

. Connaissances en physique/mathématiques/mécanique

    Zwitserland biedt en bespreek je uitgebreid hun wensen en verwachtingen.

  • Samen met het team selecteer je de best passende opdrachtgevers bij je
    kandidaten en je stelt deze voor.

  • Regelmatig heb je contact met je opdrachtgevers om op de hoogte te blijven
    van hun wensen en behoeften.

  • Je bouwt een band op met de kandidaten door ze zorgvuldig te begeleiden in
    het emigratieproces.

  • Je denkt mee over de marketing en werving van zorgprofessionals zoals
    fysiotherapeuten, ergotherapeuten en verpleegkundigen.

  • Je schrijft vacatureteksten

  • Je bezoekt circa een keer per jaar zorginstellingen in Zwitserland om bestaande relaties te
    onderhouden.

Vereisten

Jij brengt mee:

  • Geen ervaring nodig, je wordt goed ingewerkt. Fouten maken mag!

  • Actieve werkhouding, je pakt makkelijk de telefoon.

  • Gezelligheid: interesse in collega's, klanten en kandidaten.

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau. Pré: ervaring met fysiotherapie.

  • Woonachtig in Groningen of omgeving.

  • Vloeiende beheersing van de Duitse taal (B2/C1 niveau).

  • Goede kennis van Engels en redelijke kennis van Nederlands, extra talen zijn
    mooi meegenomen.

  • Pré: werkervaring in de zorg.

Benefits

Wat bieden wij?

  • Actief en gezellig team met een moderne werkomgeving.

  • Flexibele werktijden, deels thuiswerken mogelijk.

  • Gezellige teamuitjes en trips naar Zwitserland.

  • Werklaptop, telefoon en een goed gevulde koelkast.

  • Goed salaris.

  • Een baan voor langere tijd.

Interesse?

Extra info over PhysioMatch:

PhysioMatch is gespecialiseerd in het bemiddelen van zorgprofessionals, zoals
fysiotherapeuten, ergotherapeuten en verpleegkundigen, voor diverse instellingen
in Zwitserland. We zorgen voor de ideale match tussen professionals en
zorginstellingen, waarbij we de nadruk leggen op persoonlijke
begeleiding.

Een voorbeeld van een dag bij PhysioMatch:

Elke dag is anders bij PhysioMatch, maar er is altijd een goede mix van
focus, teamwork, en zelfstandigheid.

08:30 - Begin van de werkdag
Je pakt een bak heet water met een smaakje en checkt je e-mails en agenda ter voorbereiding op de dagstart.

09:00 - Dagstart
Het team komt samen voor de dagelijkse meeting. Eerst kletsen we uitgebreid bij en dan worden de prioriteiten van de dag besproken en de sollicitanten verdeeld.

09:30 - Vacatureteksten en werving
Na de meeting ga je
aan de slag met het schrijven en plaatsen van vacatures in het Duits, Engels en
Nederlands.

11:00 - Sollicitatiegesprek
Je voert een online
sollicitatiegesprek met een therapeut die geïnteresseerd is in een functie in
Zwitserland. Je bespreekt de wensen en geeft info over het proces.

12:00 - Lunchpauze
Tijd om te ontspannen en samen met
collega's te lunchen. Na de lunch maken we een wandeling, wat zorgt voor een
frisse start van de middag.

13:00 - Administratie en opvolging
Je werkt de
administratie bij, volgt sollicitaties op en neemt contact op met kandidaten en
zorginstellingen. Je plant sollicitatiegesprekken in voor de komende dagen.

14:30 - Bezoek voorbereiding
Samen met het team bespreek
je de aankomende trip naar Zwitserland om zorginstellingen te bezoeken. We
bespreken de planning en welke locaties we bezoeken.

16:00 - Evaluatie en afronding
Aan het einde van de dag
werk je nog een paar actiepunten af, stuur je e-mails en noteer je taken voor de
volgende dag. Je sluit de dag af met een korte informele uitwisseling met
collega's.

title: E-commerce Data Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.

Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

E-commerce Data Analyst

Location: Weybridge, Surrey, United Kingdom

Established in 2004, Inside Ideas Group is a rapidly growing global agency network that helps clients drive their businesses forward from the inside. We partner with over 300 clients in more than 40 countries, delivering ideas, technology and creativity that make a measurable impact. 

As part of The Brandtech Group, we are pioneers in using advanced AI technologies to transform the way we create, optimise and deliver work. Our AI capabilities enhance efficiency, support smart decision making and unlock new levels of creativity for our teams and clients. 

We are now looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our onsite team supporting in London. 

About the Role 

As the E-commerce Data Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering insight that drives improvements across the full commercial ecosystem spanning customer experience on, retailer investment effectiveness, marketing and sales performance, and the broader post-purchase, onboarding and promotional landscape. 

A core part of your remit will be the design, build and ongoing management of a marketing and sales performance dashboard, underpinned by Google BigQuery and delivered in Looker Studio. This will serve as a critical decision-making tool for marketing, e-commerce, retail and CX teams surfacing insight such as campaign uplift, halo effects, retailer investment impact and share performance across products and markets. 

Alongside this, you will analyse customer journeys, benchmark competitors, oversee content performance and support the planning and execution of onboarding and e-commerce promotions using platforms like GWI to create digital personas and audience profiles. 

You will collaborate closely with CX, marketing, product and e-commerce teams as well as HQ and local market stakeholders to ensure insight informs decisions at every stage. 

This role requires strong analytical capability, expertise in data modelling and SQL, and the ability to translate complex commercial questions into dashboard logic and actionable recommendations. 

What You Will Be Doing 

Marketing & Sales Performance Analytics  

  • Design, build and maintain a marketing and sales performance dashboard in Looker Studio, underpinned by BigQuery, combining sell-out sales data, market volume and share data, and campaign activity logs. 
  • Define the underlying data model, transform source files and design the reporting layer to support consistent, scalable KPI delivery. 
  • Identify and quantify the impact of retailer investment, including uplift in sales and market share during campaign periods. 
  • Analyse correlations between campaign activity and commercial performance to determine which marketing levers are most effective. 
  • Measure and report on halo effects across products and retailers resulting from promotional and campaign activity. 
  • Define and calculate key performance metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Work with GFK or other syndicated market data sources to enrich performance analysis with market volume and share context. 

Customer Experience & Digital Analytics 

  • Conduct analysis of the current customer experience, including user behaviour, content and campaign performance and conversion pathways. 
  • Benchmark key customer journeys against competitor websites to identify gaps and opportunities. 
  • Provide regular insight into paid promotions, post-purchase experience and customer satisfaction trends. 
  • Support planning, optimisation and operational management of post-purchase and onboarding experience. 
  • Analyse content utilisation, engagement and drop-off points, and recommend enhancements. 
  • Collaborate with HQ and local teams on onboarding content production and implementation. 
  • Support feature management including evaluation, testing performance and monitoring adoption, with ongoing analysis of content effectiveness and customer experience updates. 
  • Reporting, Dashboards & Stakeholder Insight 
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports and ad hoc analyses across customer experience, onboarding, e-commerce, retail performance and promotion activity. 
  • Translate data into clear insights that guide decision-making within marketing, CX, digital and commercial teams. 
  • Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring insight is embedded in planning and operational processes. 
  • Use platforms like GWI to build digital personas and audience profiles that support broader marketing planning. 

What You Need to Be Great in This Role 

Essential 

  • Proven experience as a data or insight analyst within digital, e-commerce, retail, marketing or agency environments. 
  • Strong proficiency in Google BigQuery and advanced SQL, including data modelling and reporting layer design. 
  • Hands-on experience building dashboards in Looker Studio, with a clear understanding of how to structure underlying data models for robust, scalable dashboard performance. 
  • Demonstrable experience combining sell-out sales, market share and campaign activity datasets to generate commercial insight. 
  • Ability to define and calculate metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Strong marketing analytics capability, including campaign effectiveness measurement across paid and promotional channels. 
  • Good understanding of digital customer journeys, content performance metrics and e-commerce KPIs. 
  • Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics GA4, Adobe Analytics or similar. 
  • Excellent communication and storytelling ability — capable of translating complex business questions into dashboard logic and presenting findings clearly to non-technical audiences. 
  • Experience working with multi-market teams and managing stakeholder expectations across business functions. 
  • A passion for data-driven decision-making and an interest in how AI can enhance analytics workflows. 

Preferred: 

  • Proficiency in Python (pandas) for data transformation, automation and workflow scripting. 
  • Broader experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including automating data ingestion and transformation workflows. 
  • Experience working in retail, e-commerce or retailer media environments. 
  • Familiarity with GfK or other syndicated market data sources. 
  • Experience with additional BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

title: EMEA Statutory Reporting Senior Manager
descriptionHtml:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

Applied Intuition is scaling quickly across entities and geographies, and statutory reporting, clean audits, and compliant local filings are essential. In this London-based role, you will be the accountable owner of statutory reporting, audit, and compliance for our EMEA entities, including the UK, Germany, Sweden, and Saudi Arabia, with more to come.

Reporting to the Director of Accounting, you will lead the EMEA local close and statutory audits, own the filing calendar, oversee the US GAAP to local GAAP conversion work produced by our India-based outsourced accounting team, and partner with Tax, Legal, and Business Technology to automate statutory and compliance processes in NetSuite. This is a hands-on opportunity to build a best-in-class statutory and compliance function across EMEA for a high-growth company.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Own the preparation, review, and sign-off of statutory financial statements for our EMEA entities under local GAAP (UK GAAP/FRS 102, German HGB, Swedish K2/K3, and IFRS as endorsed in Saudi Arabia), including the US GAAP to local GAAP conversion and bridge work papers.

  • Lead each statutory audit end to end with our external auditors, from planning and PBC lists through audit queries, adjustments, and management representation letters, closing audits on schedule.

  • Run the EMEA month-end on the US close calendar: review and sign off statutory balance sheet reconciliations, drive aged reconciling items to zero, and maintain local GAAP schedules such as leases and accrued vacation.

  • Own the EMEA statutory and compliance filing calendar, covering VAT, corporate income tax and zakat (with Tax and external advisers), company registry filings, and annual accounts, so every filing goes in on time with no notices from authorities.

  • Manage the quality and performance of our India-based outsourced accounting team and of in-country auditors, tax advisers, and accounting providers, and turn statutory and conversion workpapers into standard templates the team can run with minimal rework.

  • Partner with Business Technology to automate statutory reporting, VAT, and e-invoicing in NetSuite, design and document the related controls, and bring new entities and regulatory changes (for example, FRS 102 amendments and German and Saudi e-invoicing mandates) into the process ahead of effective dates.

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or CPA) with 14+ years of relevant accounting experience

  • Proven ownership of multi-entity UK statutory reporting under UK GAAP (FRS 102) and the Companies Act 2006, including leading statutory audits end to end

  • Experience converting US GAAP to local GAAP and reviewing GAAP bridge workpapers (for example, leases and accrued vacation)

  • Experience managing outsourced or offshore accounting teams, including setting quality standards and reviewing output across time zones

  • Proficiency with NetSuite, ideally in a multi-subsidiary environment

  • Sound judgment on materiality and filing risk, and clear communication with auditors, advisers, and partners across EMEA, the US, and India

Nice to have:

  • Big 4 or top-tier public accounting background, and in-house experience at a software/technology multinational

  • Hands-on German GAAP (HGB) and GmbH statutory experience

  • Exposure to Swedish (K2/K3) or Saudi (IFRS, zakat, ZATCA e-invoicing) statutory reporting, or other EMEA local GAAPs and languages

  • Working knowledge of VAT, Making Tax Digital, and e-invoicing requirements across EMEA

  • Experience designing internal controls (SOX or audit readiness) and testing finance system automation, including applying AI tools to accounting workflows

Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

Applied Intuition pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum intended target base salary for new hire salaries for the position. The actual base salary offered to a successful candidate will additionally be influenced by a variety of factors including experience, credentials & certifications, educational attainment, skill level requirements, interview performance, and the level and scope of the position.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Enterprise AI Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
About Legal 500

Legal 500 is a global legal market research, data and intelligence business. Our research helps corporate clients make informed decisions about legal representation and gives law firms insight into their market position, performance, and clients.

Beyond research, we’re building a growing data, benchmarking, market-intelligence and subscription service offering. And through Legal Business, our journalistic title, we deliver independent news, analysis and commentary on the business of law and the strategy, performance and leadership of the world’s leading law firms.

We are a growing, multi-site organisation, with colleagues working across research, data, technology, product, journalism, commercial and events in London, Leeds and Bristol.

About the Role

Our new Enterprise AI Product Owner will own the adoption and value of AI in how Legal 500 works. You'll use our enterprise AI tools, with Microsoft Copilot and the wider Microsoft 365 AI capability as the main platform. You'll recommend what should be built or adopted and why, put governance in place where none yet exists, and make sure people across the business use the tools well.

This is a business-facing product role that starts from how the business works, not a technical build role. Copilot is the primary tool of choice, but you'll also oversee the other AI tools the business adopts.

What you'll do

You'll sit centrally within our People & Business Operations function, reporting to the Director of People & Business Operations. Your remit covers the whole of Legal 500, not a single department. You'll:

  • Own the roadmap and prioritised backlog for our enterprise AI opportunities, recommending what to build or adopt, what not to, and why. You'll write clear user stories and acceptance criteria and hold a consistent line with senior stakeholders when demand exceeds capacity.

  • Start every opportunity from the end-to-end business process. You'll walk business owners through how work gets done today, often where no SOPs exist, map the pain points, coach them through mapping a future-state process, and find where Copilot, other AI tools or workflow changes will make a measurable difference.

  • Personally configure, test and refine Copilot skills, agents and team workflows. You'll take ideas through proof of concept and pilot, then hand ownership of the output to the business owner.

  • Design, implement and enforce AI governance from the ground up. This includes owning the intake and review process for new use cases, agents and workflows, working alongside our Data Protection Officer, Information Security and IT Operations

  • Own our enterprise AI libraries: the register of approved tools and the libraries of approved agents, prompts, templates and shared workflows. You'll keep them curated, current and compliant, and avoid duplication between tools.

  • Design and deliver upskilling yourself, including training sessions, guides, clinics and self-serve resources. You'll also lead AI working groups and champion networks.

  • Spot common patterns across teams and bring them together on shared processes and solutions, so the same problem isn't solved many times.

  • Define and track adoption and value, such as usage, time saved, quality and user confidence. You'll maintain an AI benefits register, report progress to senior stakeholders and feed role impact into workforce planning.

What we're looking for

Essential

  • A process-led consulting approach, with a structured way of walking business owners through end-to-end processes, including where no SOPs existed

  • Proven experience of setting up AI governance from scratch and enforcing it. This includes owning an intake and review process and working with specialists such as a Data Protection Officer and IT Operations

  • Hands-on Microsoft Copilot experience: you've personally configured Copilot skills, agents or team workflows. Using Copilot, or overseeing someone else configuring it, isn't enough

  • Strong product management skills: setting priorities, writing user stories, running a backlog and managing senior stakeholders well

  • Experience of owning enterprise libraries or other centralised controls

  • Experience of running enablement yourself: you've designed and delivered upskilling personally, without relying on an L&D team, and you're comfortable leading working groups

Desirable

  • A genuine interest in enterprise efficiency and how people actually work, with a track record of bringing teams together on shared ways of working

  • A background in internal transformation, process improvement or Microsoft 365/Copilot SME roles, ideally including evaluating, onboarding or governing other enterprise AI tools

  • An understanding of professional services, publishing, legal markets or other knowledge-intensive environments

What this role isn't

  • It isn't about owning AI models in production, and working with development teams isn't the main job. There will be occasional technical work, but if you're mainly motivated by software delivery, this probably isn't the role for you

  • It isn't about running governance within someone else's framework, or handing enablement off to an L&D team. We need someone who has set these up and delivered them personally

Role information:

  • Hybrid workplace - 3 days a week in office, 2 days remote

  • This role can be based in either London or Leeds

  • Occasional travel to the other offices may be required (Bristol, London and Leeds)

title: Erfahrener SAP Personalberater / Headhunter - Schwerpunkt Kandidatengewinnung
descriptionHtml:
Die besten SAP-Spezialisten der Schweiz suchen keinen Job, sie wollen angesprochen werden. Für das «Who is Who» der Schweizer Wirtschaft finden, überzeugen und begleiten wir genau diese Menschen. VANGARD ist eine auf SAP spezialisierte Headhunting-Boutique mit dem Anspruch: Headhunting. Nicht Recruiting.

Warum VANGARD, gerade jetzt

Der Markt für Personaldienstleister ist unter Druck, viele Agenturen kämpfen. Wir stehen auf einem soliden Fundament: Seit 2012 sind wir im Schweizer SAP-Markt aktiv, haben bei über 400 SAP-Arbeitgebern platziert und sind in der SAP-Community bestens etabliert. Jährlich veröffentlichen wir das White Paper «SAP-Arbeitsmarkt Schweiz», mit Interviews von Branchenführern aus SAP-Beratung und Inhouse-Organisationen. Und dank unseres eigenen CRM-Systems vermessen und mappen wir den Schweizer SAP-Markt systematisch, wie kaum jemand sonst.

Für dich heisst das: Du musst nicht jeden Monat bei null anfangen.

Deine Rolle

Du spürst Top-SAP-Spezialisten auf, für die sonst niemand einen Zugang findet. Du gewinnst ihr Vertrauen, verstehst ihre Ziele und begleitest sie bis zur Vertragsunterschrift und darüber hinaus. Unser Kandidatenpool mit tausenden Profilen, unsere gewachsenen Beziehungen und unser erprobtes Headhunting-Konzept geben dir vom ersten Tag an Rückenwind.

Deine Aufgaben

Kandidatengewinnung

  • Systematisches Mapping des SAP-Markts: Wer arbeitet wo, in welchem Modul, mit welchem Erfahrungsprofil?

  • Gezielte Direktansprache passiver SAP-Spezialisten über Telefon, Netzwerk, Empfehlungen und LinkedIn

  • Aufspüren von Talenten, die auf keiner Jobbörse und oft nicht einmal auf LinkedIn sichtbar sind

  • Kontinuierliche Pflege und Reaktivierung unseres Kandidatenpools

  • Aufbau eines eigenen Netzwerks in der Schweizer SAP-Community, mit Empfehlungen als festem Bestandteil deiner Arbeit

Qualifizierung und Präsentation

  • Fundierte Interviews zur fachlichen und persönlichen Qualifizierung, von Modulwissen und Projekterfahrung bis zu Karrieremotivation und Wechselbereitschaft

  • Ehrliche Einschätzung, welche Position wirklich passt, statt Kandidaten in die erstbeste Stelle zu schieben

Betreuung durch den gesamten Prozess

  • Persönliche Begleitung jedes Kandidaten als feste Ansprechperson, vom ersten Gespräch bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

  • Individuelle Interviewvorbereitung, Gehaltsbenchmarks und ehrliches Feedback nach jedem Gespräch

  • Begleitung durch Debriefings, Gehalts- und Vertragsverhandlungen

  • Souveräner Umgang mit Gegenangeboten, Zweifeln und kritischen Momenten im Entscheidungsprozess

  • Nachbetreuung nach dem Start, damit Platzierungen langfristig tragen und aus Kandidaten Botschafter werden

Zusammenarbeit mit den Key Account Managern

  • Projektarbeit in enger Abstimmung mit unseren Key Account Managern

  • Bei Eignung Einbindung in die Kundengewinnung und -betreuung, etwa durch Teilnahme an Briefings und Kundenterminen

Was du mitbringst

  • Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der SAP- oder IT-Personalberatung, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Direktansprache

  • Einen nachweisbaren Track-Record im Gewinnen und Platzieren von Spezialisten, die nicht aktiv suchen

  • Gutes Verständnis der SAP-Welt: Du weisst, was einen FI/CO-Berater von einem EWM-Spezialisten unterscheidet

  • Die richtige Mischung aus Ausstrahlung und Hartnäckigkeit, am Telefon wie im persönlichen Gespräch

  • Eine Art, die Menschen öffnet: Kandidaten rufen dich zurück, weil sie gerne mit dir sprechen, und hören dir auch nach dem dritten Nein noch zu

  • Humor, Drive und die Gelassenheit, auch in hektischen Phasen den richtigen Ton zu treffen

  • Stilsicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch

Was wir dir bieten

  • Ein stabiles Umfeld in einer gefragten Nische, mit gefülltem Pool und etablierten Beziehungen statt Kaltstart

  • Erfahrene Mentoren mit über 10 Jahren SAP-Headhunting-Erfahrung, die dich mit viel Engagement, Know-how und Freude an deinem Erfolg unterstützen

  • Ein solides Fixum und ein variabler Anteil, der deutlich über dem der grossen Personaldienstleister liegt: Bei gleichem Erfolg verdienst du bei uns unter dem Strich mehr

  • Ein kleines, eingespieltes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und echtem Teamspirit

  • Ein super modernes Office in Zürich-Greencity mit neuester IT

Was du sonst noch wissen solltest

Bei uns ist jeder Tag anders, die Pace ist hoch, und Kandidaten wie Unternehmen erwarten eine Beratung auf höchstem Niveau. Dafür brauchst du Fokus, Engagement und Freude an Menschen. Unser Antrieb: SAP-Spezialisten in die Rolle zu bringen, in der sie wirklich wachsen, und dabei selbst jeden Tag besser zu werden.

Auf deine Kontaktaufnahme freuen wir uns.

descriptionHtml:

Job Title: Finance Analyst

Location: London Office in Chancery Lane

What You’ll be Doing

  • Running our month end close to deliver management accounts that senior stakeholders can act on with confidence

  • Building and maintaining our budgeting, forecasting and cash flow processes to inform and underpin company strategy

  • Analysis and interpretation of business costs and performance against plan, providing insight throughout the business

  • Owning the finance operations that keep the company moving day to day, from payroll through to payments

  • Taking end to end responsibility for our year end audit, statutory reporting and compliance calendar

  • Preparing analysis and materials for the board and our investors, with the opportunity to take ownership of the financial model over time

  • Scanning the horizon for bottlenecks in the finance function before they arrive, and targeting them with better process and automation

  • Designing and embedding the controls and routines a scaling business needs, so the function can grow without growing headcount

  • Managing the relationships with the external partners who support our finance function

What We’re Looking For

  • A strong command of the fundamentals: financial statements, reporting, and the accounting that sits behind the numbers

  • One to three years at a Big 4 or another leading mid-tier firm, or in a finance team in industry, part qualified ACA or ACCA

  • Ambitious, and looking to develop and progress quickly in a fast growing company

  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, with strong financial modelling ability and the capacity to turn financial data into clear, actionable insight

  • Commercially minded, and able to communicate complex financial movements clearly and concisely to people outside finance

  • An inquisitive approach to the day to day, with a desire to question and challenge the numbers and to understand the business behind them

  • Excellent analytical and problem solving ability, highly numerate, with a real drive for accuracy

  • A natural instinct to automate and improve rather than repeat

  • Comfortable operating in an ambiguous environment, managing changing and conflicting priorities

  • Strong organisational skills, with a proven record of meeting and beating deadlines

  • Experience of Xero or similar accounting software preferred; familiarity with data and reporting tools an advantage

  • Self motivated, able to work autonomously, and conscientious with it

✨ Our values

PUT INTEGRITY FIRST Honesty matters. Tell the truth, and be straight-up. Be transparent and do the right thing. This builds respect and reliability for our students, families and team members.

KNOW YOUR COORDINATES Understand where you are and where you want to get to. Know your strengths and acknowledge your gaps. Think from first principles. Question things, and never pretend to know what you don't.

RAISE THE BAR Own it and get it done. Do better. Iterate quickly and seek feedback. Deliver real value. Be excellent and lift others up. Share learnings and help your teammates improve.

LOVE TO BE WRONG Push boundaries. Be outside your comfort zone. Naturally you'll get some things wrong and that's okay. Embrace feedback. Learn from it and get closer to excellence.

WIN TOGETHER To achieve our mission, we have to work together. We all have a role to play, so help each other get there. We’re stronger as a team so inspire, support and respect each other.

🙋 Why you’ll love working here

We’re a team on a mission to transform education for the better. Joining MES means you’ll be part of something ambitious, fast-moving, and full of purpose. Here’s what you can expect:

  • The chance to make a real impact: your work directly shapes the future of education.

  • A fast-paced and high-growth environment where ideas move quickly and careers accelerate.

  • A collaborative, supportive culture: we’re head quartered in the UK, but we’re a global team with colleagues in 15+ countries, bringing a rich mix of perspectives and energy.

We are committed to building a diverse team and strongly encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and help us build a better product for students around the world.

descriptionHtml:

A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.

We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

 

Role Overview 📝

As the Fleet Associate - Admin, you are the backbone of our vehicle operations. Your primary mission is to ensure that our fleet is fully compliant, legally documented, and that all vehicle related costs are accurately tracked. You are a highly organised administrator who thrives on keeping records up to date and resolving issues from insurance claims to parking fines with speed and precision.

 

What you’ll be doing 🚀

  • Penalty Charge Notice (PCN) Management:

    Act as the primary lead for all incoming traffic fines and PCNs.

    • Identify the responsible driver for each contravention and raise the appropriate recoup charges in our internal systems.

    • Ensure all appeals or payments are actioned within the required legal timeframes to avoid late fees.

  • Insurance Claims Administration:

    • Coordinate the end-to-end administration for vehicle accidents and insurance claims.

    • Gather evidence, photos, and statements to submit to our insurers and follow up until each case is closed.

  • Vehicle Compliance & Documentation:

    • Maintain a "zero-error" digital archive for all vehicle documents, including V5Cs, MOTs, service records, insurance certificates and invoices.

    • Monitor expiration dates to ensure no vehicle is dispatched without valid tax, insurance, or safety certification.

  • Fleet Onboarding & Offboarding:

    • Manage the administrative workflow for bringing new vehicles into the fleet and removing decommissioned units.

    • Ensure all tracking hardware and vehicle specific documents are assigned or recovered correctly.

  • Communication & Inbox Management:

    • Oversee the fleet department’s central inbox, providing professional and timely responses to drivers, partners, and local authorities.

    • Act as the point of contact for external vendors regarding vehicle status and maintenance updates.

What we’re looking for 🔎

  • The Ultimate Organiser: You take pride in a clean inbox and a perfectly updated spreadsheet. You are someone who notices the smallest details that others might miss.

  • Effective Communicator: You can write clear, professional emails to local councils and handle firm but fair communication with drivers regarding fines or damages.

  • Resilient Administrator: You are comfortable managing a high volume of repetitive tasks and can stay focused on accuracy even during busy periods.

  • Tech-Literate: You are proficient with Google Sheets/Excel and are quick to learn new internal databases and fleet management software.

Our Values

  • 😊 We Are Kind - Kind to the planet, our team and our partners. We listen with purpose, leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - it requires us to be fair, consistent, honest, thoughtful and compassionate.

  • 💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started. We never fight the urge to be inquisitive, to understand the world around us and to explore where others might not.

  • 🌍 We Are Resourceful - Our planet's resources are scarce and our future depends on our ability to use them wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have.

How we reward our team 🎁

title: Flight Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

At The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx - a modular, reusable orbital vehicle for space missions to stations and beyond. Nyx is engineered with the capability to transport cargo and, in the future, humans.

We are seeking a highly motivated Flight Software Engineer to join our mission-driven team developing Nyx. In this role, you will take full ownership of key components of the flight software stack. You will be designing, implementing, and testing mission-critical systems that enable safe, autonomous, and reliable spaceflight operations.

You will work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where cross-functional integration is essential. Your code will interface directly with vehicle avionics, guidance systems, propulsion, communications, and ground control. Expect to write modern, high-reliability C++ and Python code, drive software simulations, and ensure flight readiness through rigorous testing at both unit and system levels.

The position level will be determined based on your experience, technical depth, and ability to take ownership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and own core flight software modules for spacecraft control, telemetry, data handling, fault management, and communications.

  • Develop in modern C++ and Python for support tooling, following best practices in software architecture, testing, and performance optimization.

  • Build and maintain test frameworks for automated unit, integration, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing to validate software behavior across mission phases.

  • Create and run high-fidelity simulations to model flight dynamics, subsystem interactions, and edge cases.

  • Collaborate closely with GNC, avionics, propulsion, and mission operations teams to ensure seamless integration and mission success.

  • Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and flight readiness assessments.

What we would love to see from you

  • Strong proficiency in modern C++ (C++17 or newer) and Python.

  • Experience with real-time systems, embedded development, or spacecraft software.

  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of complex technical problems and drive them to resolution.

  • Familiarity with software testing methodologies and simulation tools.

  • Excellent cross-disciplinary communication and collaboration skills.

  • Good understanding of math & physics.

  • Focus on detail, quality, and testing.

  • Experience with CI/CD systems and build systems.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of safety critical and real-time critical software and familiarity with RTOS.

  • Good understanding of communication protocols such as: TCP/IP, UART, CAN Bus and serialization.

  • Experience with automotive or flight software frameworks.

  • Background in orbital mechanics, spacecraft systems, or space mission lifecycle.

  • Experience with industry standards such as AUTOSAR, ECSS, DO-178.

 

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.
  • Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.
  • Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.
  • Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.
  • Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.
  • Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes.
  • Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field
  • Working proficiency in C/C++ and Python: you can read, debug and patch existing code and write small tools and scripts
  • Comfortable in Linux environments, including the command line, logs, Docker and basic networking (IP, TCP/UDP)
  • Hands-on hardware-software integration: system bring-up, wiring and connectors, and embedded interfaces (UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) at a practical level
  • Structured troubleshooting: you can isolate whether a problem is software, hardware, configuration or RF, often under time pressure in the field
  • Strong communicator: you can explain technical issues clearly to customers and operators, and report findings back to engineering in a way they can act on
  • Willing to travel and work on-site with customers, including at test ranges and in field environments
  • EU citizenship (required for security clearance and customer requirements)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, QGroundControl or mission planning tools
  • UAV flight testing and validation in operational environments
  • Experience with datalinks and radio systems
  • Previous customer-facing or field engineering role, especially with defense or government customers
  • German language skills

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Pension plan 
  • Extended social security package 
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

descriptionHtml:

Qualifications and Skills

title: Forward Software Engineer, Data
descriptionHtml:

Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About The Job


As a Forward Software Engineer, Data, you will build the systems behind some of the hardest problems Mistral takes on.

You join our team of engineers in Applied AI. We gravitate towards hard problems, decide how to solve them, and ship fast. You work closely with our customer-facing teams, and what works goes into production with our customers and across the company. When a project needs it, you work directly on customer engagements.

We're looking for a strong software engineer who builds end to end and has shipped ML or GenAI systems to production. You've felt the pain of models that pass every eval and fail on real data, and of quality that drifts after launch. You've also felt the data engineering pain: pipelines that break silently, schemas that change under you, and backfills that take a weekend. Data engineering is your edge. You turn messy, large-scale data into systems that hold up.

You think like a founder. You start from the customer's problem, not the technology. You measure success by the value you deliver, and you care about building experiences people love to use. You like working at the edge of what AI can do today, and you push past it.

Your scope is end to end, from first prototype to production. Your depth in data architecture helps set the standard for how the team designs and delivers systems. You know lakehouse and data mesh patterns well enough to know when they fit and when they're overkill. You've designed ontologies and data models, and you know that getting them right is as much art as science.

What you will do

  • Build AI systems end to end, from first prototype to production.

  • Design the data architecture underneath them: ingestion, processing, storage, and the data models and ontologies that make messy data usable.

  • Build distributed pipelines that process large volumes of documents, code, logs, and multimodal content for retrieval, agentic workflows, and fine-tuning.

  • Turn what works for one customer into patterns and platforms that work across many, without rebuilding each time.

  • Make systems hold up under real load: throughput, latency, cost, and failure recovery are part of the design from the start.

  • Build data governance into the systems themselves: ownership, access control, lineage, retention, and privacy for sensitive enterprise data.

  • Build the evaluation loop: labeling with LLMs and humans, versioned eval datasets, and checks that catch quality drift before customers do.

  • Set the standard for how the team designs and ships data systems.

  • Work with researchers, engineers, and customer-facing teams to turn hard problems into systems people rely on.

What We're Looking For

  • You have full ability to ship across the stack: proficient NodeJS e.g. NextJS/Express/Fastify or similar or Python e.g. FastAPI. You are confident with TypeScript + React/NextJS or similar. Solid beats polished.

  • You have 5+ years of experience building and running production data-intensive pipelines with distributed processing (for example Spark, Ray, Beam, or Dask) and orchestration tools (for example Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect) with structured and unstructured data.

  • You have experience with retrieval-augmented generation, agentic use cases, or LLM evaluation, and a clear view of how data quality drives model quality.

  • You work autonomously: you find the problem, decide the approach, and own the outcome.

  • You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, and are fluent in English.

  • You ship in increments, are obsessed with time to value and are comfortable making and articulating product-technical tradeoffs.

Ideally you have

  • A passion for graph-based systems (e.g. Neo4j) and ontology design

  • Hands-on experience building data pipelines for LLM training, fine-tuning, or evaluation, and contributions to open-source projects, particularly in data or LLMs.

  • Hands-on experience with data governance and privacy requirements (for example GDPR), secure data handling, CI/CD and infrastructure as code, or an affinity for security engineering.

How We Work in Applied AI

  • We care about people and outputs.

  • What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it

  • Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week.
