title: Founding Enterprise AE | France
descriptionHtml:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

Your mission

telli is arriving in France. We are building a small, mighty team in Paris to make every customer interaction worth having. We have a product already used by leading B2C businesses, but the French market is still at the beginning. We will earn our place, one customer at a time.

We are outbound first. As a founding Enterprise Account Executive, you will create opportunities, win major French accounts, and help define how telli sells in this market. You will carry a quota and own the hard parts of the deal, from the first cold conversation to signature. Your work will shape the playbook for the team that follows.

What you'll do

  • Build your own enterprise pipeline through thoughtful outbound, calls, referrals, and a deep understanding of French customer operations.

  • Lead complex sales cycles end to end: discovery, demos, business cases, executive alignment, security, legal, procurement, and negotiation.

  • Find the real problem behind a customer's interest in AI, quantify the value of solving it, and earn trust across the buying group.

  • Work closely with the France team, founders, product, and deployment colleagues to turn early customers into lasting successes.

  • Keep an honest forecast and turn wins, losses, and objections into a repeatable French sales motion.

What makes you a great fit

  • You have personally sourced and closed complex B2B enterprise deals, ideally in software or AI, and can show how you earned them.

  • You are comfortable speaking with senior business leaders and working through IT, security, finance, legal, and procurement.

  • You enjoy the unglamorous work as much as the big meeting: prospecting, follow-up, and fixing what is broken.

  • You bring a bias for action, aim for excellence, take ownership, and work with low ego. Read the telli principles

  • You communicate with confidence and care in French and can work effectively in English with our international team.

  • You are based in Paris and can spend two weeks in Berlin for onboarding. You are ready to travel and visit prospects across France when needed.

You may not be a good fit if

  • You don't believe voice is the future of how people and businesses talk to each other.

  • You expect a ready-made book of business or marketing to build your pipeline.

  • You want to join deals only after discovery, and avoid cold outreach or the hard follow-through between meetings.

  • You need a fixed playbook before acting or pass on ownership when a deal gets messy.

  • You dislike working across executive, operations, IT, legal, and procurement stakeholders or learning openly from losses.

The reality of the role

France is a new market for us. There is no mature local playbook or book of business waiting for you. Some deals will be messy, and you will need to create momentum yourself. If you want ownership, direct feedback, ambitious colleagues, and the chance to do the best work of your career, this is the opportunity.

The hiring process

The hiring process itself is a case study in how you sell. Approach it as you would a complex account: research us, form a point of view, earn attention, ask and listen, follow through, and respond to feedback. We will evaluate how you create momentum and manage the process end to end, with the judgment and ownership you would bring to winning enterprise customers in France.

Compensation

€120,000–€180,000 gross annual on-target earnings (OTE), with a 50% base salary and 50% variable compensation at target, plus equity. We will discuss the equity terms during the hiring process.

title: Founding LPA Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Applicants from the EU and non-EU are welcome to apply

▪ Industry: Deep-tech / Active Muon Imaging & Laser-Plasma Accelerators

▪ HQ & Locations: Hamburg (DE) – HQ; Tallinn (EE)

▪ Size: 1–10 employees

Company Mission

The company develops safe, rapid and accurate active muon imaging solutions for industrial quality assessment, security and customs inspection and medical diagnostics. Their platform combines laser-plasma-accelerator-driven muon sources, next-generation particle detectors and AI to enable high-resolution 3D imaging with automated decision-making. The company operates at DESY in Hamburg, Germany, and Tehnopol in Tallinn, Estonia. Their main development partners span the energy, defence, aerospace and security industries. Their initial technology and business focus is on the quality and safety assessment of critical metallic and ceramic components, such as rocket engines, gas turbines, jet engines, and large-scale nuclear or industrial systems.

Core Values

Skunkworks approach: They work in small teams with full ownership. They keep it simple, stupid. Move fast: a shiny prototype means they spent too long on it. They build to learn. They polish later. Disagree together, commit together: they debate and challenge, regardless of title. Then they deliver the decision as one team. They win as a team. They pivot as a team.

Courage: they always make the call. A mistake isn't a failure: it's proof they're improving. Either way, the own the outcome. Honesty and transparency: they share what's really happening, good or bad. That lets everyone make the right call. They stay open. They stay honest.

Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Assemble and lead the Muon Source team, covering LPA, converter, and optics; start hands-on, hire and structure the team as the work grows

  • Oversee the development of working points and a density-tailored plasma source that survives the thermal load of a 100 Hz, 100 TW focus—millions of consistent shots, not one good shot

  • Lead the development of the plasma source and execute experiments at user facilities to iterate the design toward powering the transportable muon source

  • Isolate the laser specs that matter most—pulse energy, duration, pointing and energy stability, beam quality—and ensure they get delivered

  • Own the vacuum system and the laser transport line, including vacuum chambers, differential pumping, vibration management and thermal management, turning the LPA into a machine that fits inside a shipping container and runs 24/7

  • Define the requirements for the control system, the machine protection system, and the diagnostics suite that let the machine run unattended

  • Manage the budget and make technical decisions within your area of responsibility

  • Participate in hiring processes to expand the Muon Source team as the scope grows

Requirements

  • Team leadership. You've built and led a technical team before. You're ready to be hands-on again before this one exists

  • Hands-on LPA experience. You've built and operated a laser-plasma accelerator. Not just modeled one. Injection, dephasing, depletion, and guiding physics you've tuned on real hardware

  • Experimental leadership at user facilities. You've planned and run a multi-year experimental campaign before. You know how to iterate a design from real beamtime data

  • High-power laser system literacy. You can write a spec a laser manufacturer can build to: pulse energy, duration, pointing and energy stability, beam quality. You hold vendors to it

  • Vacuum and opto-mechanical engineering judgment. You know what vacuum chamber design, differential pumping, vibration isolation, and thermal management require to keep the LPA running under continuous, high-average-power use

  • Controls and diagnostics systems thinking. You can translate "runs unattended, 24/7" into concrete requirements for a control system, a machine protection system, and a diagnostics suite, even where another team builds them

  • Minimum 3 to 5 years postdoc experience

  • Doctorate (PhD / Dr.) required

  • At least full professional proficiency in English; German or Estonian is a plus

  • Willingness to work primarily on-site in Hamburg (no full remote; approximately one home-office day per week)

  • Occasional travel required to visit and work at different research facilities across the world

  • Ability to start in January 2027 or latest February 2027

Core Benefits

  • Key Role with Direct Impact: Without your LPA, our core product – the transportable muon source – cannot operate

  • Founding Role with High Autonomy: Build both the accelerator team and the machine from the ground up, taking full ownership of technical and budget decisions

  • Unique Deep-Tech Challenge: Hands-on work with laser-plasma accelerators at 100 Hz / 100 TW and active muon imaging technology that is revolutionizing industrial inspection

  • Access to World-Class Infrastructure: On-demand beamtime at multi-GeV facilities such as DESY PRIMA, plus collaborations with ELI Beamlines, EPAC, and ATLAS

  • Strong Network & Visibility: Collaborate with leading partners such as DESY, DLR, Siemens Energy, Marvel Fusion, and other high-tech organizations

  • Attractive Compensation Package plus a substantial employee equity program and relocation support, including for non-EU candidates

  • Culture of Ownership & Speed: A skunkworks approach, flat hierarchies, bold decision-making, and full transparency create an environment for personal growth

You’ll consider the problem and solution spaces, balancing user needs, business goals and technical considerations. 

You’ll play a leadership role in projects and guide the direction of work. You’ll build relationships with senior stakeholders and other interested parties. You’ll support less experienced colleagues and share your extensive knowledge widely.

You'll ensure that work is carried out in accordance with Opencast's quality, environmental, and information security policies and procedures, as well as applicable customer policies, standards and procedures while working on client.

If you have less leadership experience, consider our consultant service designer role.

Requirements

This role involves weekly on-site work, and you’ll be required to travel regularly to client locations across the UK. We’re looking for people who value in-person collaboration, enjoy building strong relationships, and are passionate about delivering solutions that make a real difference for our clients.

Due to the nature of this role, you must either hold active Security Check (SC) clearance or be eligible and willing to undergo the clearance process. 

SC clearance is granted in line with UK Government security vetting requirements. Typically, applicants must have UK citizenship and have lived continuously in the UK for at least the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days. Nationality and immigration status may also be considered as part of the vetting process. We are unable to progress applications from candidates who do not meet these requirements.

If you are unsure whether you meet the eligibility criteria, we encourage you to review the guidance or discuss this with us before applying.



We are recruiting for multiple positions, with opportunities available immediately and in the coming months. If you are interested in joining Opencast, we encourage you to apply.

Essential experience

In your CV and interview you’ll need to show how you have:

  • Experience with the GDS / Gov Design Systems
  • Analysed and synthesised complex information into actionable insights, needs and recommendations
  • Conveyed complex information to different audiences, using appropriate creative techniques
  • Designed artefacts to evidence existing systems and experiences
  • Designed and facilitated user research, workshops and co-design sessions
  • Designed accessible and inclusive end-to-end services
  • Analysed the impact and integration of all aspects of a service in the context of a larger service ecosystem
  • Worked across multiple work streams
  • Led discussions with product owners to plan and produce roadmaps
  • Planned and executed service design practices to different timescales
  • Considered future business needs and wider client strategies.
  • Designing to government service standards 
  • Working in agile delivery teams

As well as service design skills, you’ll need to show that you have:

  • Built trust and strong working relationships with senior stakeholders
  • Respectfully and effectively challenged proposed decisions or solutions
  • Created common ground between people
  • Assigned tasks and set project milestones for yourself and others
  • Coached less experienced practitioners

At the interview, we’ll ask you to present a piece of work that demonstrates this experience.

Salary

£64,001 - £70,000 per annum.

What we offer

A competitive package including a 7% employer pension contribution, share options, and a discretionary bonus. You’ll also benefit from 25 days’ holiday and access to 3 annual “life happens” days to support unexpected situations. We provide wellbeing support, ongoing professional development, volunteering opportunities, and the chance to be part of a genuinely supportive team.

Where you’ll work 

This role requires regular on-site attendance at our HQ, hub offices, and client sites, as well as the ability to work from home. Applicants must be able to travel to offices and client sites across the UK as part of their normal working arrangements, as travel is essential for fulfilling the responsibilities of the role.

We include you 

We welcome candidates from all identities, attributes, ways of thinking and backgrounds to thrive in a career at Opencast. Our aim is for the diversity of our people to be reflected in the solutions we deliver, to help create a fairer society for all.   

Interview 

Interviews will be conducted via Microsoft Teams. We’re happy to make adjustments to support your needs.

title: GM / VP Sales, France
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The role in one line

Come build our France territory. You'll own the market, lead from the front in every deal, and build the team as the market earns it.

Why now

Omnea is the UK's number one startup for 2026 and the 11th fastest-growing tech company in Europe. We're in the middle of a major global expansion, and France is a market we're committing to. The product, customers and sales motion are proven. What we need now is the leader who turns that into a real business on the ground.

  • We win 86% of live RFPs against our biggest competitor

  • More than 3x ARR growth in the last 12 months, with 40% in Q3 alone

  • Under 20% of enterprises use modern procurement software today. Gartner expects that to reach 50% by 2027

  • Global enterprises including Spotify, Wise, Adecco and McAfee already run on Omnea

What you'll do

  • Own the France number: set the territory plan, choose the target accounts and build pipeline from day one

  • Be in the deals: run and close our biggest France opportunities yourself, with CFOs, CPOs and procurement leaders

  • Lead from the front as Omnea's face in France: customer meetings, CFO dinners, industry events and partner conversations

  • Build the team as the market earns it: hire and coach the AEs who follow you, and set the standard they sell to

  • Take what you hear from buyers straight to product and marketing, so we win more in France

Who this is for

  • 8+ years in B2B SaaS, with a strong record of closing complex enterprise new business yourself

  • Experience leading or building a sales team, ideally in a new market or a fast-growing business

  • Fluent French and English

  • A player-coach who would rather be in the deal than in a dashboard

  • Credible with C-suite buyers, especially Finance, Procurement and Legal

  • Comfortable building from zero: no local team and no playbook handed to you, just a proven product and a market to win

  • Bonus: you've opened a new market or been an early leader at a scale-up

Where this goes

You'll build and lead Omnea's France business. As the market grows, so do your team and your remit. We run as a meritocracy, and we've signed the Future Founder Promise, so if you want to start your own company one day, we'll back that too.

How you'll work

This role is remote while we build our presence in France.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

title: Graduate Customer Operations Agent (UK)
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

This is an entry-level role for someone who wants to start a career in operations at a financial services firm. You'll join our UK Customer Operations team and train to become a fully competent front-line agent, supporting customers across our personal loans, credit cards and car finance. That covers everything from general service queries to more intricate financial support situations. By taking ownership of every enquiry from first contact to final resolution, you will not only deliver exceptional customer outcomes but also provide actionable feedback and insights to help improve our automated tools and AI-driven customer journeys

You'll be based in our Chatham office three days a week and work two weekend days a month (one Saturday and one Sunday), with a day in lieu the week before so you never work more than five days in a week.

What you'll be doing

  • Resolving general customer service and financial support queries across any one of our products in either loans, cards or car finance over multiple channels, following established processes

  • Owning each enquiry from first contact to resolution, or escalating it to the right place when it needs to go further

  • Supporting customers in financial difficulty or in vulnerable situations: listening actively, asking the right questions to understand their circumstances, and finding the right support option for them

  • Keeping conversations on track while building rapport and trust, so every outcome is both positive for the customer and compliant

  • Meeting your targets for customer satisfaction, quality and compliance by following procedures carefully and using judgement where a customer's situation calls for it, and logging every interaction accurately for audit and learning

  • Using AI and digital tools to resolve queries faster and more accurately

  • Feeding back blockers, process gaps and recurring issues to the relevant teams, and taking part in process reviews that improve our knowledge base, training resources and AI systems

  • Keeping up with product, system and process changes, acting on coaching and feedback, and sharing what you learn with colleagues


What we're looking for

Essential

  • Clear, empathetic communication, both spoken and written. You can adapt to the person in front of you and explain something complicated in plain English

  • The ability to learn quickly, pick up new products and procedures, and act on coaching

  • Good organisation: you can manage several tasks at once and follow a structured process accurately

  • Sound judgement, and the willingness to speak up when a customer isn't getting a good outcome

  • Comfort with digital tools and picking up new technology, including AI-driven platforms

  • Availability to work from our Chatham office three days a week and two weekends a month (where you will work from home)

Nice to have

  • Experience in a contact centre or another customer-facing role, particularly in financial services would be a definite plus but it is not essential for this role.

  • A habit of spotting where a process could work better and suggesting how


Perks & Benefits

  • More Time to Unwind Start with 25 days of holiday, plus extra days to reward your loyalty! Hit your 1-year milestone and get 26 days, or 27 days after 2+ years.

  • Own a Share of Our Growth We want you to have skin in the game. You’ll receive Company Equity, meaning as we scale, you directly share in our financial success.

  • Health & Wellbeing Peace of mind comes standard with comprehensive private medical and dental insurance from day one.

  • Smash Targets, Get Rewarded Earn up to a £4,000 annual performance bonus based on hitting key team metrics and KPIs.

  • Perks & Recognition via Reward Gateway Access hundreds of exclusive employee discounts, alongside our brand-new recognition programme tied to our core competencies. Plus, enjoy dedicated team budgets for ad hoc, monthly, quarterly, and annual awards!

  • Legendary Socials & Summer Events We love to celebrate our hard work! From team get-togethers to our epic annual Summer Day Event, featuring great food, a BBQ, and plenty of fun, there are always opportunities to connect and unwind with colleagues across the business.Interview process


Our Interview Process

We want to get to know you, and we want you to get to know us! Here is what you can expect:

  • Step 1: Talent Screening Call and Mock CRM/Email Exercise A quick chat with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to talk through your experience, what you are looking for, and answers to any initial questions you have. You will also complete a quick task where you will be navigating through a mock - CRM system and replying to some email enquiries

  • Step 2: Onsite Interview & Role Preview A 1-hour interview at our Chatham office. To give you a true feel for our environment, you will also have the optional chance to jump on a live call-listening session to experience the role firsthand!

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

title: Graduate / Junior Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
About THG Ingenuity 

THG Ingenuity is a proprietary Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) technology, robotics, and operations platform built for global ecommerce. Developed through more than two decades of operating ecommerce and retail services at scale, its software and automation capabilities have been engineered, tested, and refined through the real-world demands of managing complex commerce operations. Today, THG Ingenuity provides an integrating operating environment that enables brands to intelligently optimise the entire commerce lifecycle from browsing and checkout to AI inventory management and forecasting, automated fulfilment, carrier control, and customer experience. The platform comprises: 

  • THG Fulfil: The fulfilment operating system for global ecommerce. Delivered via a proprietary SaaS and Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model, THG Fulfil orchestrates every stage of checkout, fulfilment, delivery, and customer experience through an integrated system. 
  • THG Studios: The UK's most innovative creative hub, helping brands create content that connects, experiences that engage, and IP that scales, all from its end-to-end, in-house facilities.  
  • THG Commerce: A cloud-native technology stack enabling retailers and brands to create intelligent, AI-powered, digital shopping experiences, while integrated marketplace and social commerce functionality allows brands to reach customers across every sales channel 

With its expertise in building and scaling brands, THG Ingenuity is uniquely positioned to bring pertinent, pragmatic, and global know-how across all aspects of commerce. 

The Role

We are seeking a talented and commercially astute Data Scientist to join our dynamic team tackling Fraud, Payments and Finance. In this multi-focus role, you will be responsible for protecting our global e-commerce operations from fraud, optimising our payments performance and driving profitability and automation initiatives within Finance.

Working with vast, complex datasets, the work will involve combatting online fraud using our award-winning THG Detect platform and driving payments optimisation by increasing authorisation rates, while also using the latest AI software and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure to build complex data solutions and applications.

This role requires a blend of strong technical skills, commercial acumen, and effective communication to translate complex data insights into tangible business value.

Responsibilities:

  • Optimise Fraud Detection: Continuously improve automated decision-making in our in-house THG Detect platform using machine learning and decision rules.
  • Enhance Payment Performance: Lead data-driven initiatives to boost payment authorisation rates, optimise transaction routing, and reduce costs.
  • Drive Profitability within Finance: Lead automation and profitability initiatives across different areas of Finance.
  • Communicate Performance: Report on all aspects of fraud, payments and finance performance to stakeholders at all levels, including C-level management.
  • Drive System Improvements: Collaborate with Fraud, Payments, Finance and Engineering teams to scope and implement enhancements to detection systems and data pipelines.
  • Innovate & Automate: Proactively identify opportunities to improve detection capabilities, drive profitability, increase payment success, and enhance team efficiency through automation.

Requirements:

  • Proficient with SQL & Python
  • Proficient in a data visualisation software (Tableau/Looker/PowerBI/e.t.c.)
  • Experience using a variety of machine learning algorithms
  • Able to communicate effectively; using data to tell a story and drive business change
  • Experience within Google Cloud preferential

THG Ingenuity is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.

THG Ingenuity is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.

Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG Ingenuity please contact one of our Talent team to discuss further.

Unterstützt von Investoren wie der Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation bauen wir gemeinsam das modernste, 100 % elektrische Liefersystem Europas.

Das erwartet dich 

  • Teamleitung: Du bist Coach und Vorbild – mit deinem echten, intrinsischen Interesse an Menschen führst und inspirierst du dein Team aus 4 Teamleitenden und über 50 Lagermitarbeitenden.
  • Schichtleitung: Im FC behältst du stets den Überblick, priorisierst Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass jede Bestellung pünktlich rausgeht.
  • Abwechslung: Du erlebst den perfekten Mix aus Action direkt auf der Lagerfläche (3–4 Tage pro Woche) und strategischem Deep Dive im FC Office (1–2 Tage pro Woche).
  • Prozessoptimierung: Stillstand gibt es bei uns nicht. Du hast Ideen? Hier entwickelst du eigene Logistikprojekte und hebst unsere Abläufe durch deinen Tatendrang aufs nächste Level.
  • Ownership: Du hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, auch wenn Dinge mal außerhalb deines unmittelbaren Bereichs liegen. Du schaust über den Tellerrand hinaus und nimmst die Dinge proaktiv selbst in die Hand.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master) in Logistikmanagement, Supply Chain Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
  • Du brennst für die Logistik und bringst idealerweise erste Einblicke aus dem Lagerbereich mit (z. B. durch Praktika oder ein Werkstudium).
  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und bringst die nötige Flexibilität für Schichtarbeit (inklusive Abenden und Samstagen) mit.
  • Ein extrem hohes Maß an Eigenantrieb. Du siehst Dinge von selbst, nimmst sie proaktiv in die Hand und übernimmst Verantwortung – auch über deinen eigenen Tellerrand hinaus.
  • Ein echtes, intrinsisches Interesse an Menschen. Du bist empathisch, nahbar und liebst es, dein Team zu motivieren und weiterzuentwickeln.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Zeit zum Auftanken: Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.
  • Verpflegung für Gewinner: Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück, Mittag- und Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Individuelle Mobilität: Du entscheidest, wie du zu uns kommst. Du erhältst einen Firmenwagen (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und kostenlose Parkplätze an den Picnic Standorten stehen dir zur Verfügung. Dazu bieten wir ein „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm an.
  • Lebensmittelretter: Hol dir unsere exklusiven "Too-Good-To-Go"-Tüten und rette leckere Lebensmittel – nur für unsere Mitarbeitenden!
  • Lerne & wachse: Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.
  • Absicherung für morgen: Wir unterstützen dich mit einem überdurchschnittlichen Zuschuss zur Betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, damit du auch an später denkst.

title: Graduate Product Designer 2027 (London)
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Role

There’s a lot behind a morning coffee order. You could be part of it.

A local café, a courier on the way and a customer ready to start their day. At Deliveroo, we connect people with the food, shops and products they love.

As a Graduate Product Designer, you’ll work at the intersection of data, design, and engineering, helping define how millions of people experience Deliveroo and turning complex marketplace challenges into simple, high-impact solutions. This is a full-time role based in our London HQ.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining one of our core teams: Consumer, Merchant, Dasher, Ads & Promos,  or Customer Experience & Integrity. You’ll work on real projects that impact millions of customers, merchants, and Riders, collaborating with Product, Research, Data, and Engineering to prototype your concepts, test with real users, and ship improvements to millions of people. 

  • You’ll learn from designers shaping this new practice - one where AI is native to how you explore ideas, prototype, and ship.
  • You’ll grow faster than you thought possible - with a dedicated manager, a mentor, and a team invested in your development, you’ll quickly grow to own design end-to-end.
  • You’ll experiment with how AI can change the way you work and design processes, and ship polished features that reach millions of users, merchants, and Riders.
  • You’ll use AI to explore divergent directions, build high-fidelity prototypes, and pressure-test ideas before they ship, leveraging this technology to help you shape how our product becomes smarter, more intuitive, and more human.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of our product and process. As part of an early class of new graduates, what you figure out won’t just shape your own projects - it’ll shape how design is practiced across the team.
  • You’ll refine your craft with mentors and peers in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment that values curiosity, craft, and collaboration.
  • You’ll collaborate closely with designers, engineers, PMs, and researchers to find the right problems to solve and ensure high-quality implementation.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

We’re looking for strong design foundations and curiosity to grow. Here’s what you’ll need to join us and thrive in the role:

  • You’re in your final year of study, graduating with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in design or a technology-related field (e.g. Human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Computer Science, Digital Design, Industrial Design, etc) and available to start full-time in 2027.
  • You have a portfolio (school, internships, or side projects) that shows strong design fundamentals - visual design, interaction design, and user-centered problem solving.
  • AI is already part of your process and your portfolio includes at least one case study showing how you applied AI in your design process or designed an AI-powered experience.
  • You communicate through prototypes - using Figma alongside AI-driven tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to turn ideas into working experiences quickly.
  • You’re excited to learn, comfortable making decisions or asking for help, and able to iterate quickly as you incorporate feedback.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters - solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. You’ll be paired with a dedicated manager and a mentor while being supported by a community of designers passionate about learning and helping each other grow.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to: 

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scaleWork on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱See your impact, fastShip, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership
    environment.

🧠Grow through challenge and ownershipTake on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎A culture built for buildersHigh standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

At Acturis, innovation isn’t just part of our culture - it’s in our DNA.

Our story began in 2000 in the garage of our co‑founder, Theo Duchen, who, alongside fellow former McKinsey partner David McDonald, set out to reinvent insurance technology. What started as a bold start‑up idea has grown into a global SaaS leader trusted by the industry.

Today, over 100,000 users across 40+ countries rely on the Acturis platform. By working closely with brokers, insurers, and MGAs, we continue to shape the market and drive new standards across both personal and commercial lines.

Acturis is proud to be recognised as a Great Place to Work® 2026 and to maintain a collaborative, innovative, start‑up‑style culture, even as we scale globally. With over 90% of our hires coming from graduate backgrounds, this is a place built for early‑career talent to thrive. And as an EcoVadis Committed‑rated organisation, we focus on creating long‑term value by operating in a sustainable and responsible way.

About the Application Development team

The Application Development team is responsible for the design, development and maintenance of the core Acturis platform. Working across APIs, databases, user interfaces and quality assurance, the team delivers the functionality that powers the software used by brokers and insurers every day. From defining requirements and investigating issues to testing new features and supporting platform improvements, the team plays a central role in the ongoing evolution of the Acturis platform.

Day to day you will:

We offer mentorship from day one, a clear progression path, and real responsibility early on, because we’ve built an environment where graduates grow fast and make meaningful impact.

Ready to apply your technical mind to real‑world challenges?
Join Acturis and build a career where you’ll grow quickly, innovate boldly, and work alongside some of the brightest people in the industry.

title: Growth Marketer
descriptionHtml:
In just over two years, we’ve gone from 0 to over 900 customers, succeeding where many have tried and failed before. We’re now on the hunt for a brilliant growth marketer who wants to make an enormous impact on Spruce’s growth trajectory as we add thousands of installers over the next 18 months. You’ll help to scale and own our marketing and growth engine – campaigns, content, ads, and the experiments that tell us what’s actually working – and generally anything that helps accelerate our growth.

This is not an easy job – but we can promise it’ll be incredibly stimulating & fulfilling, and you’ll struggle to find a lovelier, more engaged group of customers to work with (..and the team’s not bad either!).

🌲 About Spruce

  • Almost 20% of the UK’s carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there’s simply no way to make reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But there’s a problem: the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it really hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can’t currently offer a heat pump when someone’s boiler breaks and they urgently need heating.

  • We’re fixing this. We’ve built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we’re having a massive impact on hundreds of installation businesses, merchants, utilities and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job, doubling their sales conversion rates, and boosting their bottom line.

  • We raised a chunky Seed round last year from top-tier investors and have been scaling the team to massively grow our impact. We’re in the process of expanding outside heat pumps and by the end of the year will be an operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. If you can picture a combination of ServiceTitan, Procore, and autoCAD, you might get a sense of where we’re headed…

🥖 The Role

As we drive the business towards the next fundraise, you’ll be working closely with Hector and our founder Jo, to scale our growth engine. No two days will be the same, but at minimum your work will include:

  • Running growth experiments – setting up and running our full set of growth/marketing tests across. This involves anything that can get the product into the hands of more users, quickly binning things that don’t work, and iterating quickly on everything to find our growth levers.

  • Creating & managing ads, creative, and content – top and middle-funnel marketing content, videos, customer testimonials, short form copy for our website, socials, ads, and nurturing emails, and onboarding guides for new customers.

  • Owning our distribution channels – partnerships, website, socials, email nurture, paid ads and events, making sure each one is pulling its weight and the pipeline it generates is handed cleanly to sales.

  • Marketing analytics & reporting – breaking down conversion rates through our marketing and sales pipelines, tracking CAC and channel performance, spotting areas we can improve, and coming up with suggestions for when and how we should change tack.

🫵 About You

You'll have somewhere between 2 and 5 years of work experience. You don't need a marketing background, but you do need to show us you can spot opportunities and push things forward, whether that's campaigns you've run, content you've created, or projects where you've built something from scratch and got it in front of people. You'll ideally be:

  • Relentlessly proactive — you naturally take responsibility, are always pushing to make things better, and just want to crack on and get sh*t done;

  • A brilliant communicator — you write compelling, concise copy and can explain complex concepts simply;

  • Full of creative energy — you have ideas for how to get more installers onto Spruce and you can't wait to test them. You look at what other companies have done well and think about how to adapt it, not copy it;

  • Hands-on with the tools — you’re willing to roll-up your sleeves to run campaigns yourself across paid ads, email and socials, and you’re comfortable building landing pages, setting up tracking, and making content without waiting for someone else to do it;

  • Data-minded — you're comfortable pulling apart a funnel to work out where it's leaking and you know your way around a spreadsheet, but you use data to decide what to try next, not as a substitute for ideas;

  • A natural "people person" — you love working with people and have a natural interest in their problems. You find it easy to warm to them and quickly put them at ease;

  • Genuinely curious about our customers — heat pump installers are small business owners doing technically complex, physically demanding work. The best marketing we can do starts with understanding their world, and you'll spend real time talking to them;

  • An AI whizz — you’re way ahead of the average person with your LLM usage, have built interesting/cool things in your spare time, and are deeply conscious of all the things that are possible that you haven’t had a chance to try yet;

… and you’ll hopefully also love heat pumps! 🤓

🌟 Our Offer

  • 💰 Base salary £50-70k, with quarterly bonus aligned to company targets

  • 🍰 Slice of equity (options) in the company

  • 🏖️ 33 days holiday and opportunity to work from abroad for another 30 days each year

  • 👧 Workplace Nursery Benefit scheme (YellowNest)

  • 🏥 Private Medical Cover

  • 🧑‍🍼 Enhanced Parental Leave

  • 🚲 Cycle to Work scheme

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Brilliant team to learn from and massive opportunity to grow

  • 🌍 Meaningful, impactful work that genuinely improves the world.

🧑‍💻 Working At Spruce

  • We’re currently a close-knit team of 32, split between London and Bristol. We spend 2-3 days each week working together in-person in both locations, and get everyone altogether every fortnight.

  • You'll have genuine influence from day one. The best idea wins regardless of seniority. We expect you to challenge everything, ask "why?" multiple levels deep, and push back when something doesn't make sense.

  • We want everyone to spend time with installers on-site, feel their pain points, then be able to rapidly suggest and implement solutions based on real feedback rather than assumptions.

  • We move fast and ship imperfect things, learning from users rather than trying to perfect in isolation. When things break, we focus on how we fix it, what can we learn and never blame. You'll own your outcomes whilst knowing the team has your back.

  • Feedback is constant, direct, and kind – we'll tell you when something isn't working and expect the same honesty (and empathy) back.

Compensation: £50K – £70K • Offers Equity • Quarterly bonus linked to company targets

title: Growth Marketing Associate
descriptionHtml:
About Geordie AI

Geordie is building the security and governance platform that enables businesses to adopt AI agents safely and confidently.

As AI agents take on more work across businesses, organisations need to understand what those agents are doing, what they can access, the risks they create and how much they cost. Geordie gives businesses the visibility and control they need to manage AI agents as they scale.

We're building at the cutting edge of enterprise AI, helping organisations unlock the potential of AI while keeping it secure, accountable and under control. We're now looking for a creative, proactive Growth Marketing Associate to help bring our story to life and build Geordie's presence across social media.

2026 WINNER

RSA Conference Innovation Sandbox

2025 WINNER

Black Hat Europe Startup Spotlight

GARTNER

Cool Vendor 2026, AI Software Security

The Role

Reporting to the Head of Growth Marketing, you'll bring Geordie's content strategy to life with fresh ideas and creative execution.

You'll create content for our company social channels, lead influencer engagement, ghostwrite founder social posts and support employee posts, coordinating publishing wherever needed to amplify Geordie's social presence and reputation as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies.

You'll also film and edit short social clips and other video content, track what resonates with our audience, and support wider marketing activities.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys creating content, spotting opportunities and turning ideas into engaging marketing. You'll work closely with the Head of Growth Marketing and the wider team, with plenty of opportunity to contribute ideas and help shape how Geordie shows up in the market.

What You'll Do

  • Create social content: Develop engaging content for Geordie's company social channels, bringing our product, team and perspective on AI to life.

  • Support founder-led content: Ghostwrite social posts for our founders, helping communicate their ideas, insights and perspectives on the AI industry.

  • Coordinate employee advocacy: Help employees share content and ideas, making it easy for the wider team to contribute to Geordie's online presence.

  • Lead influencer engagement: Identify relevant creators and industry voices, build relationships and coordinate opportunities to collaborate.

  • Film and edit video: Produce short-form social clips and other video content that makes Geordie's story engaging and accessible.

  • Manage publishing: Coordinate content across channels, keeping publishing organised and ensuring content goes out consistently.

  • Track performance: Monitor engagement and identify which topics, formats and ideas resonate with our audience, using those insights to improve future content.

  • Support wider marketing: Get involved in broader marketing activities and help the team execute campaigns and initiatives as needed.

What We're Looking For

  • A strong content instinct: You understand what makes content interesting, engaging and worth sharing.

  • Excellent writing skills: You're able to write clearly and creatively, adapting your tone for company channels, founders and employees.

  • Creative execution: You enjoy coming up with ideas but, more importantly, can turn them into content that gets published.

  • Video skills: You're comfortable filming and editing short-form video content for social media.

  • Social media awareness: You understand how social platforms work and keep up with emerging formats, trends and creators.

  • Relationship-building skills: You're confident reaching out to influencers and coordinating with people across the business.

  • Organisation: You're able to manage multiple pieces of content and keep publishing on track.

  • A data-informed mindset: You pay attention to performance and use what you learn to improve your work.

  • Proactivity: You take ownership, bring fresh ideas and don't need to be told about every opportunity worth exploring.

LOVE WHAT YOU DO

An interest in AI and emerging technology would be particularly useful. You don't need to be an AI expert, but you should be curious about the space and excited by the opportunity to help tell the story of a company working at its forefront.

Why Join Geordie?

Help shape a growing AI brand

Play a hands-on role in building Geordie's social presence and reputation.

Work at the cutting edge of AI

Be part of a company tackling the important challenge of making AI agents safe and scalable for businesses.

Work closely with leadership

Collaborate with the Head of Growth Marketing and founders to bring ideas and perspectives to a wider audience.

Have room to experiment

Test new formats, develop creative ideas and learn from what performs.

Make a visible impact

Help shape how customers, partners and the wider AI community understand Geordie and what we're building.


Our Values

 

Solve What Matters

We listen intently and stay focused on what truly matters to our customers. If it doesn't help them navigate real-world agentic adoption and risk, it's probably not worth building.

Build, Learn, Iterate

We favour momentum over perfection - testing, learning, and evolving through action. It's how we move fast and get better, together.

Kind, Not Comfortable

We're honest, respectful, and unafraid to challenge each other. We believe doing great work should feel good, too. Kindness makes that possible.

A Platform for Your Best Work

We want this to be the most meaningful chapter of your career. Geordie is the place where you grow, lead and lift others, while building something that truly matters.

Agents are already at work. Help the world see how Geordie keeps them in check.

title: GTM Associate
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Condukt is the next-generation compliance platform for financial services, offering an agentic solution powered by real-time data for business identity.

Always-on and policy-aware, Condukt enables financial institutions and fintechs to gain actionable insights into business verification - unlocking growth, increasing efficiency, and strengthening compliance.

We were founded by former operators and builders with deep experience in banking, payments, and lending. Today, our team spans across London and Porto, bringing together engineers, product owners, and operators from companies like Revolut, Meta, Block (Square), SumUp, American Express, Yandex, and OakNorth.

Trusted by leading regulated entities, including Wise, Tide, Mollie, Shift4, Flatpay, and myPOS, Condukt is backed by top investors, including Lightspeed Venture Partners and MMC Ventures.

 

Position Overview

As a GTM Associate, you’ll sit at the centre of Condukt’s commercial engine, generating new pipeline across financial services and working hand in hand with our Account Executives to turn it into revenue.

You’ll build opportunities from the ground up: reaching high-growth fintechs and financial institutions with well-researched outreach, qualifying inbound interest quickly, and running first discovery conversations. Your work doesn’t end at the first meeting. You’ll stay on the deal with our Account Executives, help build the customer relationship and, as you grow, lead smaller deals end to end alongside an AE.

As an early-stage, fast-growing company, we value people who take ownership, move with urgency, and are excited to help build both a market-leading product and a repeatable enterprise sales motion. You’ll work closely with our AI Deployment Strategists, Product, Engineering, and Leadership to shape how we sell, who we sell to, and how we win.

If you’re at the start of your commercial career, energised by meeting new people, and keen to take on more responsibility fast, this role is for you.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Own early-stage pipeline creation with fintechs and financial institutions that match our ideal customer profile

  • Research and map target accounts, identifying the right C-level Risk & Compliance, Operations, and Product leaders to engage

  • Help build and run our outbound motion, with sharp, well-researched messaging across email, LinkedIn, phone and events. Test creative formats beyond the usual sequences, and turn what works into a repeatable playbook

  • Respond fast to inbound interest and qualify every lead on fit, urgency and decision-makers

  • Lead discovery calls, support AEs on live deals and, as you grow, lead smaller deals end to end

  • Bring what you hear from the market back to Product and Leadership, helping shape who we sell to and spot new market opportunities

  • Pick up whatever the business needs next: priorities will shift as we scale, and you’ll help shape where we go

What you bring:

  • 1-3 years in a client-facing or target-carrying role, with a proven record of booking net-new meetings

  • Genuine energy for meeting people, and the confidence to pick up the phone, walk into a room of strangers and start the conversation

  • Resilience in the face of rejection, and the drive to keep going for the wins

  • Ability to learn fast, handle ambiguity and change course when priorities shift

  • Hands-on attitude, with a focus on outcomes rather than titles

  • Intellectual curiosity about the compliance space

  • Fluency with AI and data tools to work faster and smarter

  • Strong organisation across follow-ups, sequences and your CRM

  • Low-ego, collaborative approach and openness to feedback

  • Genuine interest in fintech and how financial institutions onboard customers and manage risk

  • Excellent written and spoken English

  • The right to work in the UK

Bonus:

  • Sales experience preferred, but not required for the role

  • Background in fintech, banking, payments, or lending ecosystems

  • Second language proficiency (German, French, and Dutch, especially valued)

 

Our offer:

  • Tackle meaningful problems with real-world impact

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Flat hierarchy with direct access to the founders

  • Hybrid, 3 days a week in our London office

  • Top-of-the-line equipment

  • Private health insurance, plus sick and compassionate leave as needed

title: Head of Compliance
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

We are a global technology consultancy with a trademarked, AI-first approach-Gen-e2™. It redefines how enterprises build digital products and transform their organizations with AI. We do the right thing, and we do it right. We’re proud to be a World Economic Forum New Champion, and a B Corp-certified company.

Your Role

As Head of Engineering at PALO IT Labs, reporting directly to the CTO, you are the operational engine of our engineering organisation. You translate strategy into daily execution, lead our AI engineering community, and ensure every team-client-facing or product-side-delivers at the highest standard.

Where the CTO sets direction and makes structural architectural decisions, you make those decisions real. You own the day-to-day: team health, engineering standards, roadmap execution, and the development of our AI engineers. You are the technical authority your teams rely on to unblock, challenge and grow-while the CTO focuses on vision, key clients, and long-term positioning.

Engineering Excellence

  • Own the token economics of our delivery, balancing model cost, latency and quality across squads, so “AI-first” means production-grade, not prototype-grade

  • Operate one level above Lead Engineers: arbitrate divergences, challenge local decisions, spot systemic debt and keep the bar rising as execution becomes increasingly agentic

  • Deploy on our most complex client engagements as the senior technical authority: design AI-first architectures and see them through to production-you ship, not slide decks

  • Step in as Tech Lead on client projects when needed: if a mission requires it, you can take the technical lead role directly, ensuring continuity and quality without waiting for a resource to be available

People & Community

Gen-e2 Practice & R&D

  • Feed everything back into Gen-e²: what you learn on live engagements becomes standards, artefacts, prompts and learning paths for the whole firm, in collaboration with international teams

  • Produce and own engineering KPIs: velocity, quality, incident rate, technical debt, and team health; report regularly to the CTO

  • Represent the engineering practice in leadership forums and working groups, communicate regularly on team health and needs, escalate risks promptly, and uphold PALO IT values, confidentiality, information security and professional standards

  • Contribute to pre-sales through technical scoping, estimation, proposal input and executive-level advisory, ensuring commercial promises remain grounded in production-grade engineering reality

Who You Are

  • You bring 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant leadership of an engineering organisation or practice (VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, Head of Tech, or CTO of a scale-up)

  • You have delivered production-grade AI-first systems, LLM integration, RAG pipelines, agent orchestration-and you think in token economics (cost, latency, quality tradeoffs) as naturally as you think in code. You master AI coding assistants as a force multiplier: you still code, by choice

  • You have led delivery in complex, client-facing environments (consulting, embedded squads, platform modernisation) with real users, real constraints and real accountability

  • You are a proven people developer and manager, with a track record of scaling engineering practices-not just individuals-through mentorship, community-building and hands-on AI adoption

  • You think in systems and write things down: architecture decisions under uncertainty, ADRs, standards that make quality reproducible

  • You are fluent at every altitude, from engineering stand-ups to leadership forums, and you switch between them in the same afternoon

  • You lead with care and exigence: high expectations held with accountability in a psychologically safe environment

  • You know how to read team signals early: engagement, workload imbalance, burnout risk, retention risk and under-utilisation, and you act with care, clarity and accountability

  • You care about Tech for Good: sustainability, accessibility and responsible AI are embedded in how you build

  • You are comfortable partnering with HR on hiring strategy, interviews, portfolio reviews, offer decisions and talent-pipeline building through community engagement and events

  • Bilingual French/English, English is mandatory for client and international collaboration

More About PALO IT 

Our mission is to become the most advanced consulting company when it comes to AI-First product and software engineering. 100% of our projects are focused on deploying our Gen-e2 methodology to clients to help them accelerate delivery and scale those new practices.

title: Head of Finance and Operations (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Ninox ist eine Berliner Low-Code-Plattform, mit der Teams genau die Geschäftsanwendungen bauen, die sie brauchen. Rund 80 Mitarbeitende, tausende Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa, vom kleinen Team bis zum Großunternehmen. Ein Produkt, an dem Menschen wirklich hängen. Wir sind seit 12 Jahren am Markt, etabliert, wachsen und sind solide mit Wagniskapital finanziert.

Aufgaben

Du leitest Finance, IT, People und Operations: neun Menschen in vier Disziplinen. Deine Aufgabe ist es, diese vier Disziplinen zu führen, zu entwickeln und auf gemeinsame Standards, Servicelevel und Prioritäten auszurichten. Auch dort, wo du selbst nicht die Fachexpertin oder der Fachexperte bist. Gleichzeitig bist du Ansprechpartner für das C-Level (CEO, CGO und CRO) und die Teamleads in den anderen Abteilungen.

Der Schwerpunkt deiner Ergebnisverantwortung liegt dabei eindeutig im Finanzbereich. Dort führst du ein Team von vier Personen in der Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung (AR/AP) und verantwortest den Rechnungslegungszyklus von Anfang bis Ende: Buchhaltung, Zahlungsläufe, Mahnwesen und Payroll bis hin zum abgeschlossenen Monat und den Zahlen, die das Haus verlassen. Du überschaust die Systeme, die diese Zahlen erzeugen – DATEV, Billing-Plattformen, CRM und Data Warehouse und bist in der Lage diese nach modernen KI basierten Standards miteinander zu verzahnen um ein fortlaufendes Reporting aufzubauen.

Es ist weder eine rein strategische noch eine rein operative Position. Für IT und Office führst du über Standards, Servicelevel und Prioritäten: Hardware, Onboarding, Compliance Standards wie ISO 27001 und 9001 sind dabei von dir zu koordinieren.

Unser CFO wechselt begleitend in ein Fractional-Modell und bleibt bei Board-, Finanzierungs- und Transaktionsthemen eng dabei, du bekommst also einen erfahrenen Sparringspartner, ohne dass jemand über deinem Tagesgeschäft sitzt.

Qualifikation

  • Mehrere Jahre in einer leitenden Finanzfunktion in einem wachsenden Unternehmen, mit eigener Verantwortung für den Monatsabschluss vom Buchungssatz bis zum Reporting. In einem Team dieser Größe ist die Führungskraft Spielertrainer:in: Du kannst die Arbeit auch selbst machen, wenn jemand ausfällt.
  • Solide deutsche Rechnungslegungspraxis – HGB, DATEV, Payroll und die Zusammenarbeit mit dem Steuerberater. Praktisch, nicht theoretisch.
  • Führungserfahrung: Du hast ein Team fachlich und disziplinarisch geführt – idealerweise in der Buchhaltung – und traust dir zu, auch für IT und People Standards zu setzen, ohne Sysadmin oder Arbeitsrechtlerin zu sein.
  • Sicherheit bei SaaS-Kennzahlen: ARR, MRR, Brutto- und Nettoretention, Rechnungsabgrenzung, Kohorten-Analyse und dem entsprechenden Reporting.
  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung darin, einen manuellen Prozess durch einen echten zu ersetzen: ein Reporting, das sich selbst baut; eine Abstimmung, die keine Person mehr braucht. Du musst kein SQL schreiben, solltest aber über Data Warehouse, Billing-System und CRM sprechen können, ohne dafür einen Entwickler im Raum zu brauchen.
  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher – Arbeits- und Abschlusssprache in dieser Rolle – sowie fließendes Englisch.
  • Von Vorteil: Due Diligence, Audit oder eine Finanzierungsrunde von innen erlebt; Berührung mit Förderprogrammen wie GRW oder IBB.
  • Erfahrung mit verschiedenen Compliance Frameworks wie ISO, GRC, ISMS, etc. geben dir einen erheblichen Vorteil im Prozess.

Benefits

  • 100.000–120.000 € Grundgehalt je nach Erfahrung, dazu ein variabler Anteil, gekoppelt an eine Scorecard, die du mitgestaltest.
  • pot. Beteiligung an unserem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm (ESOP).
  • Ein echtes Mandat: vier Funktionen, neun Menschen und das Mandat Prozesse effektiv und wachstumsorientiert zu gestalten.
  • Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro am Monbijouplatz in Berlin-Mitte
  • 30 Urlaubstage, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, BVG Ticket und weitere Benefits
  • Ein Unternehmen, klein genug, dass deine Entscheidungen sichtbar sind, und groß genug, dass die sie echten Impact haben.

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze zu einem Prozess, den du in Ordnung gebracht hast: wie er vorher aussah, was du verändert hast und was es dich gekostet hat, es durchzusetzen. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.
