title: Procurement Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

What You Will Do

  • Make deals: negotiate prices, contracts and work closely with our Sales team to identify and seize market opportunities.

  • Establish and maintain international supplier relationships as part of our strategic procurement, purchasing a seven-figure trading volume per month.

  • Find new partners internationally, for example via trade shows or cold calls, and build these up into long-lasting relationships.

  • Resolve issues with internal and external stakeholders that block revenue.

  • Follow spot market trades, price dynamics and trends, and act on them at high speed.

  • Work with advanced AI tools that keep you a step ahead of the market.

Who You Are

  • You think like a trader. You like buying and selling and ideally have made money before, for example through trading, your own business, a side hustle or a sales role.

  • You want to win. You chase deals and results without waiting to be pushed.

  • You act fast. You decide and follow up.

  • You have a natural curiosity. You always ask how and why, and you learn fast from every conversation.

  • You are comfortable interacting with internal stakeholders and external parties in real-life meetings or (video) calls.

Background

  • You are fresh out of university, or you have a couple of years of work experience in a commercial role, for example sales or trading. Any industry works.

  • Self-employment, your own business or a side hustle is very welcome. We look for people who drive commercial value, understand trade and know how to create revenue.

Required Qualifications

  • You have a university degree.

  • You have strong analytical and negotiation skills, and can clearly articulate complex subjects with confidence and precision.

  • You bring a hands-on mentality: you take ownership, solve problems independently, and thrive in dynamic settings.

  • You are curious about AI and how it changes the way we trade.

  • German post: You speak German at C2 level (mandatory) and English fluently.

  • English post: you speak English fluently. Italian is a plus, and so is any other European business-fluent language.

What’s In It for You

  • Real ownership from day one - shape operational processes in a fast-scaling, AI-first company.

  • Learn from the best - work directly with senior operators, interact with skilled industry leaders and CEOs on a daily basis

  • Competitive compensation - attractive base salary and performance-based bonus program.

  • Personal growth & visibility - rapid learning opportunities, cross-functional exposure, and early leadership potential in a growing global team.

  • Vibrant company culture – modern Berlin office, monthly All-Hands, team events, and regular offsites.

Why Join

You’ll be joining a company that’s not only transforming a global industry but doing so with the speed, precision, and intelligence of AI.
Here, you won’t just manage supply chains - you’ll help redefine how global commerce operates.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. title: Product Lead - Adtech
descriptionHtml:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

Product Lead - Adtech

€120K – €160K

 

Freecash is the product. Almedia is the engagement engine behind it: the smartest way for mobile game studios to turn high-potential users into high-value ones. We're the leader in our category, profitable, and expanding fast.

You will work at the intersection of consumer product, mobile adtech and publisher platforms. Your responsibility will be to improve how users discover and engage with rewards, how publishers integrate and monetize, and how value is measured and distributed across users, publishers, advertisers and Almedia.


This is a high-ownership role for someone who can turn an ambitious product thesis into a clear strategy, a rigorous experimentation programme and a scalable platform.

 

What you'll own

  • Consumer product and engagement. Own the full user journey, from discovery and activation through onboarding, progression, and repeat reward engagement, by designing clear, motivating, product-native reward experiences and turning user behavior into measurable value for publishers and the platform.

  • Publisher platform. Shape the Link SDK and its integration experience for mobile publishers, improving developer experience, implementation quality, configurability and observability, while working with engineering on identity, events, attribution, reward delivery and fraud prevention to give publishers flexible tools without fragmenting the product into bespoke integrations.

  • Monetization and marketplace economics. Develop new rewarded monetization products for publishers, defining how rewards, publisher value and Almedia's economics fit together, by partnering with data science on pricing, segmentation, ranking and optimization to balance user experience, advertiser performance, publisher revenue and contribution margin.

  • Experimentation and measurement. Own a rigorous experimentation portfolio across consumer experiences, integrations and monetization, using holdouts and causal measurement to isolate incremental value from correlation, by defining clear primary metrics, guardrails and maturity windows, and making explicit decisions to scale, change or stop each initiative.

  • Publisher and commercial leadership. Work directly with major mobile publishers, clearly explaining product capabilities, economics and measurement, by leading lighthouse launches, turning publisher feedback into scalable product decisions, and building reporting that publishers can understand and trust.

 

What you'll bring

  • Senior product experience in mobile adtech, publisher monetization, rewarded advertising, mobile gaming monetization or a closely related marketplace.

  • Experience owning a consumer product involving rewards, onboarding, retention, progression or monetization.

  • Experience shipping an SDK, API, developer platform or technically complex partner integration.

  • Direct ownership of revenue, pricing, yield, gross margin, advertiser performance or another meaningful economic outcome.

  • Strong understanding of marketplace economics and how incentives affect users, publishers and advertisers.

  • Deep practical experience with experimentation, holdouts, selection bias and causal measurement.

  • Comfort working with data science on ranking, pricing or optimization systems.

  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers or publishers.

     

What puts you ahead

  • You've been a founder. You know what it means to own an outcome with no one to hand it off to.

  • You've scaled through hyper-growth. 50 to 200+ people, building the plane mid-flight: familiar territory.

  • Mobile gaming or advertising background. You know the players, the incentives, the dynamics.

     

Why Almedia?

  • Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

 

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Product Manager - AI Finance
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within Doit's AI Finance.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners. 

By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

Lead the localisation efforts for our global energy billing platform, ensuring it meets the specific regulatory, market, and cultural requirements of France, from meter read to bill.
You'll be in charge of the French localisation of the Billing Module—one of the core product domains at the heart of the Kaluza platform. The Billing module processes consumption, pricing, and account data to schedule, calculate, and generate accurate, timely, and compliant invoices throughout a customer’s lifecycle. The module automatically manages billing cycles, generates bills, handles corrections, and produces the data that feeds invoices, billing-related communications, payment schedules, and downstream financial reporting, while powering customer and agent UIs.

This is a hands-on, full-stack product role — you'll work across the whole domain and alongside PMs from other domains and from the global billing teams to ensure the overall billing  journey from meter to bill meets the requirements of French clients.

  • Collaborate intensely with clients and in-country experts to understand their unique needs and requirements, negotiate scope, and build a roadmap.

  • Deep dive into French energy market regulations, translating complex compliance needs into detailed product specifications for the billing system.

  • Define and manage detailed product requirements for features related to country-specific needs from getting a read to generating a bill (meter reading protocols, invoice formats, taxation rules, payment methods, and regulatory reporting).

  • Work closely with engineering, UX, and QA teams to ensure the successful implementation and testing of localised billing functionalities.

  • Act as the go-to expert for global teams on specific French market nuances related to energy billing and customer journeys.

  • Continuously monitor changes in French energy legislation and market practices, proactively adapting the product roadmap to maintain compliance and competitiveness.

About You

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager, or equivalent role in software companies, with a strong track record of successfully localising complex software products for international markets

  • Solid understanding of the end-to-end B2C billing lifecycle including meter data, tariffs, invoicing, and debt management.

  • A track record in regulated markets where billing complexity matters, energy, telecoms, financial services, or similar. Familiarity with the French energy market (ENGIE, CRE, switching, tariff structures) is advantageous.

  • Exceptional ability to translate abstract regulatory text or client requirements into clear, actionable, outcome-driven requirements for development teams.

  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (engineering, design, legal, operations, client success) to deliver localised solutions.

  • Excellent stakeholder and client management skills, able to lead conversations across requirements, scope, expectations, and roadmap alignment, and communicate technical & market complexity clearly to varied audiences.

  • Proficiency in AI tools throughout all stages of the product lifecycle — from discovery and ideation to delivery and iteration.Fluent in French and English — our platform and many of our teams operate in English, so you move easily between both.

  • A builder's mindset — you're autonomous, learn fast, and aren't afraid to go deep. You're comfortable interrogating a codebase with AI tools, reading an API schema or data model, and writing a SQL query to get the answer you need.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and pace — you can operate effectively when not everything is defined, know when to make a call, and aren't afraid to escalate or ask for help when it matters.

  • Fluent in French and very comfortable in English — our platform and many of our teams operate in English, so you move easily between both

Your Mission

As a Product Manager in the Investing domain, you will contribute to the product scope our largest partners depend on, as well as our side of the joint dwpbank x lemon.markets suite. Your remit will include working with some of the biggest financial institutions in Europe to deliver core capabilities. These include trading mechanics, tax, corporate actions, and the investing capabilities we're building jointly with dwpbank. You will scope them, prioritise them, and deliver them.

Reporting to the Senior Product Manager, Investing, you'll drive complex, multi-stakeholder commitments end-to-end. You'll work across internal teams at lemon.markets, our largest partners, and dwpbank counterparts in the group. Success looks like partners shipping compliant products on our infrastructure without us being the bottleneck.

In this role you will:

  • Own the roadmap for a set of partner-critical Investing capabilities, from problem framing through to launch, adoption, and iteration.

  • Be embedded in a cross-functional crew including operations and engineering, while engaging with other product teams, solutions engineering, external partners, and colleagues in risk, finance, and compliance.

  • Prioritise commitments against the domain strategy using quantitative and qualitative evidence, and share your trade-offs internally and externally.

  • Ensure that any partner-specific integrations have longevity within our platform.

  • Engage directly with enterprise partners and prospects - scope requirements, negotiate delivery, prioritise.

  • Work with dwpbank counterparts on joint product opportunities, translating between two organisations with different ways of working.

  • Propose forward-looking solutions that outlive the immediate ask, rather than one-off fixes for the loudest partner.

  • Track market and regulatory developments in our space, and bring the insights back to the team.

You’ll be successful in this role if:

  • You have at least 2-3 years of product experience, independently shipping highly complex products.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity - you can define a problem space, structure it, and move forward without waiting for someone else to hand you a spec.

  • You argue your position based on data and evidence, and iterate when the evidence changes.

  • You can express yourself in writing. Documentation, decisions, specs, partner comms - clear writing is a core part of the job.

  • You use AI tools in your day-to-day work and are comfortable pushing what they can do.

  • You are professionally fluent in English and German.

  • Experience in regulated fintech / brokerage or B2B environments is a plus!

How we take care of you:

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributor lemoneers work 4 or more days per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.

  • 💛 Perks & benefits: Wechoose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

title: Product Owner, Technical - AI Stockbroking
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product owners to own product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in the Netherlands. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in the Netherlands.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

  • Assurer la cohérence des solutions développées avec la stratégie technologique globale.

title: Quality Control Specialist (Software/Electronics)
descriptionHtml:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups.
We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.

When a drone fails a test on our production floor, you're the first person we call. As Production Quality Control Specialist (Software/Electronics), you're the first line of technical support for production. You troubleshoot, diagnose and fix failures across our VTOL drones, their sub-systems, sensors and in-process quality tests. That way every aircraft we ship meets the standard our customers rely on in the field.

You also step back from single failures and look at the data. You analyze yields and quarantine trends, find the root causes behind repeat problems and decide which fixes to tackle first. You work closely with Production, Engineering and Supply Chain, and your work shows up directly in product quality and output.


Responsibilities

  • First on the scene. You're the first-line technical support for production issues, from test failures and assembly defects to nonconforming units.

  • Fix what's broken. You troubleshoot and repair electrical, electronic and system-level failures on drones, sub-assemblies, payloads and sensors.

  • Keep the test benches honest. You help investigate issues with our software and electronics test benches.

  • Decide what happens to quarantined material. You choose whether it gets reworked, repaired, scrapped or returned to the supplier.

  • Find the real cause. You lead root cause analyses (5 Whys, Ishikawa, 8D) on recurring and high-impact failures.

  • Let the data point the way. You analyze yields and quarantine Paretos to spot the biggest quality drivers.

  • See fixes through. You turn your findings into prioritized corrective actions (CAPA) and follow them until they are closed.

  • Keep failure, test and repair records traceable.

  • Share what you learn. You feed findings back to Engineering and suppliers, and you train assembly staff on failure modes and workmanship defects.


    • Requirements

  • You've spent 4+ years as a quality technician, quality inspector or assembly technician on a complex mechatronic product.

  • You understand at system level how mechanics, electronics, sensors and firmware work together.

  • You're at ease with data. You can build yield and failure Paretos and draw sound conclusions from them.

  • You're motivated and able to get to know our test software stack.

  • You're methodical and keep good records, and you make sound calls under production pressure.

  • You have a technical apprenticeship or technical diploma in Engineering, Manufacturing or Mechatronics, or equivalent practical experience.

  • You communicate excellently in English and enjoy working together on the shop floor.


    • Plus

  • Experience with UAVs, RC aircraft or avionics

  • Familiarity with batteries, GNSS, IMUs, cameras or LiDAR

  • Experience designing electronics PCBAs

  • Experience in software programming

  • SPC, Cp/Cpk, MSA or a Six Sigma Green Belt

  • Python, SQL, BI or AI tools for data analysis

  • Experience with non-conformance tracking, quality management systems or manufacturing ERP/PLM software

  • Familiarity with inspection tools, measurement equipment, technical drawings and CAD

  • Hands-on work with assembly line operators, manufacturing engineers and quality teams

  • Continuous improvement methods such as 8D, 5S and CAPA

  • Speaking or understanding German

    • Joining Wingtra, you gain deep insight into applied robotics and aerial photogrammetry. You work in a startup, so you make a personal impact on both the technology and the organization itself. Please send your CV in English.
    If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you.

title: Radiologist - Chest CT Annotation - AI Project (UK)
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking radiologists with a chest/thoracic background to carry out structural annotation on de-identified chest CT scans, with a focus on spatial accuracy and consistency against detailed annotation guidelines.

You will work asynchronously on a dedicated annotation platform, marking points, boxes and measurements on findings that have already been flagged upstream, to support the development of clinical AI imaging models.

This is a remote, flexible and short-term project.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Click-point placement: Mark specific coordinates on a scan, such as the centre of a nodule.

  • Bounding boxes: Draw boxes around defined regions of interest, such as a flagged lesion.

  • Simple measurements: Record diameter, or distance between two marked points, on segmentations or polygons already drawn.

  • Guideline application: Work to an annotation guideline covering placement conventions, boundary definitions and measurement rules, applied consistently across a large volume of studies.

  • Edge case handling: Flag ambiguous cases with a short rationale so guidance can be refined.

This is structural markup project with no interpretation required. You will not be reading scans for diagnosis, judging malignancy, or making clinical decisions.


Qualifications:

  • Registration: Registered radiologist in your country of practice with active license

  • Experience: 3–10 years' experience in radiology, with a chest/thoracic focus

  • Knowledge: Strong grounding in thoracic anatomy and cross-sectional CT.

  • Attention to detail: Proven accuracy and consistency in image review or measurement work.

  • Technical proficiency: Comfortable using structured annotation tools and digital platforms.

  • Prior imaging annotation experience is an advantage but not required.

  • Language: Native or near-native written English.


Legal Status:

  • You will have the right to work in your country of residence.

  • You will work as an independent contractor.


Why Join Us?

  • Flexible Work Arrangements: Part-time, remote and fully asynchronous.

  • Competitive Compensation: Hourly rate, paid weekly.

  • Professional Development: Hands-on experience in clinical AI development and medical imaging, shaping how AI systems localise and measure findings on CT.

title: Mobile Developer
descriptionHtml:

As a Mobile Developer, you will contribute to this mission by developing and improving the applications that connect people, devices and healthcare.

Our digital health solutions enable healthcare professionals to monitor patients remotely, helping people receive the right care in the right place. You will work across our mobile applications, creating reliable, intuitive and high-performing experiences for patients and healthcare professionals alike.

Beyond developing and improving our apps, you will help shape our technical direction, explore new technologies and share your expertise with colleagues. You will have the autonomy to take ownership, make technical decisions and contribute beyond your immediate responsibilities, supported by Luscii's Holacratic way of working.

Your role

As a Mobile Developer at Luscii, you will take ownership of the development, optimisation and maintenance of our mobile applications across iOS and Android. You bring ideas to life, make well-considered technical decisions and help ensure our applications remain performant, stable, scalable and easy to maintain.

You will work closely with colleagues across development, QA and support, combining hands-on engineering with technical ownership. Whether you are building a new feature, exploring a technology through a proof of concept or resolving a production issue, you will help us continuously improve the quality and usability of our digital health solutions.

What you will be doing:

  • Develop, maintain and optimise mobile applications using native technologies such as Kotlin and Swift, with a focus on performance, stability and user experience.

  • Contribute to mobile architecture, technical design and modular codebases, applying clean architecture, object-oriented design principles and patterns such as MVVM and MVI.

  • Build intuitive user interfaces using technologies such as Jetpack Compose and SwiftUI, following platform-specific design guidelines.

  • Develop and maintain features that communicate with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices, as well as web services, cloud platforms and APIs.

  • Build prototypes and proof of concepts to explore new technologies, validate technical approaches and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Investigate and resolve production issues through debugging and performance analysis, covering areas such as memory management, multithreading and networking.

  • Contribute to code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD processes, sharing technical knowledge and helping colleagues make sound implementation decisions.

Why Luscii?

Read more about working at Luscii and how we work at Luscii/OMRON. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy.

  • Salary: € 4.600 - € 5.900 gross per month (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii).

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii.

  • Flexible setup: Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here.

The ideal candidate…

You enjoy the autonomy to shape your work and responsibilities, while actively seeking collaboration and alignment with others.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.

  • You have at least five years of experience in mobile development, with a strong background in native Android and/or iOS development. You have extensive experience with Kotlin and/or Swift.

  • You have a relevant bachelor's degree, for example in Computer Science or Computer Engineering and you are familiar with working in an Agile environment.

  • You have a solid understanding of mobile architecture and software design principles, including clean architecture, object-oriented design, MVVM and/or MVI. You know how to build and maintain modular applications.

  • You have experience with mobile development frameworks and tools such as Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI, Kotlin Coroutines, Flow and Kotlin Multiplatform. You are also familiar with unit testing and/or UI testing, CI/CD pipelines and platform-specific design guidelines.

  • You understand what it takes to build reliable, high-performing mobile applications, including memory management, multithreading, networking, debugging and optimisation. You have experience integrating web services, cloud technologies, APIs and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices.

  • You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

  • Design, build, and operate reliable backend services and APIs, primarily using Python, Django, and PostgreSQL, and contribute targeted changes to our React Native applications with TypeScript.
  • Use AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and generate tests. Define clear tasks and constraints, provide relevant context, Provide clear context and constraints, and validate changes through code review, automated tests, and application-level checks.

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Medical to explore, define, and deliver patient-centric features across our platform, supporting regulated digital health products for IBS, GERD, and upcoming indications.
  • Uphold technical excellence in architecture, code quality, and security, including applicable requirements under IEC 62304, BSI TR-03161, and the MDR.
  • Mentor other developers and help raise the technical bar across the team.

Requirements

Your Profile

Must haves

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong backend focus and an understanding of how complete applications work from user interface to infrastructure.
  • Strong backend development skills in an established language such as Python, TypeScript, Java, or PHP. Our current stack includes Python, Django, and PostgreSQL.
  • Working knowledge of React Native and TypeScript, with the ability to implement and test changes in an existing mobile application.
  • Solid understanding of relational databases, API design, distributed systems and services.
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests for backend services and APIs, including unit and integration tests.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and privacy, including authentication, authorization, secrets management, and secure handling of personal and patient data.
  • Strong practical knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, and cloud-native architecture, with experience using GCP or another major cloud provider such as AWS or Azure.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and write automated tests, including connecting agents to engineering tools via MCP. You can explain how you scoped the work, verified the results, and handled tool permissions and sensitive data.
  • A pragmatic product mindset: you collaborate effectively with non-technical stakeholders, understand the impact of technical decisions on patients and UX, and continuously improve both product and platform.

Nice-to-have

  • Strong Linux administration skills, including setting up, operating, and securing self-managed cloud instances; familiarity with monitoring and observability concepts.
  • Experience with Prometheus, Loki, and Grafana; GitOps using ArgoCD or FluxCD; or configuration management using Ansible or similar tools.
  • Networking knowledge and experience with mobile CI/CD, release automation, or application monitoring tools such as Sentry.

title: Senior Sales Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Als Senior Sales Engineer (m/w/d) fungierst du als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Vertrieb, Consulting und Projektumsetzung. Du unterstützt den Sales-Prozess, indem du komplexe Kundenanforderungen analysierst, strukturierst und daraus tragfähige SAP-Lösungskonzepte entwickelst. Dabei verantwortest du die fachlich-technische Lösungsarchitektur, die Machbarkeitsbewertung, Scope-Definition, Aufwandsschätzung sowie die Konzeption der Umsetzung in der Angebots- und Pre-Sales-Phase. Du arbeitest eng mit Account Executives, Bid Management, Consulting Teams, Product Management und weiteren Fachexperten zusammen und bist ein entscheidender Bestandteil unseres strategischen Vertriebsmodells.

Deine Aufgabe:

Solution Design & Pre-Sales

  • Analyse komplexer fachlicher und technischer Kundenanforderungen im SAP-Transformationsumfeld sowie Entwicklung belastbarer, kundenspezifischer Lösungskonzepte inklusive fachlich-technischer Lösungsarchitektur.

  • Durchführung und Moderation von Discovery Sessions, Solution Workshops und technischen Deep Dives zur Bewertung von Machbarkeit, Anforderungen und Lösungsoptionen.

  • Definition geeigneter Delivery-Modelle, Projektansätze und Umsetzungsstrategien einschließlich Scope-, Risiko- und Abhängigkeitsmanagement unter Einbringung von Best Practices aus vergleichbaren SAP-Projekten.

Sales Support & Customer Advisory

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Account Executives bei strategischen Opportunities, Qualifizierung von Kundenanfragen sowie Übersetzung fachlicher und technischer Anforderungen in konkrete Lösungsansätze.

  • Entwicklung überzeugender Solution Stories und Value Propositions sowie Unterstützung bei Kundenpräsentationen, Pitches, Workshops und Executive Meetings.

  • Beratung von Kunden zu SAP-Transformationen, Datenmigration und Datenmanagement sowie fachliche Positionierung gegenüber Kunden, Partnern und Stakeholdern zur Differenzierung unserer Lösungsansätze im Wettbewerb.

Estimation, Scope & Delivery Feasibility

  • Verantwortung für die Definition des Projekt-Scopes sowie die Entwicklung und Validierung belastbarer Aufwands-, Ressourcen- und Delivery-Modelle.

  • Bewertung von Delivery-Risiken, Projektkomplexität und kritischen Abhängigkeiten sowie Festlegung von Annahmen, Voraussetzungen und kundenseitigen Mitwirkungspflichten.

  • Sicherstellung, dass angebotene Lösungen operativ lieferbar und wirtschaftlich tragfähig sind, einschließlich eines strukturierten Übergangs von Sales in die Delivery nach Auftragseingang.

Bid & Proposal Support

  • Erstellung und Qualitätssicherung fachlicher und technischer Angebotsinhalte sowie fachliche Verantwortung für die Solution- und Delivery-Kapitel innerhalb von Angeboten.

  • Unterstützung bei RFPs, Ausschreibungen und komplexen Angebotsverfahren durch die Ausarbeitung belastbarer und überzeugender Lösungsansätze.

  • Ansprechpartner für fachliche und technische Rückfragen von Kunden sowie Durchführung von Clarifications im Rahmen des Angebotsprozesses.

Knowledge & Enablement

  • Aufbau und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung wiederverwendbarer Lösungskonzepte, Methoden und Best Practices zur Steigerung von Effizienz und Qualität.

  • Aktive Weitergabe von Know-how an Sales-, Consulting- und Delivery-Teams sowie Unterstützung beim Ausbau von Sales Enablement und Solution Selling.

  • Identifikation von Markttrends und wiederkehrenden Kundenanforderungen sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product Management und Portfolio-Verantwortlichen zur Weiterentwicklung des Lösungsangebots.


Dein Profil:

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im SAP

  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung in Pre-Sales-, Solution-Sales- oder Beratungsprozessen

  • Erfahrung in der fachlichen Konzeption und Bewertung komplexer Kundenanforderungen

  • Erfahrung mit Aufwandsschätzungen, Scope-Definition und Projektplanung

  • Erfahrung in Angebotsverfahren, RFPs und komplexen Sales Cycles

  • Ausgeprägte Präsentations-, Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Kundenreisen innerhalb des Projektumfelds

Falls du denkst, dass du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst: Bei uns sind deiner Entwicklung „keine Grenzen gesetzt“! Geh mit uns gemeinsam deinen Weg – Wir unterstützen dich dabei! Zeige uns einfach wer du bist.

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

Ein Umfeld, dass jederzeit offen für Veränderungen und Optimierungen ist. Ein „das war schon immer so“ gibt es bei uns nicht. Du hast die Chance dein Wissen einzubringen, Prozesse zu gestalten, vorhandenen Themen zu standardisieren oder Abläufe zu optimieren. Sei Impulsgeber im Thema Projektmanagement und bringe uns mit deiner Expertise noch weiter nach vorne! Wir schaffen Rahmenbedingungen, in denen du dich wohlfühlst. Daher bieten wir dir viele Benefits, wie europaweites flexibles Arbeiten, Mobilität und Altersvorsorge. Im Folgenden findest du mehr Informationen!

Wir schaffen Rahmenbedingungen, in denen du dich wohlfühlst:

  • Home-Office Verträge & absolute Flexibilität durch freie Gestaltung der Arbeitszeit

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung und 30 Tage Urlaub

  • FlexWork: Bis zu 3 Monate pro Jahr remote aus dem europäischen Ausland arbeiten

  • Monatliches Budget für individuell wählbare Benefits aus über 50 möglichen Angeboten über emplu, verschiedene Angebote über Corporate Benefits, sowie Fahrrad- und Autoleasing per Gehaltsumwandlung

  • Mental Health Benefit 'Nilo' – 10 kostenlose Sessions mit Psycholog:innen jährlich sowie Zugang zu Meditationen und Kursen

  • Wir unterstützen dich gezielt bei deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung bei Natuvion

  • Mentorenprogramm für eine strukturierte und persönliche Einarbeitung

  • Werde Teil des #teamgreen - Bei Natuvion arbeitest du an innovativen Projekten als Teil eines Teams, das füreinander einsteht. Wir setzen auf Zusammenarbeit, Offenheit und Vertrauen

  • Modernes Equipment und zentrale Büros in Walldorf, Berlin, München und Leipzig

  • Uns ist deine langfristige Perspektive wichtig, deshalb bezuschussen wir deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge sowie vermögenswirksame Leistungen

Join #teamgreen - Natuvion ist ein digitales Umzugsunternehmen.

Unser Team bewegt keine Tische, Aktenschränke oder Stühle. Natuvion transportiert geschäftskritische Daten und Prozesse von einer Technologieplattform auf eine andere. Typische Natuvion „Umzugsdienstleistungen“ umfassen Datenmigration, Datentransformation, Datenintegration, Datenschutz, Datensicherheit und Datenqualität.

Unsere >400 BeraterInnen und EntwicklerInnen in Deutschland, Österreich, Slowakei, USA und Australien verfügen über weitreichendes Knowhow bei (SAP®-)Projekten und ein profundes Prozessverständnis über Branchengrenzen hinweg. Mit viel Erfahrung, Engagement und Einsatz begleiten sie unsere Kunden mit Beratung, Dienstleistung und eigener Softwaretechnologie. So ermöglichen wir Unternehmen, ihre Daten und Prozesse immer auf den modernsten und innovativsten Plattformen zu nutzen.

title: Senior SAP AMS Consultant (SAP PP)
descriptionHtml:

Employment: Permanent

Location: UK based

Salary: Excellent basic salary

Benefits: 24 days holiday, paid birthday day off, paid volunteer day, holiday buy & sell, Bupa private healthcare, 5% employer matched pension contribution, life insurance 4x annual salary, electric car lease scheme, funded social events, investment in personal development, you chose the charity we make the financial contribution, CSR initiatives, and much more!

The Company

At The Config Team, we’re not a typical corporate consultancy, and we’re not a generic SAP/IT Consultancy. We are experts in SAP supply chain, and we do it exceptionally well. With 30+ years of experience and our own suite of products (like PreBilt™ for EWM), we help global brands create smarter, faster, more resilient supply chains.

Each project we deliver is different from the next. We can offer an environment that brings a variety of projects at the forefront of modern supply chain solutions.

To delight our customers by exceeding their expectations in all aspects of support and service. The Config Team is an experienced and trusted SAP AMS partner.

This is a senior, customer-facing role with responsibility for managing and delivering day-to-day client requirements, including Service Requests, Incident Resolution and Problem Management, in line with ITIL methodology and Service Level Agreements.

The successful candidate will also lead complex changes, contribute to project delivery, resolve challenging issues and improve SAP-related processes.

As a subject-matter expert, the Senior AMS Consultant will work closely with customers and colleagues across our delivery teams. The role also includes supporting the development of less-experienced team members through coaching, mentoring and knowledge sharing.

To ensure the above is fully achievable for our clients you will need to have a strong knowledge and understanding of SAP PP.

  • Background in an SAP support or SAP AMS environment.

  • Ability to deal with internal and external stakeholders in a support environment.

  • A full valid UK driving licence.

Desired Skills

  • Experience of using or implementing mobile solutions either in SAP ITS or using a Third Party Product with SAP.

The Config Team

A leading SAP Supply Chain Software Consultancy, with a people-centric and collaborative culture focused on employee well-being, learning and development and creating an excellent place to work for our people. We aim to delight customers with the exceptional delivery of SAP projects.

Why apply for this position with The Config Team?

  • Work Where Works approach.

  • Opportunity to build and shape our partner strategy.

  • Work with innovative SAP software products and solutions.

  • Excellent career progression and learning & development opportunities.

  • Be part of a collaborative, supportive and people-focused culture.

Find out more about Life At The Config Team on Glassdoor where we our proud to say employees rate us 4.9 / 5 stars! https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-The-Config-Team-EI_IE1831019.11,26.htm

At The Config Team, our people are our greatest asset. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment built on trust, respect, and integrity, where everyone has the opportunity to succeed. We strive to create a workplace where all individuals feel welcome, safe, valued, and supported.

We are committed to preventing discrimination of any kind and actively encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including those from underrepresented groups. title: Senior Security Engineer - AppSec (d/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Redefine the future of live entertainment tech
Welcome to vivenu, the global leader in event ticketing tech and one of the world’s fastest-growing live entertainment tech firms. We are transforming event ticketing for global leaders like the Grammys, the Golden Globes, Stanford University and the Hockenheimring turning what was once a simple transaction into a strategic business advantage. Backed by over $65 million in funding, our platform empowers event organizers to own their brand experience, unlock deep data insights, and seamlessly integrate ticketing into their digital infrastructure.
With six offices worldwide and growing, we deliver a customizable, intuitive solution and industry-leading support that simplify even the most complex ticketing challenges – helping organizers deliver exceptional experiences and drive real growth.
Join us and build the future of live entertainment.
With over 10 million end users and usage quadrupling annually, our infrastructure now handles over 1 billion requests per month — and counting. Our API-first platform solves complex system challenges at scale — delivering performance, flexibility, and reliability for the world’s leading live entertainment brands.

This isn't just a maintenance role – it is a blank canvas to build, scale, and architect a state-of-the-art AppSec program from the ground up. We are currently operating at a fraction of our ultimate potential, which means you have an immense, blank-canvas opportunity to fundamentally shape our security culture, processes, and tooling across the entire global engineering organization.

You will drive the entire AppSec lifecycle: from offensive red teaming and threat modeling to risk-based vulnerability management and pioneering a true shift-left culture.

What Makes This Role Challenging and Engaging:

  • High-Impact Technical Environment: You won't just follow blueprints; you will holistically influence a shift-left architecture across both application and platform layers.

  • Modern Technology Stack: Dive into securing a massive TypeScript monolith alongside Go supporting services, giving you hands-on experience in modern language security and advanced GitHub CI/CD pipeline hardening.

  • Web and API: secure the application of the vivenu platform which provides customers with an out-of-the-box ticketing software as well as the underlying API structure

  • Complex Multi-Cloud Architecture: Challenge your skills against a sophisticated multi-tenant, multi-region environment spanning k8s, GCP (our primary compute) and and separate database services

  • Cutting-Edge Deployment: Secure a next-gen Kubernetes "satellite architecture" utilizing hardened private compute nodes, VPC peering, and Argo CD for GitOps—a true, modern cloud-native security mandate.



As a Senior Security Engineer - AppSec (d/f/m) your responsibilities will include:
  • Be a Trusted Advisor: Partner closely with engineering teams to champion security-by-design and elevate our overall security posture.
  • Offensive & Defensive Testing: Coordinate and execute threat modeling and advanced security tests across our product and underlying infrastructure.
  • Lead Next-Gen Vulnerability Management: Drive triage and remediation using modern, risk-based principles like EPSS, while leveraging AI technologies to accelerate security testing at scale.
  • Pioneer Security-as-Code: Design, implement, and automate security checks and guardrails (SAST, DAST, and secret scanning) directly into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Review & Refine: Perform deep-dive code and configuration reviews, advocating for secure coding practices that support a proactive shift-left strategy.

    • What you will need to succeed in this role:
  • Experience: 5+ years of dedicated Security Engineering experience, ideally within a high-growth SaaS, E-commerce, or Fintech environment.
  • SaaS Deep-Dive: The ability to dive deep into the business logic of a complex SaaS application to uncover and verify elusive attack vectors.
  • Web and API Security Mastery: a deep understanding of web/API attack vectors and scalable best practices and how to run workloads securely in a cloud environment (k8s, AWS/GCP/Azure)
  • Ownership: A proven track record of autonomously driving security initiatives from conception to completion.
  • Automation Mindset: Proficiency in at least one programming language for scripting and security tool development (bonus points for automating GRC evidence collection).
  • Education: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, IT, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

    Preferred:

  • Experience navigating PCI DSS script security.
  • A background in Red/Purple Team operations and advanced penetration testing, paired with the empathy and collaboration skills needed to help dev teams fix software vulnerabilities.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform for securing infrastructure-as-code and integrating security testing.
  • Familiarity with our modern tech stack: GCP, Golang, and TypeScript.
    • Why join vivenu?
    Live Entertainment TechPlay a mission-critical role for global brands, redefining fan experiences from festivals to major sports events. Here, you’re part of the business of fun — powered by cutting-edge technology that brings moments to life for millions.
    Sustainable GrowthWe scale sustainably on a profitable, VC-backed foundation with true product-market fit. This means continuous investment in our people, products, and long-term vision.
    Top-tier TeamCollaborate with over 160 dedicated professionals, including leaders from Google, Slack, and Salesforce. Together, we’re shaping the future of live entertainment technology, one decision at a time.
    Global DNAWe’re a diverse, merit-driven team spread across six global offices. Talent and impact are what matter here — not hierarchy or background.
    Fast Growing, in All AspectsSifted consistently ranks us among the fastest-growing scale-ups in Europe. We’re driven by daily learning, shared wins, and collective growth.
    Next-Gen Leaders & InsightsWork alongside some of tech’s brightest minds — from Forbes 30 Under 30 founders to Executive of the Year award winners. At vivenu, you’ll help set the standard for the ticketing industry’s future.
    vivenu Inclusion StatementAt vivenu, we believe our people define our success – and that we win with bold, diverse minds. The strongest teams are built on different perspectives, experiences, and voices. We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels empowered to contribute, grow, and thrive to shape the future of live entertainment globally.
    Check out our mission statement and corporate values here.

title: Solution Consulting Manager
descriptionHtml:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

The Role

We have grown quickly, and our Solution Consulting team is at the center of how prospects evaluate Rillet as their next ERP. We are looking for a Solution Consulting Manager to lead and scale that team.

This is a player-coach role weighted heavily toward coaching. You will spend roughly 25% of your time running your own sales cycles (staying sharp, credible and close to the customer and product) and roughly 75% of your time coaching, mentoring and developing your team, primarily by riding shotgun on live deals and giving real-time feedback. You will also be a key voice in shaping the product and building the Solution Consulting infrastructure that lets the organization scale.

You will work directly with the CEO, GTM leadership and the Product team.

Responsibilities

Coach, mentor and develop the team (~75%)

  • Ride shotgun on deals. Join discovery calls, demos, technical validations and POCs to observe, step in when needed, and give specific, real-time feedback. Run tight pre-call prep and post-call debriefs so every deal is a learning opportunity.

  • Raise the bar on craft. Coach Solution Consultants on discovery, value selling, storytelling, demo design, handling technical objections, and tailoring sandbox environments to each customer's use cases.

  • Grow each person individually. Set clear expectations and development plans, give regular honest feedback, and help each Solution Consultant build deep product and accounting domain expertise and advance in their career.

  • Hire and onboard. Recruit, interview and ramp new Solution Consultants, and build an onboarding program that gets them deal-ready quickly.

  • Partner on deal strategy. Work with Account Executives and sales leadership to staff deals, pressure-test strategy on complex ERP evaluations, and keep technical wins on track.

Run your own sales cycles (~25%)

  • Remove technical objections. Take on strategic and complex opportunities, understanding the prospect's business requirements and existing technology stack, and clearly articulating how Rillet integrates and improves their processes.

  • Deliver high-impact demos. Set up and tailor the sandbox environment, answer questions in real time, and act as the prospect's trusted consultant throughout the purchase process.

  • Represent Rillet. Be the face of the company, applying high customer empathy and structured problem-solving to ensure every prospect interaction is excellent, including with finance and accounting leaders.

Inform product and build for scale

  • Be the voice of the prospect. Synthesize front-line feedback, objections, competitive intel and feature gaps from across the team, and bring it to founders and Product in close to real time, with clear patterns and prioritization.

  • Influence the roadmap. Partner with Product on discovery, early feedback on new features, and how capabilities are positioned and demoed.

  • Build Solution Consulting infrastructure. Create the systems, playbooks and tools that help the team scale, such as discovery frameworks, demo standards and reusable assets, sandbox and demo-data templates, technical FAQs and objection libraries, POC and technical-validation processes, a deal-review cadence, and enablement and certification paths.

  • Measure what matters. Define and track team metrics (technical win rate, ramp time, deal coverage, cycle time) and use them to improve how the team operates.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years managing or formally mentoring pre-sales, solutions consulting or sales engineering teams, with a track record of developing people.

  • 3+ years of industry accounting experience across areas such as revenue recognition, month-end close and multi-entity consolidation.

  • 3+ years supporting complex ERP sales cycles with implementation and/or customer support for accounting or financial solutions.

  • Deep knowledge of the ecosystem of tools in the office of the CFO.

  • Excellent communicator who makes complex concepts easy to understand, and who can give direct, constructive feedback in the moment.

  • Experience building processes, enablement or tooling for a growing team, ideally in an early-stage, fast-moving environment.

  • Thrives in a dynamic environment while keeping high attention to detail.

  • CPA certification or having started your career in audit is a plus.

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.

Life at Rillet

  • Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

  • Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

  • Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

Compensation: $210K – $320K • Offers Equity • Multiple Ranges

  • Zone A • OTE $225K – $320K • Offers Equity
  • Zone B • OTE $210K – $290K • Offers Equity
  • Zone C • OTE $210K – $290K • Offers Equity

title: SQL Developer – AI Prompting & Context Engineering
descriptionHtml:
This is a dual role, split between approximately 60% AI-assisted development and agent orchestration, and 40% SQL Server development supporting large-scale data migration. You’ll work within the development team and report to the Software Manager, combining practical AI skills with strong SQL expertise to deliver reliable, efficient solutions.

Key Responsibilities

AI-Assisted Development & Agent Orchestration (c. 60%)

  • Use AI coding assistants, such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot, across the development lifecycle, including code generation, refactoring, testing, documentation and review.

  • Build and maintain effective prompts, system instructions, reusable skills and context to produce consistent, reliable AI outputs.

  • Design and orchestrate agents and multi-agent workflows, including task decomposition, tool use, agent hand-offs and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.

  • Connect agents to internal systems, databases and APIs, for example through MCP or function calling.

  • Evaluate AI output for accuracy, regression, cost and latency, and refine workflows based on results.

  • Apply appropriate safeguards for data privacy, security and hallucination risk, particularly when customer or school data is involved.

  • Identify and prototype opportunities to apply AI to development and data migration, and share best practice by supporting and coaching colleagues.

SQL Server & Data Migration (c. 40%)

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable SQL Server T-SQL solutions and related tools for data cleansing, migration and reconciliation.

  • Provide database performance-tuning expertise for internal and third-party systems, using AI tooling where appropriate.

  • Define technical requirements with non-technical colleagues in the Data Migration Team, and work with third parties to understand their software and support migration projects.

  • Manage SQL Server database environments used for data migration, including backup and recovery in test environments.

  • Prepare and expose data safely for agents and AI workflows, using AI to support SQL query generation, code review and optimisation.

  • Plan and prioritise work independently, managing tasks against project timelines and requirements.

The Ideal Candidate

  • You’ll combine hands-on AI-assisted development skills with substantial SQL Server experience. You’ll be curious and adaptable, communicate clearly, and use good judgement to assess AI-generated output rather than accepting it uncritically.

  • Demonstrable experience using AI coding tools and writing effective prompts, with practical examples of workflows or agents you have built.

  • Substantial SQL programming experience and strong knowledge of the techniques and capabilities of Microsoft SQL Server 2017 or later.

  • A strong grounding in data modelling, data management and data manipulation, alongside Git, version control and attention to detail.

  • The ability to investigate problems independently, collaborate with colleagues and communicate clearly in writing and in person.

Essential Skills

Practical experience with AI coding assistants and strong prompting skills, supported by examples.

Strong SQL Server T-SQL development and performance tuning, including experience supporting SQL Server in a large-scale environment.

Experience with Git and version control.

Excellent teamwork, communication and documentation skills.

Desirable Skills

Experience building agents or multi-agent workflows using Claude Code, MCP or similar frameworks.

Familiarity with LLM APIs, evaluation approaches and prompt testing.

Scripting or programming experience in Python or a similar language.

Awareness of AI data protection and security considerations.

A reasonable understanding of operating systems, infrastructure and networking.

title: Vice President of Marketing (Global)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Axelera AI builds the most power-efficient AI inference hardware and software in the market, from the edge to the data center. Founded in 2021 and headquartered at High Tech Campus Eindhoven, we design AI processors on our Digital In-Memory Computing architecture, including the Metis platform and the Europa AIPU for multi-user generative AI and computer vision.

We have grown from the founding employees to employees across 20 countries, and over 750 customers. In February 2026 we raised more than $250 million, the largest investment ever in an EU-based AI semiconductor company, bringing total funding past $450 million. Our customers span physical and edge AI: defense and public safety, industrial manufacturing, retail, robotics, agritech and security, to AI Factories and enterprise AI customers looking to control their own infrastructure and costs.

Position Overview

We are hiring a Vice President of Marketing to run the global marketing engine that turns our technology lead into market leadership. You will report to our CMO and General Manager of the Americas as her senior operating partner. She sets marketing strategy, positioning and budget, and directly leads developer relations, partnerships and technical sales development. You turn that strategy into one global plan and lead the team that delivers it: corporate communications, content, digital marketing, events and our webstore. We plan together, share one dashboard, and keep decisions close to the people doing the work.

You will join a highly functional team that has already grown Axelera AI’s engagement significantly across press, digital, events, partners and our developer community. This is not a rebuild. title: Research Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: Oxford or London (Hybrid)

The Mission: Why We Exist

Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer healthier lives, using the power of genomics.

Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores - giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time.

 

Role Purpose

We're looking for an exceptional Research Engineer with strong computational skills and a track record of applying them to large-scale data science. A background in human genetics is preferred, but if you come from another quantitative field and are excited by the potential of genetics to transform healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

You'll join a team of experts in human genetics, data science and software engineering, building the platform at the heart of our Life Sciences work – (1) helping us derive new insights into human biology and guide drug development towards safer, more effective targets; (2) providing our SaaS customers with innovative analytics. How your time splits across methodology, software engineering and analysis will reflect your own balance of computational and scientific strengths.

This role can be hired at IC2 (Research Engineer) or IC3 (Senior Research Engineer) level, depending on your experience. At IC3, you'll operate with greater autonomy, hold a broader technical scope, bring deeper subject-matter expertise, and lead projects that require integrated updates across multiple tools, working with cross-disciplinary teams to deliver value.

It'd be great if you also have

title: Research Manager, Biodefense
descriptionHtml:
You support fellows in the Biodefense Fellowship, so that each one does strong work and moves into a role where they can reduce catastrophic biological risk.

  • Salary: £86,750–£121,500 per year. We may be able to pay more for exceptional candidates.

  • Location: London, at our office at LISA

  • Hours: Full time

  • Visa: We can sponsor a Skilled Worker visa, but approval isn't guaranteed.

Why work at Pivotal

Pivotal finds people who can work on the biggest risks from advanced AI and gets them working on them. AI and synthetic biology are making it easier to create dangerous pathogens, so in 2026 we started the Biodefense Fellowship, which focuses on defences such as early detection, protective equipment and medical countermeasures. Since 2024, 135 fellows have taken part in our fellowships, and alumni now work at METR, Apollo Research, UK AISI and GovAI. We have grown from 2 staff in 2024 to 10 today, and we plan to reach at least 16 in 2027. Read more about us at pivotal-research.org, and about what it is like to work here.

What you will own

You'll be the Research Manager for about 6 research fellows, supporting each project from scoping through to publication. You'll collaborate closely with our whole research management team.

You'll engage deeply with your fellows' work: reading drafts, questioning experimental designs, suggesting framings, and helping projects stay ambitious but tractable. You’ll also hold the thread that keeps projects moving and fellows well supported.

  • Your fellows. Regular check-ins, project planning, unblocking, and feedback on drafts.

  • Projects and mentors. Use your knowledge of the field to help find biodefense mentors and to judge which projects matter most.

  • Information hazards. Help fellows handle sensitive biological information responsibly, and decide with mentors what is safe to publish.

  • Career outcomes. Help fellows move into biosecurity organisations, government and policy roles.

  • Wellbeing. Look after your fellows' wellbeing, with support from our community manager.

  • Between cohorts. Help design the next cohort, and support other programs where needed.

Research management at Pivotal

As an individual researcher, you might advance one or two projects. In this role, you'll have a hand in about 6 projects simultaneously (and about 18 projects every year). Your leverage comes from making each fellow meaningfully more effective than they would be on their own.

The biodefense field has an extremely limited talent pipeline, and many of the people who will shape it over the next few years are early in their careers, still developing their research taste, and often short on high-quality guidance. This role sits at that bottleneck. You’ll help the next generation of researchers produce stronger work, find the right collaborators, and move into positions where they can have outsized impact.

If you get energy from seeing other people's work click into place, this role may let you shape the field more than you could as a single researcher.

Who does well in this role

  • A background in biosecurity research or policy.

  • You know the biosecurity field and its organisations, which helps with mentors and careers.

  • Good judgement about handling sensitive research information.

  • Strong project management across several projects at once.

  • Care for people: fellows trust you and tell you early when things go wrong.

  • You want to spend a large part of your career reducing catastrophic biological risk.

We don’t expect anyone to be strong in all of this. If the role excites you, please apply, even if you match only part of what we describe here.

How we hire

We review applications as they come in, so applying early helps. The process has these stages:

  • Written application. A short form and your CV. It takes about 30 minutes.

  • Automated video interview. About 10 minutes. You record short answers to a few questions, at a time that suits you.

  • Work task. About 2 hours, based on real work in this role. We pay you for this time. You may use AI tools, as you would in the job. Tell us which ones you used and how.

  • Personal interview. About 45 minutes. We discuss your work task and how you would approach the role. With your consent, we record it so that more of the team can review it.

  • Work trial and references. Up to three paid days working with us at our office in London. We also speak to two referees, after asking you.

If you need an adjustment at any stage, such as extra time, tell us and we will arrange it. If you have questions, email ----- £86,750 – £121,500
