title: Senior Launch / Onboarding Manager (f/m/x)
descriptionHtml:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission

As our Launch Manager, you’ll own the end-to-end delivery of our partner onboarding, from kick-off through go-live and post-launch activities, turning complex, regulated brokerage integrations into predictable, high-quality launches.

Our partner universe is evolving: alongside our direct business with fintechs and neobanks, we’re building a combined offering with dwpbank, bringing a new wave of partners and increased cross-organization complexity. We’re therefore building a dedicated Launch Manager function to run these onboardings with clear ownership.

In this setup, you’ll provide the coordination we’re building, driving the launch plan, steering stakeholders, and ensuring a clean handover to Partner Management once the partner is live. You’ll sit at the center of cross-functional execution, aligning Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Operations, and second-line functions (and, where relevant, dwpbank) to keep delivery on time, within scope, and operationally sound.

In this role you will:

  • Lead end-to-end partner launches by owning the onboarding plan, milestones, and delivery rhythm across Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Operations, and second-line functions — so partners go live faster and with fewer surprises.

  • Drive alignment and decision-making between partnership leads, product counterparts, and executive sponsors — so scope, priorities, and trade-offs are clear and execution stays on track.

  • Run cross-functional workstreams (e.g., API integration readiness, ops/process setup, compliance & controls, partner enablement) to reduce delivery risk and ensure high-quality outcomes in a regulated environment.

  • Design and continuously improve an onboarding playbook (templates, checklists, risk log, status reporting, launch criteria) to standardize onboarding and scale partner delivery without scaling chaos.

  • Own stakeholder communication and reporting to leadership, internal steering committees, and partner counterparts — so progress, risks, and dependencies are transparent and manageable.

  • Manage complex/time-sensitive post-launch activities (feature expansions, new functionalities, operational changes) so existing partners can grow their offering without destabilizing day-to-day operations.

You’ll be successful in this role if:

  • You bring 5+ years of experience in launch management or project/program management within brokerage, fintech, or banking environments.

  • You have a deep understanding of B2B onboarding, including how to structure plans, manage dependencies, and steer stakeholders through complex delivery.

  • You bring strong financial services domain expertise (brokerage knowledge is a plus) and can translate regulatory/operational constraints into actionable delivery plans.

  • You have led complex cross-functional teams across business, product, engineering, and second-line functions, driving outcomes without formal authority.

  • You are comfortable mixing methods (waterfall, agile, hybrid) and pragmatically using tools like onboarding plans, risk logs, and reporting to get the job done.

  • You thrive in ambiguity and complexity, take ownership end-to-end, and can zoom out for the plan while still digging into the messy details needed to execute.

  • Communicate exceptionally well in English and German (C1+) building trust quickly, leading tough conversations calmly, and keeping momentum across senior internal and external stakeholders.

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributer lemoneers work 4 day or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

But also in the bigger things: celebrating the onboarding of new partners, growing our teams, and owning a strong discussion culture.

title: Senior logistiek medewerker Joure
descriptionHtml:
Werk jij graag in de logistiek en neem je makkelijk het voortouw? Dan zoeken wij jou. Je werkt actief mee op de werkvloer, begeleidt collega's en zorgt ervoor dat onze operatie veilig en efficiënt verloopt.

Waar kom je te werken?

Je komt te werken in ons depot in Joure. Samen met je collega's zorg je ervoor dat duizenden pakketten iedere dag op tijd worden verwerkt. Je werkt in een vast rooster met wisselende diensten:

  • middagdienst: 11:00 tot 19:30 uur;

  • nachtdienst: 02:00 tot 11:30 uur.

Je bent bereid beide diensten te werken volgens een vooraf vastgesteld rooster.


Wat ga je doen?

Als senior logistiek medewerker begeleid je collega's op de werkvloer en ondersteun je de Teamleader Operations bij de dagelijkse operatie.

  • Laden, lossen, sorteren en scannen van pakketten.

  • Bewaken van de voortgang, kwaliteit en veiligheid.

  • Collega's ondersteunen en begeleiden.

  • Knelpunten signaleren en helpen oplossen.

  • Aanspreekpunt zijn tijdens de dienst.

  • De Teamleader Operations ondersteunen of vervangen.

  • Meedenken over verbeteringen in het proces.

Wat bieden we jou?

  • Een salaris tussen € 2.501,82 en € 3.574,03 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

  • Een functie 38,75 (1 fte) uur per week.

  • Een gunstige ORT (onregelmatigheidstoeslag)

    • 30% tussen 20:00 uur en 24:00 uur;

    • 45% tussen 00:00 uur 06:00 uur;

    • 50% op zaterdagen en zondagen;

    • 100% op feestdagen;

  • Opleidingskansen, ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en onbeperkt toegang tot onze Studyhub.

  • 28 vakantiedagen (+ optie tot bijkoop) en reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Veel extra’s, zoals een collectieve zorgverzekering en een aantrekkelijk pensioen.


Wat neem je mee?

  • Mbo werk- en denkniveau.

  • Kennis van Excel.

  • Je communiceert makkelijk en neemt initiatief.

Over DPD Nederland

Met 12 depots in Nederland en als onderdeel van Geopost, zijn we verbonden met een internationaal netwerk dat jaarlijks 1,2 miljard pakketten verwerkt. Achter deze indrukwekkende cijfers staan duizenden collega’s die zich elke dag inzetten, straks samen met jou.

Onze cultuur is ondernemend, betrouwbaar en mensgericht. Wat ooit begon als een nuchter MKB-bedrijf leeft nog steeds voort: praktisch, sociaal en trots. We geloven in persoonlijk contact, samenwerking en zelf aanpakken. Uitdagingen gaan we niet uit de weg. Dat zit in ons DNA.

We groeien hard, hebben grote ambities en jij hoort er straks écht bij. Samen maken we het verschil.

title: Senior long-term oil analyst
descriptionHtml:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
About the Role

As a Senior Long-Term Oil Analyst, you will own Kpler’s strategic multi-decade outlook for crude oil, refined products, and alternative liquid fuels within the evolving global energy system. Bridging macro-economic forecasting and physical trade flows, you will anchor long-term supply, demand, and transition scenarios directly into Kpler’s proprietary cargo-level intelligence. In this high-visibility research role, your insights and published analysis will guide executive decision-makers, commercial traders, and investors navigating structural market transformations, capital allocation, and decarbonization pathways.


Key Responsibilities
  • Lead long-term market research and scenario modeling: Spearhead Kpler's multi-decade (5 to 25+ year) research coverage and fundamental supply, demand, and trade scenarios for crude oil, refined products, NGLs, and low-carbon fuels.
  • Analyze structural market drivers and transition pathways: Deliver in-depth research on upstream capital investment, OPEC+ and non-OPEC capacity shifts, refinery configuration trends, transport electrification, and evolving environmental policies.
  • Anchor macro projections in granular trade flows: Leverage Kpler’s proprietary cargo-level tracking to translate multi-decade macro perspectives into actionable implications for regional balances, trade routes, refining margins, and midstream infrastructure.
  • Author authoritative research publications: Produce regular, high-impact outlook publications, strategic research notes, and thematic market commentary under Kpler’s Insights banner, clearly framing key assumptions and structural uncertainties.
  • Synthesize cross-commodity dynamics: Collaborate with Kpler’s Gas, LNG, and Power research analysts to ensure cohesive, system-wide market assumptions, while benchmarking models against international agencies such as the IEA, EIA, and OPEC.
  • Serve as a trusted market authority: Represent Kpler’s research in executive client briefings, commercial advisory sessions, industry webinars, and specialist media engagements.

    • Experience & Background

    Essential:

  • 5+ years of prior experience in energy market analysis, energy modelling or strategy, with a focus on oil and liquids markets
  • Proven experience building and maintaining supply and demand or scenario models, including a good understanding of the drivers of long-term outlooks
  • Strong understanding of the oil and refined products value chain and of energy transition dynamics
  • Experience in producing independent market analysis and insights
  • Skilled at conducting complex analyses across multiple datasets using advanced data analytics tools
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

title: (Senior) M&A Manager Healthcare (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
(Senior) M&A Manager Healthcare (w/m/d)

München – Vollzeit, Hybrid-Modell, mit VSOP

Du willst nicht einfach nur Deals abschließen, du willst die hausärztliche Versorgung in Deutschland nachhaltig verändern.

Hier geht es nicht um reine Zahlen, hier geht es um Menschen, die dank deiner Arbeit wieder rechtzeitig die richtige Behandlung erhalten.

10–20 Telefonate pro Tag, mehrere Parallel‑Deals und ein Jahresgehalt von bis zu 120 k € sind für dich Normalität, nicht Ausnahme.

Unser Kunde

Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes Unternehmen im Bereich Digital Health und moderne medizinische Versorgung mit Sitz in München.

Das Unternehmen verbindet klassische hausärztliche Versorgung mit digitalen Lösungen und baut deutschlandweit ein Netzwerk moderner Praxen auf. Ziel ist es, Versorgung für chronisch kranke Patienten messbar besser zu machen und gleichzeitig Ärzten moderne Strukturen zu bieten.

Die Rolle sitzt direkt an der Schnittstelle aus Healthcare, Wachstum, Strategie und M&A.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Du führst M&A-Prozesse eigenständig von Erstkontakt bis Signing

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit Ärzten und Praxisinhabern statt nur mit Datenräumen

  • Du bekommst viel Verantwortung in einem stark wachsenden Umfeld

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Management und Investorenumfeld zusammen

  • VSOP-Beteiligung sorgt dafür, dass Wachstum nicht nur auf PowerPoint existiert

  • Hohe Sichtbarkeit und echter Einfluss auf die Expansion

  • Die Mischung aus Healthcare, Verhandlung, Beziehungsebene und M&A ist selten. Viele reden über „Impact“, hier beeinflusst deine Arbeit tatsächlich Versorgungstrukturen.

Aufgaben

  • Du steuerst den gesamten Akquisitionsprozess von Arztpraxen und MVZs deutschlandweit

  • Du führst Verhandlungen direkt mit Praxisinhabern und Entscheidern

  • Du koordinierst externe Partner für Legal, Financial und Commercial Due Diligence

  • Du baust Beziehungen zu Ärzten, Maklern und relevanten Netzwerken auf

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Finance Business Cases und Bewertungen

  • Du bereitest Entscheidungsunterlagen für Management und Board auf

  • Du steuerst mehrere parallele Deals und behältst Timelines, Risiken und Erfolgswahrscheinlichkeiten im Blick

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre nachweisbare M&A‑Erfahrung mit direkter Akquisition von Hausarztpraxen oder MVZs, inklusive erfolgreich abgeschlossener Transaktionen

  • End‑to‑End‑Deal‑Ownership: Du hast eigenverantwortlich von der Sourcing‑Phase bis zum Closing gesteuert

  • Ausgeprägte operative Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Deals gleichzeitig zu managen

  • Stark ausgeprägte Beziehungs‑ und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten gegenüber Praxisinhabern und Ärzt:innen

  • Masterabschluss (M.A., M.Sc. o. Ä.)

  • Deutsch C1‑Niveau und exzellente Kommunikations‑ sowie Empathiefähigkeiten

  • Strukturierte, analytische Arbeitsweise und idealerweise Erfahrung im Healthcare‑Umfeld

Was hier nicht funktioniert

  • Keine praktische Erfahrung im Erwerb von Arztpraxen oder MVZs – reine M&A‑Theorie reicht nicht

  • Nur beratende Tätigkeiten ohne eigenständige Transaction‑Ownership

  • Unzureichende Deutschkenntnisse (unter C1) – direkte Kommunikation ist Kernaufgabe

  • Schwache Stakeholder‑Kommunikation und fehlende Beziehungspflege zu Ärzt:innen

  • Unstrukturierte Arbeitsweise, die das gleichzeitige Managen mehrerer Deals verhindert

Benefits

  • Gehalt je nach Erfahrung ca. 60.000 € bis 120.000 € brutto p.a.

  • Zusätzlich Bonusmodell und VSOP-Beteiligung

  • 30 Urlaubstage und ein Home‑Office‑Tag pro Woche

  • Moderne Arbeitsweise mit klaren OKRs und kurzen Abstimmungen

  • Persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget

  • Wellpass-Zuschuss

  • Snacks und Getränke im Office

  • Regelmäßige Team-Events und gemeinsame Feiern

  • Dynamisches Umfeld mit hoher Lernkurve und echter Entwicklungsperspektive

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Du begleitest Deals mit direktem Einfluss auf die medizinische Versorgung

  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung und schnelle Entscheidungswege

  • Kombination aus Strategie, Verhandlung, Wachstum und Healthcare

  • Du bist nicht nur „Deal Support“, sondern aktiver Teil der Expansion

  • Stark wachsendes Umfeld mit echter Gestaltungsmöglichkeit

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt als (Senior) M&A Manager Healthcare (w/m/d).

Entscheidend ist hier nicht dein Titel. Entscheidend ist, ob du Deals sauber steuern, Vertrauen aufbauen und Wachstum wirklich vorantreiben kannst.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Nabla

Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:

Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.

Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.

The best of AI at the service of healthcare

Nabla’s phenomenal traction is the result of 3 years of diligent product development.

Led by former Meta AI Research engineers, our team has consistently anticipated how AI can revolutionize healthcare delivery. Our Machine Learning team continually leverages the latest advancements to unlock AI’s full potential in healthcare.

Yann LeCun, Meta’s Chief AI Scientist and Turing award winner, is an advisor to Nabla.

Engineering at Nabla

Engineering at Nabla is lean, fast-moving, and deeply technical. Our teams span machine learning, native desktop applications, and platform infrastructure to deliver AI into clinical settings reliably and at scale.

Your Team

At Nabla, product development is led jointly by Engineering and Product, and organized into cross-functional squads, each focused on a specific product area. Squads bring together product managers, designers, engineers of different profiles, and domain experts, and operate with a high level of ownership.
As a Senior ML Engineer, you’ll join one of these squads and contribute end to end to a specific part of the product.

What you'll do

As a senior machine learning engineer, you’ll play a key role in redefining clinicians’ workflows, unlocking better care for patients, and ensuring Nabla remains at the forefront of AI innovation. You will take ownership of high-impact projects and contribute to the growth and maturity of our ML team and R&D processes.

Within a team of experts who have built large-scale production systems at Facebook, Google, and Microsoft, you will:

  • Lead ambitious ML projects, collaborating with multiple engineers to deliver impactful solutions.

  • Go beyond ambient scribing to fully redefine clinicians’ workflows with AI, unlocking transformative efficiencies and improved patient care.

  • Propose and guide experiments, model architectures, and data-labeling strategies to improve our speech-to-text, note generation, and normalization systems.

  • Implement, train, and deploy models in production, ensuring scalability and robustness in a live healthcare setting.

  • Optimize R&D processes, enabling the team to ship new models quickly and confidently as we scale.

  • Stay at the cutting edge of AI research, sharing expertise and fostering technical growth within the team.

To get a sense of the impact you’ll have:

  • Nabla processes 10 billion tokens/month with LLMs.

  • By the time you’ve read this posting, Nabla will have transcribed 100 new hours of live audio and generated 500 new clinical notes, saving 125 hours of doctor time.

Your DNA:

The ideal candidate will bring both technical depth and leadership experience to help Nabla revolutionize healthcare with AI.

Requirements:

  • Deep expertise in machine learning: You have extensive (5+ years) experience in training and deploying neural networks for real-world use cases.

  • Strong leadership skills: Proven ability to lead ML projects, collaborate across teams, and mentor junior engineers.

  • Advanced Python coding skills: You write clean, production-ready code.

  • Vision for AI in healthcare: Passion for going beyond the status quo to redefine workflows and unlock better care for patients.

  • Fluent in English: You communicate clearly and effectively.

  • Broader software engineering experience (infrastructure, front-end, etc.) is a plus.

Our Stack

  • Python for everything ML-related

  • Pytorch and Transformers for training

  • vLLM for inference

  • Google Cloud & Kubernetes for deployment

  • Calls to OpenAI GPT-4 when needed

Where you'll be based

Our offices are based in Paris 3e (Arts & Métiers).
Remote policy: 1-2 days a week (with some flexibility). Possibility of working remotely 1-2 weeks once a year.

Benefits

Just like we’re dedicated to supporting doctors’ well-being, ensuring yours is a top priority. We firmly believe that by prioritizing your well-being, we support you to excel in your work.

Here are the benefits you get when joining Nabla:

  • Stock ownership

  • 100% healthcare coverage

  • Meal vouchers

  • Public transportation costs covered at 50%

  • Exercise class during the workday: Yoga, running, pilates, HIIT

  • Unlimited budget for book purchases, so you can continue to learn about ML / Healthcare

  • Culture of trust & accountability — your output matters more than your clock-in time

Life at Nabla

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

title: Senior Manager, Australia Communications
descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril is building technology for the defence challenges of today and tomorrow. In Australia, that means working with the ADF, industry and partners to develop and deliver capabilities that can make a difference in the defence of our nation.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Communications to help tell that story. You will turn complex programs and technology into clear, credible communications for Australian audiences. You will lead media engagement, develop narratives around our work, support senior leaders and help the team communicate through major milestones and fast-moving issues.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can set direction, write exceptionally well and deliver at pace. You will work across the Australian business and with colleagues internationally, balancing long-term reputation building with the demands of a busy news cycle.

The Australian business is growing rapidly, with over 300 employees, so this role will also support our internal comms work, engaging our employees and making sure our people are bought into the mission.

What you’ll do

  • Develop and execute communications plans that support Anduril’s priorities in Australia.
  • Build relationships with defence, technology, business and national media; identify opportunities to tell substantive stories about our work.
  • Write and edit announcements, speeches, opinion pieces, briefing materials, social content and executive messages.
  • Advise Australian leaders on messaging, interviews, speaking opportunities and sensitive issues.
  • Work with program, engineering and business teams to understand their work and explain its relevance to customers and the broader public.
  • Plan communications for product and program milestones, partnerships, events and other significant moments.
  • Manage reactive media enquiries and help prepare for issues or crises with sound judgement and clear processes.
  • Coordinate with global communications colleagues so Australian communications reflect local priorities and the company’s wider direction.
  • Own internal communications for Anduril Australia, keeping employees informed about business priorities, program milestones and decisions that affect their work.
  • Partner with Australian leaders to plan and deliver clear, timely updates, including all-hands meetings, leadership messages and major announcements.
  • Help teams understand how their work contributes to Anduril’s mission, connecting progress across programs, functions and locations.
  • Measure what is working and improve plans based on outcomes, feedback and changes in the external environment.

What you’ll bring

  • Significant experience in communications, media relations or public affairs, including ownership of complex projects from strategy through execution.
  • Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to make technical subjects understandable without losing accuracy.
  • Strong knowledge of the Australian media and policy environment, ideally including defence, national security or technology.
  • A record of advising senior leaders and working in executive communications
  • Confidence working directly with journalists and handling sensitive or high-stakes issues.
  • The curiosity to learn how a product works, the judgement to know what matters to an audience, and the discipline to check the details.
  • A practical, collaborative approach and the ability to move between strategic planning and hands-on delivery.
  • Aligned on the mission and the opportunity and challenge that faces our nation today
  • A sense of humour and a collaborative spirit!

Experience in technology, defence, government or a similarly complex sector would be valuable. What matters most is your ability to earn trust, find the real story and communicate it clearly.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an ----- address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to

    • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is ----- before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

    • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. Senior Manager, Coach & Instructor Enablement

You will enhance our existing strategy and lead the team through its exciting next stage of growth. The team will form around four capability pillars and a new Enablement Operations platform. You will be building that structure while it delivers across a large delivery organisation that supports thousands of learners. Priorities will shift underneath you as delivery data moves, and part of the job is deciding what starts, what stops, and most importantly what must not slip.

This is a role for a strong operator who excels at influencing and collaborating across complex teams and departments. A proven track record of getting work done across teams with clear asks, embedding shared measures of success, and creating an environment where there is no ambiguity about who owns what is are the keys to success within this role.

You will lead a team of six specialists supporting hundreds of coaches and instructors across all learner programmes.

What you'll own

  • Delivery Fundamentals: the standard for what good coaching and instruction look like, QA against that standard, calibration in partnership with Delivery and Quality

  • Operational & Regulatory Change: every coach and instructor has the process, tooling and regulatory knowledge to deliver, and gets it before the change reaches a learner.

  • Technical Skills & Programme Requirements: coaches and instructors are current and designated on the technical content they deliver.

  • Timely Assessment & Achievement: shared ownership for timely learner achievement.

  • Enablement Operations & Systems: the foundation underneath all four.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set the direction and deliver results.. Define the owner, mandate and measures for each pillar, help prioritise and sequence work, and make trade-offs needed to deliver the greatest business impact.

  • Build Enablement Operations SMEs own skills and requirements while operations gets the enablement to the right people, on time, and tracks who did it.

  • Prioritise and re-prioritise without drama. Run a single visible enablement roadmap, say no clearly, and re-sequence when delivery data, business need or regulatory change demands it.

  • Delivering through other teams. Partner with Learning on programme and content change, Operations on process, Quality on the coaching standard, and Delivery on learner retention and achievement.

  • Close the feedback loop with Delivery Leadership. React to performance trends from monthly calibration, observations and delivery data.

  • Lead and develop six specialists through regular 1:1s, feedback, and clear individual measures.

Skills & Qualifications

  • A proven track record of balancing cross functional relationships and their priorities while still delivering impact in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

  • A demonstrable operator. You have taken something loosely defined and made it run: clear owners, measures, cadence, reporting. You are comfortable in the detail and you finish things.

  • Fluent cross-functionally. You have delivered outcomes that depended almost entirely on teams you did not manage, and you can explain exactly how.

  • Comfortable in ambiguity and shifting priorities. You decide on incomplete information, name the risk you are accepting, and change course without losing momentum or the team's confidence.

  • Data-led. You use performance data to decide where to intervene and to hold others accountable.

  • AI-native operator. You build cadences that use AI to do the collating and chasing, so the process scales with the team rather than growing headcount alongside it.

  • Experience of enablement, L&D, capability building, delivery operations or quality in an at-scale frontline organisation.

  • Apprenticeships, regulated education or another regulated delivery environment is a strong advantage. You can hold quality, compliance and pace at the same time.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication. You can write the one-pager a senior leader acts on, and run the calibration session a coach finds useful.

Benefits

  • Time off: 27 days holiday (including 3 winter shutdown days) and bank holidays, plus 5 extra days off (1 life event, 2 volunteer days and 2 summer shutdown days).

  • Health and wellbeing: Bupa private medical insurance, a medical cash back plan, therapy through Spill and gym access through Wellhub.

  • Equity for all: we believe that when Multiverse wins, we all win, which is why every permanent employee receives share options.

  • Financial security: life insurance at 3x salary, a workplace pension with 4% contribution from us, Cycle to Work and a Tech Scheme.

  • Family support: enhanced maternity and paternity leave, adoption and shared parental leave, paid leave after pregnancy loss, and a workplace nursery scheme.

  • Hybrid working: 3 days a week in the office - except for Coaches & Instructors who come into the office 1 day per month. Plus 10 days a year to work from anywhere.

  • Work perks: quarterly team socials, company-wide events, happy hours, lunch delivered to the office once a week, fully stocked snack bar and a drinks fridge!

title: Senior Manager, Constructability
descriptionHtml:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

The role

As Senior Manager, Constructability, you will build and lead Volta's constructability function. Your team will make sure every DSX design and build sequence is buildable, safe and maintainable before it reaches site, across all our AI factories.

This is a senior leadership role. Reporting to the Senior Director, Global E2E DSX Execution, you will own the constructability process end to end, build the team that runs it, and hold the line with designers, contractors and suppliers when buildability risks threaten schedule or cost.

What you will do

Team and process leadership

  • Own the global constructability review process at each design stage, with clear gates, decision rights and escalation.

  • Make the call on buildability issues before release for construction, balancing cost, schedule, quality and maintainability.

Sequencing and modular interfaces

  • Set installation and workface strategies aligned with procurement, commissioning and site logistics.

  • Define modular and off-site interfaces with OSM, including module sizes, tolerances, transport and lift constraints.

Assurance and improvement

  • Report constructability risk and performance to delivery leadership and drive changes into the reference design.

  • Turn site lessons into standards that cut rework from one site to the next.

What we are looking for

  • Senior construction delivery leadership on data centres or complex mission-critical projects.

  • Experience leading a team or function, not only individual project delivery.

  • A track record running constructability or design assurance across several projects at once.

  • Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical and structural interfaces, sequencing, logistics and temporary works.

  • Experience using BIM or coordinated models to resolve buildability issues at scale.

  • Credibility to challenge designers, contractors and senior stakeholders and get decisions made.

Nice to have

  • Modular or off-site manufactured infrastructure.

  • High-density AI facilities and liquid-cooled equipment installation.

  • International construction programmes.

What We Offer

At Volta, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted and able to grow. We're building a company where you can make an impact, keep a healthy balance between work and life, and build a career you're proud of.

title: Senior Methods Engineer
descriptionHtml:

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

We are looking for a Senior Methods Engineer to join our production plant in Wissous. In our context of fast growth, you will act as the connector between Production, Quality, Supply Chain, and our Industrialisation & Automation team.

We are not asking for you to maintain what someone else built, we are asking for you to build it yourself: every process, standard, lean system.

Afternoons are hands-on: kaizen walks, work instruction updates, problem-solving with supervisors.

You close the day feeding data back into the system.

Roughly 50% floor, 50% structured engineering work, every day. In a nutshell:

  • Continuous Improvement & Shopfloor Performance

  • Production Line Design & Internal Flow

  • Process Knowledge & Documentation

  • Automation Roadmap Contribution

  • Diploma in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Production Engineering. A strong profile from a different engineering discipline associated with strong shopfloor experience is also valued.

  • Team player with good communication skills.

  • Very good level of English and French

  • Full alignment with Harmattan AI's mission and willingness to go the extra mile to support our growth.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Senior Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
In just over two years, we’ve gone from 0 to over 900 customers, succeeding where many have tried and failed before. We have a big mission: to make it wildly easier and more profitable to run and grow a renewables installation business – and through that to make a massive dent in the world’s carbon emissions and create a hugely better experience for homeowners.

We’re now looking for a stellar Product Designer who’s buzzing to create exceptional experiences for installers as we expand into new markets.

🌲 About Spruce

  • Almost 20% of the UK’s carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there’s simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can’t currently offer a heat pump when someone’s boiler breaks and they urgently need heating.

  • We’re fixing this. We’ve built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we’re having a massive impact on installation businesses, suppliers, and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job and doubling their sales conversion rates.

  • We raised a chunky Seed round last year from top-tier investors and have been scaling the team to massively grow our impact. We’re in the process of expanding outside heat pumps and by the end of the year will be an operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. If you can picture a combination of ServiceTitan, Procore, and autoCAD, you might get a sense of where we’re headed…

🥖 The Role

You’ll be central to our mission as we turn historically slow and painful processes into ones that are quick, intuitive and even delightful for installers. We’ve been design-led since the beginning but the challenge is only growing as our product becomes (necessarily) more complex. Day-to-day you’ll be:

  • Making complex decisions feel effortless – Our platform handles everything from building physics calculations to fluid dynamics modelling to complicated compliance requirements. We need to make handling that complexity feel effortless for all our customers, irrespective of how tech-savvy they are.

  • Designing across multiple touchpoints – You'll work on desktop design tools, homeowner-facing outputs, enquiry flows, mobile survey apps (incl LiDAR), and collaborative workflows that work seamlessly across different user types (from 3-person local installers to national utilities);

  • Collaborating closely with developers & shipping code yourself – Understanding data structures and technical constraints so your designs can be shipped quickly; and shipping PRs yourself when it makes sense (with the support of the dev team);

  • Building systematic, scalable design systems – Creating robust, structured, and reusable components that work across platforms and for potentially low-tech users;

  • Researching and validating - Interviewing and spending time with installers to deeply understand how they work and what the core problems to solve are; and building quick prototypes to test and validate design decisions and uncover unexpected pain points.

You'll report directly to Steph, our Co-Founder and CPO.

🫵 About You

We’re looking for a designer with 3+ years of product/UI design experience (and potentially a lot more), ideally in a startup context or within fast-paced, impact-focussed teams. We'd love to speak with you if you are:

  • A clear, systematic thinker who loves tackling complex flows;

  • Comfortable with diving into technical detail, even if it’s a new domain;

  • User-obsessed; you enjoy deeply understanding the user, solving their problems and making a tangible impact on them;

  • Great with people and confident running research with customers;

  • Proactive and self-organising, happy juggling multiple projects;

Bonus if you’ve worked on tools for field teams, low-tech users, or on operational workflows (but absolutely not a requirement!).

🌟 Our offer

  • 💰 £70-100k salary, depending on experience.

title: Senior Product Engineer - Booking Management
descriptionHtml:
Hi! 👋 I'm Sam, Engineering Manager for Team Booking Management at WeTravel.

I joined WeTravel to help simplify how group travel businesses handle payments and bookings. Our Booking Management team owns the journey from the moment a traveler decides to book: checkout flows, order management, tax management, and everything that enables travelers to easily make a reservation and manage it afterwards. Last year alone, over a million travelers booked adventures through our platform! As we streamline and localize our booking experience, I'm looking for engineers who are excited about making complex booking and commerce flows feel simple for our global users.

About WeTravel:

Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods.

WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform makes it simple for organizers to create beautiful trip proposals, securely process payments, and manage their customers, so they can focus on what they do best: creating amazing experiences.

This is one of the last great frontiers of travel to come online, and as the category leader, we are at the forefront of this change. Last year alone, our platform was trusted by 8,000 organizers to lead over a million travelers on adventures in 150+ countries. Now, we're on an exciting journey to grow from powering $1B to $10B in travel experiences per year.

We believe that every trip, when done right, can be a force for good - and we're building the engine to make more of that possible.

What's the role:

You will join the Booking Management team to lead critical projects across checkout, order management, tax management, and traveler self-service. Upcoming work includes:

  • Checkout experience: streamlining and localizing our checkout flows so travelers in every market can complete a reservation in just a few clicks.

  • Order management: building the foundational systems for organizers and travelers to view, modify, and manage reservations end-to-end - changes, transfers, cancellations, and everything in between.

  • Tax management: expanding our tax capabilities across jurisdictions so organizers can sell compliantly wherever their travelers are.

  • Reliability and structural improvements: scaling our booking flows to support 10x growth.

What you'll do day-to-day:

  • Lead booking projects end-to-end: discovery with Product and Customer teams, solution design, build, rollout, monitoring, and incident response.

  • Partner with the Product team to gain insight into organizer and traveler challenges, building booking experiences that convert and delight.

  • Own the reliability of our booking and order management systems

  • Contribute to WeTravel's engineering practices and excellence.

How we work:

  • We're focused on the impact. We don't subscribe to any one framework or execution ideology, and we adapt based on what's impactful.

  • We're using the latest hardware and constantly on the look out for better tools & ways to work.

  • We have AI-first development experience and work with the latest models and agentic dev tools.

  • Stack: We're developing React/TypeScript, Ruby on Rails and Kotlin Microservices. Our services run on Kubernetes. We also use and love MongoDB, MySQL, Postgres, Snowflake and we're working with the major LLM providers.

You should apply if you have:

Basic qualifications:

  • 7+ years of product engineering expertise, with 4+ years dedicated to architecting complex e-commerce, booking, or order management systems.

  • Proven track record within a high-scale consumer checkout, marketplace, travel, or e-commerce platform team.

  • Broad practical expertise in building and troubleshooting production-level checkout and order flows: conversion-critical funnels, pricing and tax calculation, availability and inventory, cancellations, modifications, and refund flows. You possess deeply ingrained expertise in order state machines, multi-step form UX, and the operational tooling that keeps commerce systems running.

  • Strong backend mastery in Ruby on Rails, Kotlin, Python, Go, Java, or Node.js with the agility to ramp up on Ruby quickly.

  • Full-stack comfort: you can build the React interface for the booking flows you architect.

  • Deep expertise in architecting robust, resilient distributed systems, including order and reservation state machines, idempotency, exactly-once semantics, event-driven architectures, webhooks, and reliable consumer patterns.

  • Direct production on-call experience, including authoring post-mortems and leading incident response.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including cross-functional collaboration experience, and the ability to thrive in a distributed, multicultural environment.

  • Pragmatic adoption of AI tools to optimize your engineering workflow, including the ability to mentor and train others on AI concepts.

Technical Skills

  • Strong background in cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), containerization, and modern CI/CD practices.

  • Experience in handling critical systems with precision: you will handle pricing and tax logic directly within the application layer.

  • Bonus: Direct experience with tax engines or multi-jurisdiction tax compliance (VAT, GST, sales tax), or with travel-industry reservation systems.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience launching or significantly redesigning a checkout or booking flow end-to-end.

  • Experience building tax calculation or compliance capabilities across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Experience in marketplace or two-sided platform commerce (orders spanning buyers, sellers, and modifications over time).

You might not be the right fit if you:

  • Your commerce expertise is limited to plugging in off-the-shelf checkout or cart solutions. We need someone who operates deeply beneath that abstraction layer.

  • You are hesitant to take full ownership of mission-critical booking flows or participate in the on-call rotation when systems fail.

  • You prioritize greenfield development over the complex challenge of scaling and refining an existing system with significant booking volume.

  • You are looking for a siloed IC position without the need for cross-functional collaboration or product-level discovery.

  • You require a rigid, pre-defined roadmap; we prefer to sharpen our strategy and direction as we scale the team.

Why join us?

  • Solve real commerce problems at real volume: over a million travelers booking adventures in 150+ countries, and growing.

  • Make a real impact: you'll help build the operating system for the multi-day group travel industry, empowering thousands of organizers and millions of travelers worldwide.

  • Solve meaningful technical challenges at scale, from designing robust systems to improving real-time user experiences in a complex domain.

  • Be part of building the best engineering team: you'll help shape culture, mentor others, and contribute to high standards of excellence and collaboration.

  • Enjoy flexibility and balance, with competitive compensation, generous PTO, and remote-friendly work culture.

Benefits Section

  • Competitive salary

  • Generous "Time to Recharge" policy - enjoy unlimited paid time off to rest, recharge, and show up as your best self.

  • Work remotely for a maximum of 4 weeks per calendar year.

  • 2-week cross-functional onboarding program.

  • Cycle-to-work scheme (Swapfiets subscription) or commuting reimbursement.

  • Monday/Thursday team lunches and after-work social events.

  • Extensive paid family leave.

  • Three paid volunteer days per year - take time to give back to causes you care about, on us.

  • Cutting-edge equipment and tools to set you up for success.

  • Join an international, travel-loving team with a passion for adventure and innovation.

  • Access to our Booking Marketplace: Book hotels and flights for personal travel at exclusive discounted rates.

Equal Opportunities

WeTravel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. title: Senior Sales Recruiter
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role:

Let’s be honest: 2026 is a strange time to be in Talent Acquisition. Most recruiters are currently looking at their own internal dashboards with a sense of unease. They’re seeing the pivots, the shrinking req loads, and the ‘doing more with less’ memos. If you’re currently at a startup that’s struggling to find its footing, or a business where the hiring bar has dropped just to fill seats, you know exactly how fragile that ‘growth’ story feels.

Samsara is the exception. We are a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. 

And we aren't just stable—we’re expanding. Our UK Mid-Market team grew 70% year-over-year last year, and we need the talent engine to match that velocity. We aren't looking for someone to manage inbounds; we’re looking for a recruiter who wants to move from a shaky seat into a high-conviction, high-growth environment where the fundamentals actually make sense.

The Challenge:

  • Self-Sourced: You own your destiny. You will be expected to find, engage, and convert your own pipeline using best-in-class tools like HireEZ, Juicebox, and LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • The High Talent Bar: We aren't looking for CV pushers. You will be expected to act as a rigorous gatekeeper, ensuring that only the top 1% of gritty, A player sales hunters make it into our process.
  • Technical Assessment: You aren't checking vibes. You will be conducting deep-dive sales assessments, evaluating discovery mechanics, and ensuring every candidate has a structured methodology for success.

In this role, you will:

  • Execute & Deliver: Your mission is to fuel the Sales Account Executive engine. You will deliver high-quality, targeted pipelines at pace across EMEA, including the UK, France, Germany, and the Netherlands.
  • Own the Data: You are the CEO of your funnel. You will have total ownership of your response rates, passthrough rates, and talent market mapping. We make decisions based on data, not gut feel.
  • Partner with Sales Heavyweights: Work directly with our Sales VP and GTM leaders to align on hiring strategies that move the needle. You are a consultant, not an order-taker.
  • Master the Craft of Strategic Talent Acquisition: We hire for execution but develop for mastery. You will be mentored by some of the most sophisticated talent leaders in SaaS, learning how to move beyond execution to becoming a strategic talent partner who can influence the trajectory of an entire region.

Strong Backgrounds successful in this role:

  • The Agency Foundation: You started your career in a fast-paced recruiting agency. You still have that hunter DNA and the resilience to handle a relentless quarterly pace.
  • In-House Impact: In-house SaaS sales recruiting experience within a high-talent bar GTM organisation. You've proven you can translate agency grit into internal success.
  • EMEA Experience: You’ve successfully closed reqs in the UK and at least one other European market.
  • Technical Acumen: You can speak the language of sales. You know the difference between an order-taker and a territory owner. You have experience hiring for a scaling playbook environment and understand how to identify the elite within this market from the B players. 

The Ideal Candidate is:

  • Foundational Mastery: The goal is to bridge the gap between execution and influence. You are here to build the bulletproof foundations of an exceptional recruiter—learning how to own a region, influence high-level stakeholders, and use data as a weapon.
  • Focused & Structured: You understand that structuring your inputs—sourcing volume, message personalization, and rigorous screening—is the only way to get consistent output.
  • Data-Minded: You study your own conversion rates and market talent availability to stay ahead of hiring needs.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You iterate on your outreach and your screening questions based on what the data tells you.

What’s in it for you?

  • Build the Foundation for Leadership: We believe leadership is a set of skills, not just a job title. In this role, you will develop the data literacy to lead a boardroom with metrics, the strategic insight to advise VPs on market conditions, and the technical acumen to assess elite GTM talent.
  • Elite Exposure: You will be exposed to a broad range of international roles and learn from some of the best sales and recruiting leaders in the industry.
  • The Fortress Stability: NYSE-listed, GAAP profitable, and essential to the global economy. We are building for the long term, which means your career development here is backed by real revenue, not just a VC’s hopes.

Total Rewards

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Ceph Storage
descriptionHtml:
Location Details:

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.​

This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings.  

Join Our Team…

GoDaddy's Global Storage Engineering team operates one of the largest Ceph environments in the industry, powering the object, block, and file storage platforms that underpin hosting, applications, internal infrastructure, and next-generation AI/HPC workloads. If you're passionate about distributed systems, large-scale storage architecture, and solving complex reliability challenges, you'll work on infrastructure that few engineers ever experience. 

At GoDaddy, Ceph isn't a side project — it's a critical platform. Our environment spans 80+ production clusters, 20,000+ OSDs, and approximately 300 PB of raw storage capacity, supporting tens of billions of objects across multiple continents. The scale demands deep technical expertise in storage architecture, automation, observability, and performance engineering. 

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you'll be a key technical owner of the platform, responsible for maintaining reliability, driving operational excellence, and influencing the future evolution of our storage ecosystem. You'll tackle challenging production problems, develop automation that operates at massive scale, contribute to architectural decisions, and collaborate with some of the industry's most experienced Ceph engineers. This is an opportunity to have direct impact on a storage platform that serves millions of customers worldwide. 

What You'll Get to Do…

  • Own the reliability, performance, scalability, and capacity of large-scale production Ceph environments supporting object, block, and file storage workloads (RADOS, RGW, RBD, CephFS). 
  • Diagnose and resolve complex distributed systems issues including recovery/backfill events, OSD instability, PG imbalance, storage latency, and RGW performance bottlenecks. 
  • Design and build automation using Python, Shell, SaltStack, and Ansible to reduce operational toil and improve platform resilience at scale. 
  • Define and improve observability for the storage platform through SLIs, SLOs, PromQL, LogQL, Grafana dashboards, and proactive alerting strategies. 
  • Lead storage lifecycle initiatives including cluster expansions, hardware refreshes, software upgrades, OpenStack integrations, and large-scale migration projects. 

Your Experience Should Include…

  • 5+ years operating large-scale Linux infrastructure with significant experience supporting distributed storage systems in production environments. 
  • 2+ years hands-on Ceph administration including OSD, MON, MDS, and RGW operations, CRUSH map management, pool design, placement groups, and performance troubleshooting. 
  • Strong understanding of Linux internals, storage architecture, networking, filesystems, block devices, and performance analysis under production workloads. 
  • Experience developing operational automation and tooling with Python, Shell, and configuration management platforms such as Ansible, SaltStack, Puppet, or Chef. 
  • Proven incident response expertise, including production troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, postmortem creation, and implementation of durable corrective actions. 

You Might Also Have…

  • Advanced Ceph expertise across RGW Multisite, CephFS, RBD Mirroring, erasure coding, and large-scale cluster design. 
  • Experience integrating storage platforms with OpenStack (Cinder, Nova, Neutron, Swift) or Kubernetes storage technologies (CSI, StorageClasses, Rook). 
  • Familiarity with modern observability platforms including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Grafana, and enterprise monitoring architectures. 
  • Experience planning and executing petabyte-scale storage migrations, capacity expansion programs, and storage hardware lifecycle management. 
  • Contributions to open-source infrastructure or storage projects and a passion for advancing distributed systems technologies. 

We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Agentic Search) – Web Rendering (Chromium)
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Product

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible. We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work on the rendering infrastructure of a novel search engine tailored for agentic AI consumption.

In this role, you will focus on loading modern web pages in a browser that we patch and build ourselves, so that content is rendered completely and reliably at a cost that works across billions of pages. You will work inside Chromium to remove what we do not need, make the rest faster and cheaper, and keep our build current as Chromium moves. Your work ensures that high-quality content is consistently available to the indexing and retrieval systems downstream.

In this position, your responsibility will be to

  • Change Chromium in its heavy core (Blink, the V8 integration, the compositor, the network service) to cut CPU, memory and startup cost per page
  • Strip Chromium down for agent workloads: skip what nobody needs, such as image and media decoding, web font downloads, and rasterization and GPU work where no one needs pixels, while keeping what page scripts depend on to run correctly (style, layout, animation frames, observers), and work out what breaks, or renders differently, when you do
  • Keep the browser compatible with the web: make sure that what we remove does not change how the sites we load behave or render
  • Profile and tune fleets of browsers: the process model, memory per renderer, startup, isolation and crash handling
  • Build the production system around it: how browsers are launched, pooled, recycled and monitored

You may be a good fit if you

Have 5+ years of experience building production systems, and are an expert in several of the following areas.

Inside the browser

  • Strong C++ in a large, performance-critical codebase, ideally Chromium, Blink or V8, or a comparable browser engine (Rust is a plus)
  • Chromium architecture: the process model, Mojo IPC, the rendering pipeline (DOM, style, layout, paint, compositing), and the network service
  • Building, debugging and shipping custom Chromium builds: the build system, tracing, crash analysis, and maintaining patches across releases

Performance and systems

  • Profiling CPU, memory and I/O for browser fleets, with tools such as perf, tracing and flame graphs
  • Linux process isolation and resource management, concurrency, and memory management
  • Have run browsers in production, or built the infrastructure that does, and can describe where the time and memory went

Strong candidates may also have experience with

  • Contributions to Chromium, Blink, V8, Firefox, WebKit or another browser engine
  • Building or maintaining a patched browser that you wrote the patches for
  • Browser instrumentation, including the Chrome DevTools Protocol
  • Working familiarity with how modern frontend frameworks render (SSR, CSR, streaming, hydration)
  • Distributed systems, Kubernetes, and Go or Python

The kind of problems you will work on

  • Cut the cost of loading a page in half. Where do CPU and memory go, and what would you change in the browser?
  • Turn off the GPU and image decoding for agent workloads. What breaks, and what changes in how pages load and render?
  • A page runs a script that never yields. How do we detect and stop it without help from the page?
  • Chromium ships a new version. How do we bring a large set of patches forward in days, not weeks?
  • Decide when a page is finished, for pages with analytics beacons, long polling and endless scrolling.

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Senior Software Engineer – Automation Runtime
descriptionHtml:
About Routine Labs
A lot of critical work in Germany still happens in legacy software. Routine Labs automates it: we record the process, AI writes the automation, and only deterministic, testable code runs in production. Our clients are in regulated industries, where "it usually works" isn't good enough.

The role
You own the layer where generated automations meet real legacy software: making them run, noticing when they break, and producing the diagnosis that gets them fixed at the source.

What you'll do

  • Build the engine that drives legacy desktop apps reliably, including apps that were never designed to be automated and give you very little to work with.

  • Make automations hold up in remote and virtualized environments like RDP and Citrix, where the usual automation hooks often aren't available.

  • Own the runtime side of the repair loop: when an automation fails, the runtime should know why and hand the generation pipeline a diagnosis it can act on, instead of waiting for someone to patch it by hand. The fix itself is regenerated and reviewed, never hot-patched in production.

  • Build and own the replay infrastructure: real client recordings, replayed on our Windows VMs, with execution success tracked for every runtime change. Generation quality metrics run on top of it.

What you bring

  • You've built and run production Python systems that other people depended on.

  • You've automated desktop apps or built test/automation infrastructure, and you know why it breaks.

  • You've worked against Windows UI automation APIs (UI Automation, MSAA, Win32) or their equivalents, and you know what they don't expose.

  • You measure whether something works before claiming it does.

  • Business-fluent German and good English.

Bonus: Citrix/RDP, OCR or vision-based fallbacks, durable workflow engines like Temporal.

How we work & what we offer

  • We're a small team of 8 in Berlin. You'll work directly with our founding engineer. Engineers join client onboardings, because the best product decisions come from seeing real processes up close. Our stack is Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL and background jobs on a fleet of Windows VMs.

Join the team shaping the technical foundation of a company redefining how legacy software gets automated.

We value diverse perspectives and welcome candidates of all genders, identities and backgrounds.

title: Senior/Staff Site Reliability Engineer (Server Infrastructure)
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

Server Infrastructure is a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team responsible for the full lifecycle of Nebius Cloud hardware: from newly delivered bare metal through provisioning, operation, maintenance, and decommissioning. Almost every Nebius service runs on servers within our domain. Our mission is to make the hardware layer fast, reliable, and invisible.

We apply software engineering to infrastructure operations. We build services and automation that bring servers into the cloud, keep them healthy, recover them from failures, and retire them safely. Our work spans CPU and GPU platforms, the base GNU/Linux system, and the infrastructure supporting our hardware fleet.

As a Senior / Staff Engineer, you’ll take ownership of complex infrastructure challenges and help shape the team’s technical direction. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with architecture, mentoring, and coordination across teams, turning operational needs into reliable services and automation.
You’ll work closely with data center engineers, capacity managers, cloud compute developers, networking teams, and hardware suppliers. Your work will directly affect the reliability and capacity of the entire cloud platform.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Design, build, and operate services for netboot, provisioning, maintenance, automated recovery, and decommissioning.
  • Lead technical initiatives from problem definition and design through implementation and production operation.
  • Help shape the technical roadmap, balancing reliability improvements, new hardware integration, and long-term engineering work.
  • Define meaningful reliability indicators and service level objectives, using them to guide engineering priorities.
  • Reduce operational toil by turning recurring failures and manual procedures into reliable automation.
  • Improve on-call practices, incident response, and learning through blameless incident reviews.
  • Strengthen fleet observability, alerting, testing, deployment safety, and operational readiness.
  • Drive support for new CPU and GPU platforms and improvements to the base GNU/Linux system.
  • Mentor engineers, provide thoughtful design and code reviews, and help the team develop sound engineering practices.
  • Coordinate delivery across teams, communicate technical tradeoffs, and resolve dependencies.
We expect you to have:
  • Strong software engineering experience in Go and a solid understanding of Linux systems.
  • Experience designing, building, and operating infrastructure services, including distributed systems and failure handling.
  • A track record of owning complex technical initiatives and bringing them into production.
  • Practical knowledge of SRE principles: service level objectives, observability, incident management, capacity planning, and toil reduction.
  • Sound technical judgment and the ability to guide architecture and investigate difficult production problems.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and improving engineering practices through collaboration and technical example.
  • Clear communication and the ability to work effectively across engineering and operational teams.

We welcome candidates at senior and staff levels. The scope of ownership and technical influence will reflect your experience.
Experience with hardware provisioning, bare metal infrastructure, GPU platforms, or large server fleets would be valuable.
Familiarity with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, GitOps, SaltStack, and Terraform is also useful.
We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI
