title: Technical Onboarding Engineer (x/f/m) - Phone Assistant
descriptionHtml:
Werde Teil unserer Mission, werde Teil von Doctolib!

Wir suchen Dich als Technical Onboarding Engineer als Unterstützung für das Technical Onboarding Team in Berlin.

Du verantwortest eigenständig die technischen Onboardings unseres KI-basierten Telefonassistenten und sorgst dafür, dass Praxen und Krankenhäuser von Tag 1 an reibungslos mit Doctolib arbeiten können. Dabei übernimmst Du Standard- und mittelkomplexe Implementierungen, von der Prüfung der technischen Voraussetzungen bis zur Übergabe in den laufenden Betrieb. In den ersten Monaten wächst Du in unsere Systeme hinein, betreust bald Deine eigenen Kund:innen und bringst Deine Ideen ein, um unser Onboarding Schritt für Schritt besser zu machen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • KI in die Praxis bringen: Du installierst, konfigurierst und testest unseren KI-gestützten Telefonassistenten bei Standard- und mittelkomplexen Implementierungen. So stellst Du sicher, dass er im Praxisalltag zuverlässig funktioniert.

  • Eigene Onboardings steuern: Du planst Deine Onboardings, stimmst die nächsten Schritte mit Praxen und deren IT ab und behältst Zeitpläne und offene Punkte im Blick.

  • Technische Voraussetzungen klären: Du prüfst gemeinsam mit den IT-Ansprechpartner:innen der Kund:innen Anforderungen rund um Telefonanlagen, Netzwerke, VPNs und Schnittstellen und gibst ihnen klare Orientierung.

  • Daten sicher überführen: Du begleitest die Migration von Patienten- und Termindaten aus externen Praxissystemen in unsere Software. Dabei achtest Du darauf, dass die Daten richtig und vollständig sind.

  • Probleme lösen und gezielt eskalieren: Du analysierst technische Fehler, findest die Ursachen und setzt passende Lösungen um. Komplexe Fälle dokumentierst Du strukturiert und gibst sie an erfahrene Kolleg:innen oder die zuständigen Teams weiter.

  • Wissen teilen und Abläufe verbessern: Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Deployment, Support und Product zusammen und gibst Kundenfeedback weiter. Außerdem trägst Du zu Dokumentationen und Trainings bei und automatisierst in kleineren Projekten wiederkehrende Aufgaben, auch mit KI-Tools.

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit:

  • Erste Berufserfahrung im technischen Onboarding, in der Implementierung, im Technical Support oder in einer vergleichbaren kundenorientierten IT-Rolle

  • Ein solides Verständnis von APIs, IT-Infrastrukturen, Netzwerken und VPNs sowie Grundkenntnisse zu Telefonanlagen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Daten, zum Beispiel in Excel oder SQL

  • Eine strukturierte, eigenständige Arbeitsweise und klare Kommunikation, auch mit technisch weniger versierten Gesprächspartner:innen

  • Fließendes Deutsch (C1) und Englisch (mind. B2)

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem:

  • Programmiererfahrung in JavaScript und/oder Python

  • Kenntnisse in Patientenverwaltungssystemen oder EHR-Systemen

  • Erfahrung mit VoIP/SIP, SaaS-Lösungen oder KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Ein von Doctolib gesponsertes Deutschlandticket, wenn Du aus dem Büro oder im Hybridmodus arbeitest

  • 28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)

  • Die Möglichkeit, 10 Tage im Jahr aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten

  • Eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Zusatzleistungen (u.a. Zahnreinigung u.v.m.)

  • Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 % (15 % während der Probezeit)

  • Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

  • Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das extra Elternzeit (1 Monat) u.v.m. enthält

  • Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über einen externen Partner

  • Zusätzlich zu gesunden Snacks und einem regelmäßigen Frühstücksbuffet, bieten wir Essensgutscheine

  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

  • Für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen gibt es ein Angebot, das flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung beinhaltet

Der Interviewprozess

  • Interview mit dem Talent-Team

  • Interview inkl. technischem Case mit den Hiring Manager:innen

  • Mindestens eine Referenzprüfung

Job Details

  • Festanstellung

  • Vollzeit

  • Berlin

  • Hybride Arbeitsweise (3 Tage Office/Woche)

  • Ab sofort

Wir verfolgen die Vision, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Dies spiegelt sich auch im Recruiting wider. Wir evaluieren Bewerbungen ausschließlich auf der Grundlage von Qualifikation und Motivation. Diskriminierung wird bei uns nicht toleriert.

Je diverser unser Team und die Ideen sind, desto mehr wird unser Produkt die Gesundheit unserer Nutzer:innen verbessern können. Deshalb laden wir Dich ein, Dich bei uns zu bewerben, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Herkunft oder Behinderung.

Um Chancengleichheit zu gewährleisten, kannst Du in Deiner Bewerbung auf Angaben wie Fotos, Alter, etc. verzichten. Lass uns bitte wissen, welche Vorkehrungen wir treffen können, um Dich bestmöglich zu unterstützen. Wir freuen uns, mit Dir das Gesundheitswesen zu digitalisieren!

Alle bereitgestellten Informationen werden von Doctolib für das Bewerbungsmanagement verarbeitet. Für Details zur Datenverarbeitung klicke bitte hier.

Bei Fragen oder wenn Du Deine Rechte wahrnehmen möchtest, wende Dich bitte an hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com.

title: Technical Product Lead - AI Finance App
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Technical Writer, Frontier AI Best Practice
descriptionHtml:
About the AI Security Institute

The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.

We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.

The deadline for applying to this role is Sunday 29th November 2026, end of day, anywhere on Earth.

About the team

AISI's Technical Standards and Best Practice team identifies what best practice is needed to manage the most serious risks from frontier AI development and leverages AISI’s position to get it adopted. 

AI capabilities are advancing faster than the science and practices used to manage their risks. Risks now emerge earlier, during training, internal deployment and evaluation, not just at public release, and evaluation methods are struggling to keep pace. Yet there is no consensus on the set of practices needed to safely use and develop the most capable AI systems, and high-level principles are not enough to manage these risks. What's needed is concrete technical guidance that developers agree is necessary. 

AISI is uniquely placed to lead on parts of this industry-wide effort to establish best practice. We house researchers with state-of-the-art technical insight on keeping AI secure during internal use, hold existing relationships with industry and other frontier AI organisations, and offer a neutral third-party home to establish best practice collaboratively. This role directly delivers on part of the Prime Minister’s September 2026commitment that the UK will work towards principles and standards that ensure the most capable AI systems are developed securely and with appropriate transparency. It builds directly on our October 2026 publication Towards technical best practice for frontier AI development, setting out our view of the most urgent priorities. 

This is a new, growing team with high ambitions. It is a cross AISI initiative that draws on and collaborates with researchers and engineers from across AISI's research teams, as well as our Communications, International and Strategy teams. We're now building a dedicated core team and expect it to grow as the work does. 

Why this team matters:

AISI is uniquely placed to shape this guidance, and this team is how we'll do it: 

  • Technical expertise: AISI has roughly 10 technical and research teams whose expertise can be drawn on; one of the largest groups working on AI risk outside the frontier AI companies. AISI has evaluated more than 55 frontier models before release and published research on topics such as safety cases, monitorability and control. 
  • A research institute within government: we work directly with leading AI developers, other governments, and third-party evaluators, and can bring them together around practices no single company would set on its own. UK AISI also coordinates the International Network for Advanced AI Measurement, Evaluation and Science – a group of 10 AI security institutes and equivalents – which has already published its own and socialised others’ best practices.  
  • A track record of shaping industry practice: AISI has already helped establish voluntary practices such as pre-release testing, and built Inspect, now the standard framework for leading third-party evaluators. 

We're not seeking to mandate requirements. We want to contribute our expertise to an industry-wide effort to develop technical best practice that could later inform formal standards. 

What we're working on:

Examples of our first priority areas include: 

  • Overseeing AI systems: what monitoring and controls developers need to make sure AI systems behave as intended, and how to preserve that oversight as systems become more capable. 
  • Sharing information on the speed of AI development: which metrics best track progress, including AI's use in its own development, and when they should be shared with governments and the public. 
  • Assessing and documenting risk: what risk assessments and safety cases should cover, and what standard of evidence they should meet.

About the role

Primary objective: turn AISI's technical expertise into authoritative best-practice documents that frontier AI developers find valuable and use, and into clear explanations of why those practices matter. 

You'll work closely with AISI researchers and the standards team on two kinds of writing. 

Example responsibilities:

  • Best-practice documents (about 50%) 

    • Work with researchers to decide what form each piece of best practice should take, and how it should be structured. 
    • Own delivery of best-practice documents, co-drafting by managing researchers’ technical input and editing to ensure each practice is coherent, specific, testable and technically accurate. 
    • Set out the technical rationale for each practice, drawing on research findings, threat models and evaluation results, so the case for it is evidence-based and credible to a diverse set of expert readers.  
    • Develop a consistent style, templates and terminology for AISI best practice documents, and run review rounds with internal and external experts.

  • Explainers (about 50%) 

    • Write public explainers and technical blog posts setting out the reasoning behind AISI's best practice: why it matters, and what it means for developers, policymakers and the public. For example, the series that follow our agenda, Towards technical best practice for frontier AI development. 
    • Manage multi-stakeholder drafting processes, engaging with feedback from industry, wider government and expert third parties. 
    • Adapt material for different audiences, from technical researchers to non-technical policy readers, working with AISI's communications team.

Reporting and growth:

You'll report to the Head of Technical Standards and Best Practice. This role by default has no line management responsibilities thought responsibility will scale as the team grows. You'll learn from AISI's researchers across a wide range of frontier AI safety topics, and help shape a new team as it grows.

What we are looking for

We're flexible on the exact profile and expect successful candidates will meet many, but not necessarily all, of the criteria below. This role is most likely to fall at Level 4, but we are open to exceptional candidates at other levels. 

Essential:

We're looking for someone who can: 

  • Understand nuanced technical AI safety work well enough to explain its claims and limitations accurately, 
  • Write precise, structured documents that set out what organisations should do and why, 
  • Explain the same technical topics clearly and engagingly to non-technical readers 

For example, you might have: 

  • Written or co-written AI research papers, such as preprints on arXiv. 
  • Written in-depth technical communication on AI working directly with researchers, such as AI company blog posts or technical reports. 
  • Written technical guidance, standards or documentation in a complex field. 
  • Written for public or policy audiences on technical topics. 

You don't need all of these. For a sense of the level and style we're looking for, see the work our research teams publish on the AISI blog by our research teams. 

Desirable:

  • Familiarity with one or more of our priority areas: monitorability, safety cases and risk reports, or AI research automation. 
  • Extensive experience communicating AI security concepts for policy audiences. 
  • Experience running the writing of a multi-author document: gathering input from several experts, resolving conflicting feedback and getting it to publication. 
  • Familiarity with how frontier AI developers, evaluators or standards bodies work, for example from working at or alongside them. 

Example backgrounds:

  • An AI safety researcher who has published several papers and especially enjoys the writing and framing side of research. 
  • A technical writer or science communicator with a machine learning degree or AI background, who has co-written papers or reports on AI research. 
  • A research engineer or analyst at an AI safety organisation who has led writing on published frameworks or reports. 

Core requirements 

  • You should be able to spend at least 4 days per week working with us. 
  • No security clearance is needed to apply. Eligibility for Security Check (SC) clearance is preferred, but not essential. More detail on clearance eligibility can be found on the UK Government website: National security vetting: clearance levels - GOV.UK.

Interview process

Candidates should expect to go through some or all of the following stages once an application has been submitted:   

  • Initial interview   
  • Technical take home test   
  • Second interview and review of take home test   
  • Third interview   
  • Final interview with members of the senior team 

What We Offer 

Impact you couldn't have anywhere else 

  • Incredibly talented, mission-driven and supportive colleagues. 
  • Direct influence on how frontier AI is governed and deployed globally. 
  • Work with the Prime Minister’s AI Advisor and leading AI companies. 
  • Opportunity to shape the first & best-resourced public-interest research team focused on AI security. 

Resources & access 

  • Pre-release access to multiple frontier models and ample compute. 
  • Extensive operational support so you can focus on research and ship quickly. 
  • Work with experts across national security, policy, AI research and adjacent sciences. 

Growth & autonomy 

  • If you’re talented and driven, you’ll own important problems early. 
  • 5 days off and annual stipends for learning and development, and funding for conferences and external collaborations. 
  • Freedom to pursue research bets without product pressure. 
  • Opportunities to publish and collaborate externally. 

Life & family* 

  • Modern central London office, or where applicable, option to work in similar government offices in Birmingham, Cardiff, Darlington, Edinburgh, Salford or Bristol. 
  • Hybrid working, flexibility for occasional remote work abroad and stipends for work-from-home equipment. 
  • At least 25 days’ annual leave, 8 public holidays, extra team-wide breaks and 3 days off for volunteering. 
  • Generous paid parental leave (36 weeks of UK statutory leave shared between parents + 3 extra paid weeks + option for additional unpaid time). 
  • On top of your salary, we contribute 28.97% of your base salary to your pension. 
  • Discounts and benefits for cycling to work, donations and retail/gyms. 
     

*These benefits apply to direct employees. Benefits may differ for individuals joining through other employment arrangements such as secondments. 

Salary

Annual salary is benchmarked to role scope and relevant experience. Most offers land between £65,000 and £145,000 made up of a base salary plus a technical allowance (take-home salary = base + technical allowance). An additional 28.97% employer pension contribution is paid on the base salary. 

This role sits outside of the DDaT pay framework given the scope of this role requires in depth technical expertise in frontier AI safety, robustness and advanced AI architectures. 

The full range of salaries are available below: 

  • Level 3: £65,000–£75,000 (Base £40,850 + Technical Allowance £24,150–£34,150)
  • Level 4: £85,000–£95,000 (Base £48,540 + Technical Allowance £36,460–£46,460)
  • Level 5: £105,000–£115,000 (Base £63,165 + Technical Allowance £41,835–£51,835)
  • Level 6: £125,000–£135,000 (Base £76,475 + Technical Allowance £48,525–£58,525)
  • Level 7: £145,000 (Base £76,475 + Technical Allowance £68,525)

Additional Information

Use of AI in Applications

Artificial Intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

Use of AI tools in recruitment

We may use AI tools to help our hiring team review applications, for example by summarising application materials and helping us prioritise them against the published criteria. We do not use AI tools to find information about you from other sources, including online. People make every decision. We do not make solely automated decisions about candidates. Find out more, including your rights, in our recruitment privacy notice: https://www.aisi.gov.uk/careers/privacy-policy.

Internal Fraud Database 

The Internal Fraud function of the Fraud, Error, Debt and Grants Function at the Cabinet Office processes details of civil servants who have been dismissed for committing internal fraud, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned. The Cabinet Office receives the details from participating government organisations of civil servants who have been dismissed, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned, for internal fraud. In instances such as this, civil servants are then banned for 5 years from further employment in the civil service. The Cabinet Office then processes this data and discloses a limited dataset back to DLUHC as a participating government organisations. DLUHC then carry out the pre employment checks so as to detect instances where known fraudsters are attempting to reapply for roles in the civil service. In this way, the policy is ensured and the repetition of internal fraud is prevented.  For more information please see - Internal Fraud Register.

Security

Successful candidates must undergo a criminal record check and get baseline personnel security standard (BPSS) clearance before they can be appointed. Additionally, there is a strong preference for eligibility for counter-terrorist check (CTC) clearance. Some roles may require higher levels of clearance, and we will state this by exception in the job advertisement. See our vetting charter here.

Nationality requirements

We may be able to offer roles to applicant from any nationality or background. As such we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet the standard nationality requirements (opens in a new window).

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code (opens in a new window) sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants. The Civil Service embraces diversity and promotes equal opportunities. As such, we run a Disability Confident Scheme (DCS) for candidates with disabilities who meet the minimum selection criteria. The Civil Service also offers a Redeployment Interview Scheme to civil servants who are at risk of redundancy, and who meet the minimum requirements for the advertised vacancy.

title: Test Automation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Test Automation Engineer

Almere | 32-40 uur per week

Over de functie

Onze software verwerkt jaarlijks 35 miljoen declaraties voor zorgaanbieders door heel Nederland. Kwaliteit is hier geen bijzaak — het is de kern van alles wat wij doen. Als Test Automation Engineer ben jij diegene die ervoor zorgt dat onze software blijft werken zoals het hoort: betrouwbaar, snel en veilig.

We werken met een high code test automation oplossing op basis van C#/Playwright. Jij bouwt mee aan ons framework en helpt het naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Heb je een stevige basis in C# en affiniteit met Playwright? Dan ben je precies wie we zoeken.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt samen met je team aan het ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van ons test automation framework. Concreet betekent dat:

  • Automatiseren en onderhouden van testcases (UI én API)

  • Bouwen en onderhouden van het test automation framework in C#/Playwright

  • Adviseren over testscenario's en kwaliteitsrisico's

  • Samenwerken met developers, QA's en product owners

  • Kennisdeling binnen de Quality Guild

Wat vragen we?

Must have

  • Stevige basis in C# (high code)

  • Ervaring met of affiniteit voor Playwright

  • Ervaring met API-testen (Rest Assured of vergelijkbaar)

  • Kennis van testmethodieken en Agile werken

  • Teamplayer met goede communicatieve vaardigheden

Nice to have

  • Kennis van Java (achtergrond, geen vereiste)

  • Kennis van SQL en/of Postman

  • Ervaring met CI/CD (Azure DevOps)

  • Kennis van BDD-frameworks (SpecFlow, Cucumber)


Wat bieden wij?

  • Een zelfstandige en afwisselende rol in een dynamisch team.

  • Een gezellige, open sfeer en korte communicatielijnen.

  • Een rol met directe impact — 35 miljoen declaraties per jaar draaien op jouw werk

  • Volop ruimte om het framework echt te verbeteren — geen verstikkende legacy

  • Een salaris tussen de €5000 en €6500, afhankelijk van je kennis en werkervaring. Dit is geen absolute range, wel een goede indicatie

  • Bij positieve bedrijfsresultaten ontvang je een jaarlijkse bonus in de vorm van een maandsalaris.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding (€0,23 per km). Gebruik je het OV? Dan krijg je een NS Business Card (100% vergoeding).

  • Een pensioenregeling met een lage bijdrage voor jou.

  • Minimaal 26 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband. Je kunt feestdagen flexibel inplannen.

  • Een ruim opleidingsbudget en veel kansen om je verder te ontwikkelen.

  • Toffe secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals bedrijfsfitness, uitruilen van feestdagen en een fietsplan.

  • De mogelijkheid om mee te groeien in een financieel gezonde en informele organisatie.

  • Een mooi kantoor, fijne collega's en de optie om (deels) thuis te werken.

Wie zijn wij?
Bij Infomedics draait alles om het maken van impact in de zorg. We willen de zorgprocessen soepel laten verlopen, maar vooral menselijk houden. We zijn een snelgroeiende en bevlogen organisatie die volop in ontwikkeling is. We zetten steeds meer in op softwareontwikkeling en zoeken continu naar manieren om waarde toe te voegen voor onze klanten.

We bieden een financieel sterke en stabiele werkomgeving, met volop kansen voor onze medewerkers om door te groeien. Bij Infomedics werk je in een open en vertrouwde omgeving waar samenwerking en ontwikkeling centraal staan.

Sollicitatieprocedure:

  • Eerst een kennismakingsgesprek met de Recruiter en daarna met je leidinggevende en een directe collega.

  • Daarna volgt een verdiepend gesprek, en mogelijk een assessment van 30 minuten zodat we zeker weten dat we goed bij elkaar passen.

  • Vergeet niet dat je een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) nodig hebt voor de functie.

Interesse?

title: The Flex Algeria: Generalist, Operations & Growth
descriptionHtml:
One job, ten jobs. French salary, Algerian life.

Meet the founder: watch this 60-second video

 

About The Flex

 

Our mission: make renting an apartment as easy as buying something on Amazon.

Renting a place to stay is still slow, stressful and full of surprises. We're fixing that. With The Flex you pick your apartment, book in a few clicks and move in. Everything is handled for you: hotel-level service with the comfort of a real home.

  • Started with one apartment in London. Today we run around 1,000 rooms.

  • 7 cities, 5 countries: London, Paris, Berlin, Lisbon, Algiers, Oran and Constantine.

  • First mover in Algeria. We were the first short-term rental company in the country, and we're now the market leader.

  • Bootstrapped. No outside funding. On average, revenue grows 30% month on month.

  • Powered by AI. Everything runs on Base360.ai, the AI operating system we built in-house. It handles pricing, guest messaging, operations and bookings on autopilot.

  • Built for the diaspora. In Algeria, The Flex is becoming the go-to platform for Algerians abroad coming home.

 

The role

 

No two weeks are the same. One day you open a new apartment, the next you run a marketing campaign, the next you fix a guest problem. You learn every part of the business fast. Perform well and you can grow into running The Flex in Algeria.

 

What you'll do

 

  • Run day-to-day operations: properties, guests, cleaning, maintenance.

  • Help with marketing, content and direct bookings.

  • Work with landlords and local partners.

  • Track numbers and spot what's not working.

 

What you get

 

  • A French-level salary, paid while you live in Algeria.

  • Accommodation provided by The Flex.

  • A clear path to lead the country.

  • Real responsibility from week one.

 

Who you are

 

  • A French-Algerian living in France who wants to build something back home.

  • You like variety and hate boredom.

  • Fluent in English. English is our working language across London, Berlin, Lisbon and beyond.

  • Open-minded. You've travelled, studied or worked abroad, or you love working with people from different cultures.

  • Fluent in French. Arabic or Darja is a strong plus.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, pressure and speed.

  • No specific experience required. Curiosity and energy matter more.

 

Requirements (non-negotiable)

 

  • Fluent English, spoken and written.

  • You hold an Algerian passport.

  • You have the right to live and work in Algeria.

  • You're ready to be based in Algiers (El Biar).

 

Why you should NOT join us

 

  • You want a 9 to 6 job with a clear job description. This isn't one.

  • You aren't comfortable working in English every day.

  • You need a big team and processes around you. We're lean and mostly remote.

  • You care more about a corporate title on LinkedIn than real ownership.

  • You aren't ready to live in Algeria full time.

  • You expect benefits like health insurance. We don't offer them.

  • You get frustrated when plans change every week. They will.

 

Who you'll work with

 

Raouf Yousfi, founder of The Flex and Base360.ai. He's from Algeria, studied at Imperial College, went through Y Combinator and was on Forbes 30 Under 30. He co-founded Terra API, which raised more than $3M and sells to 400+ companies worldwide.

 

How to apply

 

Send a short video in English (max 2 min). Tell us:

  • Strong investigative and analytical skills; ability to identify errors

title: Vestigingsmanager Onderwijs
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij de verantwoordelijkheid over jouw eigen vestiging, leidinggeven aan een team én dagelijks impact maken op de ontwikkeling van jongeren? Bij Lyceo combineer je ondernemerschap, management en onderwijs in één rol. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid, volop vrijheid en de kans om zichtbaar bij te dragen aan de groei van leerlingen én jouw vestiging.

Taken

Maak het verschil als Vestigingsmanager

Als Vestigingsmanager ben jij eindverantwoordelijk voor het succes van jouw Lyceo-vestiging. Dankzij jouw inzet krijgen leerlingen de begeleiding die hen helpt effectiever te leren, meer zelfvertrouwen te ontwikkelen en betere resultaten te behalen. Je runt jouw eigen vestiging als een ondernemer binnen de organisatie. Daarbij stuur je een team van studentbegeleiders aan, onderhoud je contact met ouders en scholen en zorg je ervoor dat de vestiging kwalitatief én organisatorisch optimaal presteert. Je bent dagelijks zichtbaar aanwezig, signaleert kansen in de regio en bouwt aan duurzame samenwerkingen met scholen en ouders. Daarnaast ben je actief onderdeel van de dagelijkse praktijk op de vestiging en ondersteun je leerlingen tijdens de huiswerkbegeleiding. Juist die combinatie van management en persoonlijke begeleiding maakt deze rol zo afwisselend en betekenisvol.

Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het:

  • leidinggeven aan, coachen en ontwikkelen van een team studentbegeleiders;

  • voeren van intake-, evaluatie- en adviesgesprekken met leerlingen en ouders;

  • organiseren van roosters, administratie en plannen van aanpak;

  • opbouwen en onderhouden van relaties met scholen en andere stakeholders in de regio;

  • actief onderdeel zijn van de dagelijkse praktijk op de vestiging en leerlingen ondersteunen tijdens de huiswerkbegeleiding;

  • realiseren van groei, kwaliteit en resultaat binnen jouw vestiging.

Vereisten

Voor deze vacature neem jij mee:

Jij krijgt energie van het combineren van onderwijs, management en ondernemerschap. Je bent zelfstandig, besluitvaardig en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het succes van jouw vestiging. Daarnaast weet je overzicht te bewaren, kansen te signaleren en relaties op te bouwen met leerlingen, ouders, scholen en collega's. Je begrijpt dat kwaliteit, betrokkenheid en resultaat hand in hand gaan. Ervaring in een leidinggevende, coördinerende of ondernemende rol helpt je om snel succesvol te zijn in deze functie.

Vink jij deze checklist ook af?

• hbo werk- en denkniveau;

• affiniteit met het begeleiden en ontwikkelen van jongeren;

• ondernemende instelling en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel;

• commercieel inzicht en oog voor groei en resultaat;

• sterke organisatorische en communicatieve vaardigheden;

• we zoeken kandidaten op goede reisafstand van jouw vestiging. We hebben momenteel kansen in de volgende plaatsen: Hengelo, Utrecht, Laren en Delft.

Jouw werkgebied

Lyceo heeft ruim 100 vestigingen en daarmee altijd een vestiging bij jou in de buurt. Wij zoeken vestigingsmanagers voor de regio’s: Bussum, Laren en Delft.

Je bent dagelijks aanwezig binnen de vestiging en werkt nauw samen met leerlingen, ouders, begeleiders en onderwijsprofessionals. Daarnaast onderhoud je contact met scholen en andere betrokkenen in de regio en bouw je actief aan de groei en kwaliteit van de vestiging.

Benefits

Als gedreven vestigingsmanager kun jij rekenen op:

Een zelfstandige managementfunctie met veel verantwoordelijkheid binnen een maatschappelijk betrokken en resultaatgerichte organisatie. Lyceo geeft je de ruimte om jouw eigen vestiging te runnen, ondersteunt je met professionele begeleiding en investeert actief in jouw ontwikkeling en groei.

Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop:

• volledig door Lyceo betaalde pensioenbijdrage van 6%;

• variabele beloningsmogelijkheden gekoppeld aan resultaten en groei;

• een jaarcontract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week, net wat past bij jouw situatie, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband;

• vrij tijdens de schoolvakanties*;

• laptop en telefoon van de zaak;

• volledige ov-vergoeding of reiskostenvergoeding per kilometer;

• toegang tot de Lyceo Academie met diverse trainingen en opleidingen;

• persoonlijke begeleiding door een clustermanager en een eigen buddy;

• aantrekkelijke kortingen via Benefits At Work;

• regelmatige borrels, teamuitjes en een jaarlijks feest;

• betekenisvol werk, waarbij resultaat en impact hand in hand gaan.

*Naast de meivakantie en de laatste week van de zomervakantie ben je tijdens alle schoolvakanties vrij. Hiervoor wordt maandelijks 5,77% ingehouden ter compensatie van deze bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen, naast de 25 wettelijke vakantiedagen. Je bouwt vakantiegeld en pensioen op over je volledige bruto maandsalaris.

Werken bij Lyceo

Wie werkt bij Lyceo, blijft leren. Lyceo is een toonaangevende landelijke organisatie in aanvullend onderwijs en helpt jaarlijks duizenden leerlingen via programma’s zoals huiswerkbegeleiding, bijspijkertrajecten, examentrainingen en lente- en zomerscholen.

Als marktleider binnen dit domein is Lyceo volop in beweging. De organisatie groeit hard en heeft duidelijke ambities voor de toekomst. Je komt terecht in een betrokken en energiek team waarin samenwerking centraal staat, maar waar ook ruimte is voor initiatief, eigenaarschap en nieuwe ideeën.

De impact is groot: scholen beoordelen Lyceo gemiddeld met een 8,5 of hoger. We zoeken continu naar de beste samenwerking tussen regulier en aanvullend onderwijs en doen er alles aan om ieder kind tot z’n recht te laten komen.

Eén klik verwijderd van jouw nieuwe baan

Gaat jouw hart sneller kloppen van deze vacature en heb je de checklist afgevinkt? Wacht dan niet te lang, want zodra wij een geschikte kandidaat hebben gevonden sluiten we de vacature. Solliciteren doe je simpel en snel via onze solliciteer-button. Vergeet je niet om een up-to-date cv en een gerichte motivatie toe te voegen? Heb je vragen over de vacature? Neem dan contact op met Jamie via telefoonnummer 06-82073897. Misschien spreken we elkaar dan snel!

title: VP, Global Developer Relations
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As our VP of Global Developer Relations, you’ll be the voice and facilitator of Mistral to the developer, scientific, and technical communities. You’ll build and scale a global DevRel strategy that fosters deep engagement, advocacy, and love for Mistral’s models and technology. Your team will build communities and educate, excite, and empower developers to adopt, innovate, and evangelize Mistral’s technology—whether they’re startups, enterprises, researchers, or open-source contributors.

You’ll work closely with Product, Research, Engineering, Marketing, Communications, and more to ensure developers have the tools, resources, and inspiration they need to succeed with Mistral.

What You Will Do

Build a Global Developer Movement

  • Develop and execute a global DevRel strategy that connects Mistral and our AI platform effectively with developers, scientists, and technologists.

  • Create authentic, developer-first engagement—focusing on education, inspiration, and community, with great content and AI tools.

  • Foster a culture of advocacy where developers naturally champion Mistral in their networks, projects, and conversations.

Engage and Inspire the Technical Community

  • Lead high-impact developer engagement initiatives, including:

    • Technical content (e.g., tutorials, blog posts, videos, documentation) that helps developers get started, optimize, and innovate with Mistral’s models.

    • Community programs (e.g., hackathons, meetups, AMAs, Discord/Slack communities) that bring together AI builders, researchers, and enthusiasts.

    • Evangelism & thought leadership (e.g., conference talks, podcasts, technical deep dives) that showcase Mistral’s unique value and capabilities.

  • Work with Product and Research teams to translate complex AI innovations into accessible, exciting, and actionable insights for developers.

title: VP of Design
descriptionHtml:

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.


Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.


We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

title: Working Student – UAV Prototyping & Integration (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

We are a cross-functional engineering team powering our Counter-Unmanned Aerial Systems (C-UAS) program. Built on the background of the Minerva Edge CTRL team, our engineers create onboard edge software and integrated systems across core STARK platforms, delivering dependable performance when timing and accuracy matter most. Today, we are building the next-generation stack and physical integration for the STARK C-UAS platform at the intersection of hardware, real-time embedded systems, computer vision, and AI-driven navigation.

YOUR MISSION

As a Drone Engineer Working Student for Dragonfly, your mission is to bring our autonomous C-UAS systems to life in the physical world. Serving as a vital link between hardware development and software execution, you will assemble and refine our aerial platforms, design mechanical and electrical solutions, and build critical testing environments.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Drone Assembly & Prototyping: Work closely alongside hardware engineers to assemble, wire, configure, and maintain C-UAS drone platforms.
  • Electro-Mechanical Engineering: Tackle hands-on electrical and mechanical challenges, from circuit troubleshooting and sensor integration to structural adjustments and payload mounting.
  • CAD & Prototyping: Utilize CAD/EDA tools to creatively prototype and iterate custom mechanical and hardware solutions.
  • QA Testing & Simulation: Conduct Quality Assurance testing on physical drone hardware and software integration, while maintaining Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiTL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SiTL) test environments.
  • Field Operations & Inventory: Support live flight-test campaigns in the field and manage procurement workflows and inventory for lab equipment and R&D parts.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Academic Background: Enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related discipline.
  • Hands-On Hardware Skills: Practical familiarity with electronics, soldering, wiring, workshop tools, and mechanical assembly.
  • Engineering Fundamentals: Solid foundation in mechanical/electrical engineering principles and eager to learn CAD/design software.
  • Availability & Mindset: Pragmatic troubleshooting mindset, available up to 20 hours/week during semesters, and willingness to support local field testing.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Prior UAV / Robotics Experience: Building, maintaining, or piloting drones (FPV, multirotor, fixed-wing).
  • Flight Control & Autopilot: Familiarity with PX4, ArduPilot, Betaflight, or ground control stations like QGroundControl.
  • Design & Software Tools: SolidWorks, Fusion 360, KiCad, 3D printing, Linux, Python/C++, or ROS/ROS2.

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Workplace Technology Lead
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

As the Workplace Technology Lead you'll be the domain expert and technical authority for workplace technology and AV innovation within Corporate Engineering. Setting technical direction, leading technology delivery for capital builds, and creating and owning repeatable standards that support employees, clinicians and members.

This is a senior technical leadership role, so you'll deliver by influencing, coordinating and partnering across the organisation (Engineering, Facilities, Clinical, Real Estate). It combines hands-on delivery, programme leadership and practical AI solutions, and you'll shape how the function grows as Neko expands.

Your scope covers collaboration and meeting spaces, employee experience, executive briefing centres, clinic environmental AV and debrief-room presentation, digital signage, and technology integration across a growing portfolio of health centres. Network, security, facilities, clinical systems and scanning hardware stay with their specialist owners, and you'll work closely with them.

What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

  • Map the estate, opening pipeline, suppliers, ownership and risks in your first 60 days, and agree the role charter, roadmap and budget baseline with Technology and Operations

  • Create a global technology roadmap aligned to expansion plans, workplace needs and the member experience, turned into investment priorities, delivery plans and lifecycle budgets

  • Act as design authority for workplace and AV: define reference designs, preferred solutions and a clear process for local variations

  • Review existing standards, take full ownership of them in Corporate Engineering, and create a repeatable technology build playbook, piloted on an agreed site or room type

  • Lead the technology workstream for new offices, health centres and refurbishments, from feasibility and design through procurement, commissioning and operational handover

  • Own the integrated technology programme: financial forecasts, risks, changes and executive reporting, with clear readiness criteria, acceptance tests and defect tracking for each opening

  • Work with clinical operations and design teams on debrief displays, ambient audio, signage and controls, prioritising simple use, discretion and a calm environment for members

  • Test two approved operational AI use cases, for example automated commissioning tools, through measured pilots

  • Establish asset and lifecycle records, supplier reviews and service requirements with Procurement and support owners

  • Deliver a costed proposal and an 18–24 month plan for the next stage of the function, with any hiring linked to the site pipeline and support demand

What We're Looking For

  • Substantial experience in workplace technology, enterprise AV and integrated systems, including delivery across multiple countries and physical environments

  • A record of technical leadership: setting standards across a complex portfolio and developing others through influence rather than line authority

  • Experience taking technology projects through architectural design, procurement, construction, commissioning and handover, with commercial and programme accountability

  • Ability to explain technical decisions to executives, clinicians, designers and delivery partners, and to connect investment choices to practical user needs

  • Practical curiosity about AI and automation, with the judgement to test outputs and involve specialist owners

Nice to Have

  • Healthcare or regulated-environment experience

  • Enterprise and experiential delivery experience

Equal Opportunity and Inclusion

Neko Health is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are happy to make reasonable adjustments throughout the hiring process.
